'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import {
  ArrowRight, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, CircleDollarSign, Clock3,
  Plus, RefreshCw, Save, Search, Target, TrendingUp, X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import type { SalesWorkspaceData } from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';

type Props = {
  data: SalesWorkspaceData;
  busy: boolean;
  request: (payload: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
  showSuccess: (title: string, message: string) => void;
  showError: (title: string, message: string) => void;
};
type PipelineOption = { id: string; name: string; sequence: number; is_default: boolean; is_active: boolean };
type PipelineStage = {
  id: string; pipeline_id: string; name: string; sequence: number;
  probability: number | string; stage_type: 'open' | 'won' | 'lost' | string; is_active: boolean;
};
type Opportunity = {
  id: string; opportunity_number: string; name: string; stage_id: string;
  stage_type: 'open' | 'won' | 'lost' | string; stage_name: string;
  customer_name: string | null; contact_name: string | null; email: string | null;
  phone: string | null; currency: string; expected_value: number | string;
  probability: number | string; expected_close_date: string | null;
  source: string | null; latest_quote_id: string | null; lost_reason: string | null;
};
type PipelinePayload = {
  pipelines: PipelineOption[]; activePipelineId: string;
  stages: PipelineStage[]; opportunities: Opportunity[];
};
type StageDraft = { id: string | null; name: string; probability: string };
type PendingMove = { opportunity: Opportunity; stageId: string; reason: string };

function numeric(value: number | string | null | undefined) {
  const parsed = Number(value ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : 0;
}
function formatMoney(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency: currency || 'KES', maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return (currency || 'KES') + ' ' + value.toLocaleString('en-KE', { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
  }
}
// Never combine amounts from different transaction currencies in one total.
function totalsByCurrency(rows: Opportunity[], weighted = false) {
  const totals = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const currency = (row.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase();
    const amount = numeric(row.expected_value) * (weighted ? numeric(row.probability) / 100 : 1);
    totals.set(currency, (totals.get(currency) || 0) + amount);
  }
  return [...totals.entries()].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
    .map(([currency, amount]) => formatMoney(amount, currency)).join(' · ') || '—';
}
function dateLabel(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return 'No close date';
  const date = new Date(String(value).slice(0, 10) + 'T00:00:00');
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? String(value).slice(0, 10)
    : date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
}

export default function SalesPipelineBoard({ data, busy, request, showSuccess, showError }: Props) {
  const [board, setBoard] = useState<PipelinePayload | null>(null);
  const [selectedPipelineId, setSelectedPipelineId] = useState('');
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [stageDraft, setStageDraft] = useState<StageDraft | null>(null);
  const [savingStage, setSavingStage] = useState(false);
  const [archivingStageId, setArchivingStageId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pendingMove, setPendingMove] = useState<PendingMove | null>(null);

  const loadBoard = useCallback(async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const query = selectedPipelineId
        ? '/api/apps/sales?pipeline=1&pipelineId=' + encodeURIComponent(selectedPipelineId)
        : '/api/apps/sales?pipeline=1';
      const response = await fetch(query, {
        method: 'GET', credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store',
        headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
      });
      const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as {
        success?: boolean; pipeline?: PipelinePayload; error?: string;
      };
      if (!response.ok || body.success !== true || !body.pipeline) {
        throw new Error(body.error || 'SaMi could not load the opportunity pipeline.');
      }
      setBoard(body.pipeline);
      if (!selectedPipelineId && body.pipeline.activePipelineId) {
        setSelectedPipelineId(body.pipeline.activePipelineId);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Pipeline could not load', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not load the opportunity pipeline.');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [selectedPipelineId, showError]);

  useEffect(() => { void loadBoard(); }, [loadBoard]);

  const stages = useMemo(
    () => [...(board?.stages || [])].sort((a, b) => a.sequence - b.sequence || a.name.localeCompare(b.name)),
    [board],
  );
  const openStages = useMemo(() => stages.filter(stage => stage.stage_type === 'open'), [stages]);
  const opportunities = useMemo(() => board?.opportunities || [], [board]);
  const filteredOpportunities = useMemo(() => {
    const query = search.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!query) return opportunities;
    return opportunities.filter(item => [
      item.opportunity_number, item.name, item.customer_name, item.contact_name,
      item.email, item.phone, item.source, item.stage_name,
    ].some(value => String(value || '').toLowerCase().includes(query)));
  }, [opportunities, search]);
  const opportunitiesByStage = useMemo(() => {
    const grouped = new Map<string, Opportunity[]>();
    for (const stage of stages) grouped.set(stage.id, []);
    for (const opportunity of filteredOpportunities) grouped.get(opportunity.stage_id)?.push(opportunity);
    return grouped;
  }, [filteredOpportunities, stages]);

  const openOpportunities = opportunities.filter(item => item.stage_type === 'open');
  const overdueCount = openOpportunities.filter(item =>
    item.expected_close_date && item.expected_close_date.slice(0, 10) < new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
  ).length;
  const isBusy = busy || loading || savingStage;

  async function commitMove(opportunity: Opportunity, stageId: string, reason = '') {
    try {
      await request({ action: 'move_opportunity', opportunityId: opportunity.id, stageId, reason });
      setPendingMove(null);
      showSuccess('Opportunity moved', 'The stage change and opportunity audit history have been saved.');
      await loadBoard();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Stage could not change', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not move this opportunity.');
    }
  }

  function onStageChange(opportunity: Opportunity, stageId: string) {
    if (!stageId || stageId === opportunity.stage_id) return;
    const target = stages.find(stage => stage.id === stageId);
    if (!target) return;
    if (target.stage_type === 'lost') {
      setPendingMove({ opportunity, stageId, reason: '' });
      return;
    }
    void commitMove(opportunity, stageId);
  }

  async function saveStage(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!stageDraft || !board) return;
    const name = stageDraft.name.trim();
    const probability = Number(stageDraft.probability);
    if (!name || !Number.isFinite(probability) || probability < 0 || probability > 100) {
      showError('Stage details are invalid', 'Enter a stage name and a probability from 0 to 100.');
      return;
    }
    setSavingStage(true);
    try {
      await request(stageDraft.id
        ? { action: 'update_pipeline_stage', stageId: stageDraft.id, name, probability }
        : { action: 'create_pipeline_stage', pipelineId: board.activePipelineId, name, probability });
      showSuccess(stageDraft.id ? 'Stage updated' : 'Stage created',
        stageDraft.id ? 'The stage settings have been saved.' : 'The new stage is ready for opportunities.');
      setStageDraft(null);
      await loadBoard();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Stage could not be saved', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not save this stage.');
    } finally {
      setSavingStage(false);
    }
  }

  async function archiveStage(stage: PipelineStage) {
    try {
      const result = await request({ action: 'archive_pipeline_stage', stageId: stage.id });
      const moved = Number(result.movedOpportunities || 0);
      showSuccess('Stage archived', moved
        ? moved + ' opportunity record(s) moved to the next active stage; transition history was recorded.'
        : 'The stage is archived and no longer available for new opportunities.');
      setArchivingStageId(null);
      await loadBoard();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Stage could not be archived', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not archive this stage.');
    }
  }

  async function reorderStages(stageId: string, direction: -1 | 1) {
    if (!board) return;
    const index = openStages.findIndex(stage => stage.id === stageId);
    const next = index + direction;
    if (index < 0 || next < 0 || next >= openStages.length) return;
    const ordered = [...openStages];
    [ordered[index], ordered[next]] = [ordered[next], ordered[index]];
    try {
      await request({ action: 'reorder_pipeline_stages', pipelineId: board.activePipelineId, stageIds: ordered.map(stage => stage.id) });
      await loadBoard();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Stage order could not change', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not reorder these stages.');
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <header className="sami-surface rounded-[26px] p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 xl:flex-row xl:items-start xl:justify-between">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.14em] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300">Sales workspace · opportunity management</p>
            <h1 className="mt-1 text-xl font-black sm:text-2xl">Pipeline board</h1>
            <p className="mt-2 max-w-3xl text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Work real opportunities by stage, monitor weighted value and keep each move in the opportunity audit trail.</p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Link href="/apps/sales/opportunities" className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black transition hover:bg-[var(--sami-surface-soft)]">
              Manage leads & opportunities <ArrowRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Link>
            <button type="button" disabled={isBusy} onClick={() => void loadBoard()} className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black disabled:opacity-60">
              <RefreshCw className={`h-4 w-4 ${loading ? 'animate-spin' : ''}`} /> Refresh
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <section className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <article className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">Open opportunities</p><Target className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" /></div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black tabular-nums">{openOpportunities.length}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">Deals still in progress</p>
        </article>
        <article className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">Open pipeline</p><CircleDollarSign className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" /></div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-black leading-6">{totalsByCurrency(openOpportunities)}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">Amounts grouped by transaction currency</p>
        </article>
        <article className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">Weighted pipeline</p><TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" /></div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-lg font-black leading-6">{totalsByCurrency(openOpportunities, true)}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">Expected value × probability</p>
        </article>
        <article className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">Past close date</p><Clock3 className={`h-4 w-4 ${overdueCount ? 'text-amber-600' : 'text-slate-500'}`} /></div>
          <p className="mt-2 text-2xl font-black tabular-nums">{overdueCount}</p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">Open deals with overdue close dates</p>
        </article>
      </section>

      <section className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-3 sm:p-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
          <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
            <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="sales-pipeline-select">Select pipeline</label>
            <select id="sales-pipeline-select" value={selectedPipelineId || board?.activePipelineId || ''}
              onChange={event => setSelectedPipelineId(event.target.value)} disabled={isBusy || (board?.pipelines.length || 0) < 2}
              className="h-10 min-w-[220px] rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-60">
              {(board?.pipelines || []).map(pipeline => <option key={pipeline.id} value={pipeline.id}>{pipeline.name}{pipeline.is_default ? ' · Default' : ''}</option>)}
            </select>
            <label className="relative block min-w-0 sm:min-w-[260px]">
              <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
              <input value={search} onChange={event => setSearch(event.target.value)} placeholder="Search opportunities" aria-label="Search opportunities on pipeline board"
                className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent pl-9 pr-3 text-xs" />
            </label>
          </div>
          {data.capabilities.canManagePipelineStages ? <button type="button" disabled={isBusy || !board?.activePipelineId}
            onClick={() => setStageDraft({ id: null, name: '', probability: '20' })}
            className="inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3.5 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60">
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" /> New stage
          </button> : null}
        </div>
      </section>

      {stageDraft ? <section className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-4 sm:p-5">
        <form onSubmit={saveStage} className="space-y-3">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div><h2 className="text-sm font-black">{stageDraft.id ? 'Edit pipeline stage' : 'Create pipeline stage'}</h2>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Won and Lost remain protected terminal stages. Reorder open stages from the board.</p></div>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setStageDraft(null)} aria-label="Close stage editor" className="inline-flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)]"><X className="h-4 w-4" /></button>
          </div>
          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_180px_auto] sm:items-end">
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Stage name *
              <input value={stageDraft.name} onChange={event => setStageDraft(current => current ? { ...current, name: event.target.value } : current)}
                required maxLength={120} autoFocus placeholder="e.g. Proposal review" className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm" />
            </label>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Default probability (%)
              <input type="number" value={stageDraft.probability} onChange={event => setStageDraft(current => current ? { ...current, probability: event.target.value } : current)}
                min={0} max={100} step={1} required className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm" />
            </label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button type="submit" disabled={isBusy} className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"><Save className="h-4 w-4" /> {savingStage ? 'Saving…' : 'Save stage'}</button>
              <button type="button" disabled={isBusy} onClick={() => setStageDraft(null)} className="h-10 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-bold">Cancel</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </form>
      </section> : null}

      {pendingMove ? <section role="dialog" aria-labelledby="lost-stage-title" className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] border-amber-300/70 p-4 dark:border-amber-500/30">
        <h2 id="lost-stage-title" className="text-sm font-black">Record the loss reason</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Moving “{pendingMove.opportunity.name}” to Lost requires an auditable reason.</p>
        <form className="mt-3 space-y-3" onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); if (pendingMove.reason.trim()) void commitMove(pendingMove.opportunity, pendingMove.stageId, pendingMove.reason.trim()); }}>
          <textarea value={pendingMove.reason} onChange={event => setPendingMove(current => current ? { ...current, reason: event.target.value } : current)}
            required maxLength={2000} rows={3} placeholder="Explain why the deal was lost." aria-label="Reason for losing opportunity"
            className="w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent p-3 text-sm" />
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button type="submit" disabled={busy || !pendingMove.reason.trim()} className="h-10 rounded-xl bg-rose-700 px-3.5 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60">Confirm lost stage</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setPendingMove(null)} className="h-10 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-bold">Cancel</button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </section> : null}

      <section className="sami-surface overflow-hidden rounded-[26px] p-3 sm:p-4">
        <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 px-1">
          <div><h2 className="text-sm font-black">Opportunity stages</h2><p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">{filteredOpportunities.length} of {opportunities.length} opportunities shown</p></div>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500">Move a deal by selecting a destination stage on its card.</span>
        </div>
        {loading ? <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3 2xl:grid-cols-5">{[1,2,3,4,5].map(item => <div key={item} className="h-60 animate-pulse rounded-2xl bg-[var(--sami-surface-soft)]" />)}</div>
        : stages.length === 0 ? <div className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border-strong)] p-8 text-center"><p className="text-sm font-black">No active pipeline stages</p><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">Create an open stage to start organizing opportunities.</p></div>
        : <div className="sami-scrollbar -mx-1 flex gap-3 overflow-x-auto px-1 pb-3">
          {stages.map((stage, stageIndex) => {
            const cards = opportunitiesByStage.get(stage.id) || [];
            const isOpen = stage.stage_type === 'open';
            return <section key={stage.id} className="flex w-[min(84vw,330px)] shrink-0 flex-col rounded-2xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-[var(--sami-surface-soft)]/70 p-3">
              <header className="mb-3 border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] pb-3">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2"><div className="min-w-0">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2"><h3 className="truncate text-sm font-black">{stage.name}</h3><span className="rounded-full border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-[var(--sami-surface)] px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-black tabular-nums">{cards.length}</span></div>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] font-semibold text-slate-500">{isOpen ? Number(stage.probability).toFixed(0) + '% default probability' : stage.stage_type === 'won' ? 'Closed won' : 'Closed lost'}</p>
                </div>
                {data.capabilities.canManagePipelineStages && isOpen ? <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1">
                  <button type="button" disabled={isBusy || stageIndex === 0} onClick={() => void reorderStages(stage.id, -1)} aria-label={'Move ' + stage.name + ' earlier'} title="Move stage earlier" className="inline-flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] disabled:opacity-30"><ChevronLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></button>
                  <button type="button" disabled={isBusy || stageIndex >= openStages.length - 1} onClick={() => void reorderStages(stage.id, 1)} aria-label={'Move ' + stage.name + ' later'} title="Move stage later" className="inline-flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] disabled:opacity-30"><ChevronRight className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /></button>
                  <button type="button" disabled={isBusy} onClick={() => setStageDraft({ id: stage.id, name: stage.name, probability: String(stage.probability) })} aria-label={'Edit ' + stage.name} title="Edit stage" className="inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2 text-[10px] font-black">Edit</button>
                  {archivingStageId === stage.id
                    ? <button type="button" disabled={isBusy} onClick={() => void archiveStage(stage)} className="inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded-lg bg-rose-700 px-2 text-[10px] font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60">Confirm archive</button>
                    : <button type="button" disabled={isBusy || openStages.length <= 1} onClick={() => setArchivingStageId(stage.id)} aria-label={'Archive ' + stage.name} title="Archive stage" className="inline-flex h-7 items-center rounded-lg border border-rose-500/30 px-2 text-[10px] font-black text-rose-700 disabled:opacity-30 dark:text-rose-300">Archive</button>}
                </div> : null}</div>
                {archivingStageId === stage.id ? <div className="mt-2 rounded-xl border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/5 p-2"><p className="text-[10px] leading-4 text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">Opportunities in this stage move to the next active open stage, and each transition is recorded.</p><button type="button" onClick={() => setArchivingStageId(null)} className="mt-1 text-[10px] font-black underline">Cancel archive</button></div> : null}
                <p className="mt-2 text-[10px] leading-4 text-slate-500">Stage value · {totalsByCurrency(cards)}</p>
                {isOpen ? <p className="mt-0.5 text-[10px] leading-4 text-slate-500">Weighted · {totalsByCurrency(cards.filter(item => item.stage_type === 'open'), true)}</p> : null}
              </header>
              <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
                {cards.length === 0 ? <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 py-6 text-center text-[11px] text-slate-500">No opportunities in this stage</div>
                : cards.map(opportunity => <article key={opportunity.id} className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-[var(--sami-surface)] p-3 shadow-[var(--sami-shadow-sm)]">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2"><div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-300">{opportunity.opportunity_number}</p>
                    <h4 className="mt-1 break-words text-xs font-black leading-5">{opportunity.name}</h4>
                  </div><span className="shrink-0 rounded-full bg-slate-500/10 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-black">{Number(opportunity.probability).toFixed(0)}%</span></div>
                  <p className="mt-1 truncate text-[11px] text-slate-500">{opportunity.customer_name || opportunity.contact_name || 'Customer not specified'}</p>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-sm font-black tabular-nums">{formatMoney(numeric(opportunity.expected_value), opportunity.currency)}</p>
                  <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] text-slate-500"><span>{dateLabel(opportunity.expected_close_date)}</span><span>{opportunity.source || 'No source'}</span></div>
                  <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    <label className="min-w-0 flex-1"><span className="sr-only">Move {opportunity.name} to stage</span>
                      <select aria-label={'Move ' + opportunity.name + ' to stage'} value={opportunity.stage_id} onChange={event => onStageChange(opportunity, event.target.value)}
                        disabled={isBusy || !data.capabilities.canMovePipeline} className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-2 text-[10px] font-bold disabled:opacity-50">
                        {stages.map(option => <option key={option.id} value={option.id}>{option.name}</option>)}
                      </select>
                    </label>
                    {opportunity.latest_quote_id ? <Link href={'/apps/sales/quotes/' + encodeURIComponent(opportunity.latest_quote_id)} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2 text-[10px] font-black">Quote <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3" /></Link> : null}
                  </div>
                </article>)}
              </div>
            </section>;
          })}
        </div>}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

type PipelineAction =
  | { action: 'create_pipeline'; name: string }
  | { action: 'create_lead'; name: FormDataEntryValue | null; companyName: FormDataEntryValue | null; contactName: FormDataEntryValue | null; email: FormDataEntryValue | null; phone: FormDataEntryValue | null; source: FormDataEntryValue | null; salesTeamId: FormDataEntryValue | null; salespersonUserId: FormDataEntryValue | null; confirmDuplicates?: boolean }
  | { action: 'update_lead'; leadId: string; name: string; companyName: string; contactName: string; email: string; phone: string; source: string; notes: string; salespersonUserId: string | null; salesTeamId: string | null; assignmentReason: string }
  | { action: 'disqualify_lead'; leadId: string; reason: string }
  | { action: 'reopen_lead'; leadId: string }
  | { action: 'create_lead_activity'; leadId: string; activityType: string; subject: string; description: string; dueDate: string | null; assignedUserId: string | null }
  | { action: 'update_lead_activity'; activityId: string; status: 'completed' | 'cancelled' }
  | { action: 'edit_lead_activity'; activityId: string; activityType: ActivityDraft['activityType']; subject: string; description: string; dueDate: string | null; assignedUserId: string | null }
  | { action: 'create_opportunity_activity'; opportunityId: string; activityType: string; subject: string; description: string; dueDate: string | null; assignedUserId: string | null }
  | { action: 'update_opportunity_activity'; activityId: string; status: 'completed' | 'cancelled' }
  | { action: 'edit_opportunity_activity'; activityId: string; activityType: ActivityDraft['activityType']; subject: string; description: string; dueDate: string | null; assignedUserId: string | null }
  | { action: 'convert_lead'; leadId: string; pipelineId: string; name: string; expectedValue: string; currency: string; expectedCloseDate: string | null }
  | { action: 'update_opportunity'; opportunityId: string; name: string; customerName: string; contactName: string; email: string; phone: string; expectedValue: string; currency: string; expectedCloseDate: string | null; source: string; notes: string; salespersonUserId: string | null }
  | { action: 'move_opportunity'; opportunityId: string; stageId: string; reason?: string }
  | { action: 'save_pipeline_view'; name: string; viewType: 'leads' | 'opportunities'; statusView: string; scoreView: 'all' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'; searchQuery: string }
  | { action: 'delete_pipeline_view'; viewId: string }
  | { action: 'save_lead_assignment_rule'; ruleId: string | null; name: string; sourceMatch: string | null; salesTeamId: string; priority: number; isActive: boolean }
  | { action: 'delete_lead_assignment_rule'; ruleId: string }
  | { action: 'bulk_reassign_leads'; leadIds: string[]; salesTeamId: string; salespersonUserId: string | null; reason: string }
  | { action: 'bulk_update_lead_status'; leadIds: string[]; mode: 'disqualify' | 'reopen'; reason: string }
  | { action: 'bulk_create_lead_activities'; leadIds: string[]; activityType: ActivityDraft['activityType']; subject: string; description: string; dueDate: string | null; assignedUserId: string | null };

type CreateLeadPayload = Extract<PipelineAction, { action: 'create_lead' }>;

type LeadDuplicateMatch = {
  id: string;
  lead_number: string;
  status: string;
  name: string;
  company_name: string | null;
  contact_name: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  salesperson_user_id: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  match_reason: 'email' | 'phone' | 'email_and_phone' | string;
};

type QualificationDraft = {
  expectedValue: string;
  currency: string;
  expectedCloseDate: string;
};

type LeadDraft = {
  name: string; companyName: string; contactName: string; email: string;
  phone: string; source: string; notes: string; salespersonUserId: string;
  salesTeamId: string; assignmentReason: string;
};

type SalesLeadAssignmentHistoryEntry = {
  id: string;
  lead_id: string;
  previous_salesperson_user_id: string | null;
  new_salesperson_user_id: string | null;
  previous_sales_team_id: string | null;
  new_sales_team_id: string | null;
  previous_territory_id: string | null;
  new_territory_id: string | null;
  changed_by: string;
  reason: string;
  created_at: string;
};

type ActivityDraft = {
  activityType: 'call' | 'email' | 'meeting' | 'task' | 'note';
  subject: string; description: string; dueDate: string; assignedUserId: string;
};

function formatMoney(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return currency + ' ' + value.toLocaleString();
  }
}

function normalizedCurrency(value: string) {
  return value.trim().toUpperCase().slice(0, 3) || 'KES';
}

type ActivityDueBucket = 'overdue' | 'today' | 'upcoming' | 'unscheduled' | 'later';
type ActivityAgendaFilter = 'all' | 'overdue' | 'today' | 'upcoming' | 'unscheduled';

function localDateKey(date: Date) {
  return [
    date.getFullYear(),
    String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0'),
    String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0'),
  ].join('-');
}

function activityDueBucket(
  dueDate: string | null,
  todayKey: string,
  nextWeekKey: string,
): ActivityDueBucket {
  if (!dueDate) return 'unscheduled';
  const dateKey = String(dueDate).slice(0, 10);
  if (dateKey < todayKey) return 'overdue';
  if (dateKey === todayKey) return 'today';
  if (dateKey <= nextWeekKey) return 'upcoming';
  return 'later';
}

function formatActivityDate(value: string | null) {
  if (!value) return 'No due date';
  const dateKey = String(value).slice(0, 10);
  const date = new Date(dateKey + 'T00:00:00');
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
    ? dateKey
    : date.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
}


function formatHistoryTimestamp(value: string) {
  const date = new Date(value);
  return Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
    ? value
    : date.toLocaleString(undefined, {
        day: 'numeric',
        month: 'short',
        year: 'numeric',
        hour: 'numeric',
        minute: '2-digit',
      });
}

  const [leadSearch, setLeadSearch] = useState('');

  const [bulkFollowUpAssignedUserId, setBulkFollowUpAssignedUserId] = useState('');
  const [bulkLeadMessage, setBulkLeadMessage] = useState('');

  const [opportunitySearch, setOpportunitySearch] = useState('');

  const [savedPipelineViews, setSavedPipelineViews] = useState<SalesPipelineSavedView[]>([]);

  const [opportunitySavedViewName, setOpportunitySavedViewName] = useState('');
  const [pipelineViewsLoading, setPipelineViewsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [pipelineViewsError, setPipelineViewsError] = useState('');
  const [leadAssignmentRules, setLeadAssignmentRules] = useState<SalesLeadAssignmentRule[]>([]);
  const [assignmentRulesLoading, setAssignmentRulesLoading] = useState(false);
  const [assignmentRulesError, setAssignmentRulesError] = useState('');
  const [assignmentRuleDraft, setAssignmentRuleDraft] = useState<LeadAssignmentRuleDraft>({

  const [opportunityDraft, setOpportunityDraft] = useState<OpportunityDraft>({

    expectedValue: '', currency: normalizedCurrency(defaultCurrency),
    expectedCloseDate: '', source: '', notes: '', salespersonUserId: '',
  });
  const [closingOpportunityId, setClosingOpportunityId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [closingOpportunityStageId, setClosingOpportunityStageId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [opportunityLossReason, setOpportunityLossReason] = useState('');
  const [expandedOpportunityHistoryId, setExpandedOpportunityHistoryId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [agendaSearch, setAgendaSearch] = useState('');
  const [agendaFilter, setAgendaFilter] = useState<ActivityAgendaFilter>('all');

  const [pendingLeadPayload, setPendingLeadPayload] = useState<CreateLeadPayload | null>(null);
  const createLeadFormRef = useRef<HTMLFormElement | null>(null);
  const [qualification, setQualification] = useState<QualificationDraft>({
    expectedValue: '',
    currency: normalizedCurrency(defaultCurrency),
    expectedCloseDate: '',
  });

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const query = selectedPipelineId
      ? '/api/apps/sales?pipeline=1&pipelineId=' + encodeURIComponent(selectedPipelineId)
      : '/api/apps/sales?pipeline=1';
    const response = await fetch(query, {
      credentials: 'same-origin',
      cache: 'no-store',
      headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },

      setSelectedPipelineId(body.pipeline.activePipelineId);
    }
  }, [selectedPipelineId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load().catch(caught => {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Could not load the Sales pipeline.');
    });
  }, [load]);

  const loadSavedPipelineViews = useCallback(async () => {
    setPipelineViewsLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/apps/sales?pipelineViews=1', {
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },

      const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as {
        savedPipelineViews?: SalesPipelineSavedView[];
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!response.ok || !Array.isArray(body.savedPipelineViews)) {
        throw new Error(body.error || 'Could not load saved pipeline views.');
      }
      setSavedPipelineViews(body.savedPipelineViews);
      setPipelineViewsError('');
    } catch (caught) {
      setPipelineViewsError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Could not load saved pipeline views.');
    } finally {
      setPipelineViewsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadSavedPipelineViews();
  }, [loadSavedPipelineViews]);

  const loadLeadAssignmentRules = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!canManagePipeline) {
      setLeadAssignmentRules([]);
      return;
    }
    setAssignmentRulesLoading(true);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/apps/sales?leadAssignmentRules=1', {
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
      });
      const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as {
        leadAssignmentRules?: SalesLeadAssignmentRule[];
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!response.ok || !Array.isArray(body.leadAssignmentRules)) {
        throw new Error(body.error || 'Could not load lead-routing rules.');
      }
      setLeadAssignmentRules(body.leadAssignmentRules);
      setAssignmentRulesError('');
    } catch (caught) {
      setAssignmentRulesError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Could not load lead-routing rules.');
    } finally {
      setAssignmentRulesLoading(false);
    }
  }, [canManagePipeline]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadLeadAssignmentRules();
  }, [loadLeadAssignmentRules]);

  const filteredLeads = data.leads.filter(lead => {
    const search = leadSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matchesStatus = leadStatusFilter === 'all' || lead.status === leadStatusFilter;
    const matchesScore = leadScoreFilter === 'all' || lead.lead_score_band === leadScoreFilter;
    const matchesSearch = !search || [
      lead.name, lead.lead_number, lead.company_name, lead.contact_name,
      lead.email, lead.phone, lead.source, lead.status, lead.lead_score, lead.lead_score_band,
      data.salespeople.find(person => person.id === lead.salesperson_user_id)?.name,
    ].some(value => String(value || '').toLowerCase().includes(search));
    return matchesStatus && matchesScore && matchesSearch;
  });

  function selectFilteredLeads() {
    setSelectedLeadIds(filteredLeads.filter(lead => lead.status !== 'converted').slice(0, 100).map(lead => lead.id));
    setBulkLeadMessage('');
  }

  function toggleLeadSelection(leadId: string, checked: boolean) {
    setSelectedLeadIds(current => {
      if (!checked) return current.filter(id => id !== leadId);
      if (current.includes(leadId) || current.length >= 100) return current;
      return [...current, leadId];
    });
    setBulkLeadMessage('');
  }

  const filteredOpportunities = data.opportunities.filter(opportunity => {
    const status = ['open', 'won', 'lost'].includes(opportunity.stage_type) ? opportunity.stage_type : 'open';
    const filter = opportunityStatusFilter === 'all' || status === opportunityStatusFilter;
    const search = opportunitySearch.trim().toLowerCase();
    const matchesSearch = !search || [
      opportunity.name, opportunity.opportunity_number, opportunity.customer_name,
      opportunity.contact_name, opportunity.email, opportunity.phone, opportunity.stage_name,
      opportunity.source, opportunity.notes,
      data.salespeople.find(person => person.id === opportunity.salesperson_user_id)?.name,
    ].some(value => String(value || '').toLowerCase().includes(search));
    return filter && matchesSearch;
  });

  const today = new Date();
  const todayKey = localDateKey(today);
  const nextWeekDate = new Date(today);
  nextWeekDate.setDate(nextWeekDate.getDate() + 7);
  const nextWeekKey = localDateKey(nextWeekDate);

  const plannedActivities = [
    ...data.activities
      .filter(activity => activity.status === 'planned')
      .map(activity => ({
        activity,
        recordType: 'lead' as const,
        recordId: activity.lead_id,
        recordNumber: activity.lead_number,
        recordName: activity.lead_name,
        recordCompanyName: activity.lead_company_name,
        recordContactName: activity.lead_contact_name,
        dueBucket: activityDueBucket(activity.due_date, todayKey, nextWeekKey),
        ownerName: data.salespeople.find(person => person.id === activity.assigned_user_id)?.name || 'Unassigned',
      })),
    ...data.opportunityActivities
      .filter(activity => activity.status === 'planned')
      .map(activity => ({
        activity,
        recordType: 'opportunity' as const,
        recordId: activity.opportunity_id,
        recordNumber: activity.opportunity_number,
        recordName: activity.opportunity_name,
        recordCompanyName: activity.opportunity_customer_name,
        recordContactName: activity.opportunity_contact_name,
        dueBucket: activityDueBucket(activity.due_date, todayKey, nextWeekKey),
        ownerName: data.salespeople.find(person => person.id === activity.assigned_user_id)?.name || 'Unassigned',
      })),
  ];

  const agendaFilterOptions: { key: ActivityAgendaFilter; label: string; count: number }[] = [
    { key: 'all', label: 'All planned', count: plannedActivities.length },
    { key: 'overdue', label: 'Overdue', count: plannedActivities.filter(item => item.dueBucket === 'overdue').length },
    { key: 'today', label: 'Due today', count: plannedActivities.filter(item => item.dueBucket === 'today').length },
    { key: 'upcoming', label: 'Next 7 days', count: plannedActivities.filter(item => item.dueBucket === 'upcoming').length },
    { key: 'unscheduled', label: 'No due date', count: plannedActivities.filter(item => item.dueBucket === 'unscheduled').length },
  ];

  const filteredAgendaActivities = plannedActivities
    .filter(item => agendaFilter === 'all' || item.dueBucket === agendaFilter)
    .filter(({ activity, ownerName, recordName, recordNumber, recordCompanyName, recordContactName }) => {
      const search = agendaSearch.trim().toLowerCase();
      return !search || [
        activity.subject,
        activity.description,
        activity.activity_type,
        recordName,
        recordNumber,
        recordCompanyName,
        recordContactName,
        ownerName,
      ].some(value => String(value || '').toLowerCase().includes(search));
    })
    .sort((a, b) => {
      const aDate = a.activity.due_date ? String(a.activity.due_date).slice(0, 10) : '9999-12-31';
      const bDate = b.activity.due_date ? String(b.activity.due_date).slice(0, 10) : '9999-12-31';
      return aDate.localeCompare(bDate) || b.activity.created_at.localeCompare(a.activity.created_at);
    });

  async function action(payload: PipelineAction): Promise<boolean> {
    setBusy(true);
    setError('');
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/apps/sales', {
        method: 'POST',
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Accept: 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as {
        error?: string;
        code?: string;
        duplicates?: LeadDuplicateMatch[];
        result?: { updatedCount?: number; createdCount?: number; skippedCount?: number; mode?: string; pipelineId?: string; name?: string; stageCount?: number };
      };
      if (
        !response.ok &&
        payload.action === 'create_lead' &&
        body.code === 'LEAD_DUPLICATE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED' &&
        Array.isArray(body.duplicates)
      ) {
        setPendingLeadPayload(payload);
        setDuplicateCandidates(body.duplicates);
        setError('');
        return false;
      }
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(body.error || 'Sales action failed.');
      }
      if (payload.action === 'create_pipeline') {
        const createdPipelineId = body.result?.pipelineId;
        if (!createdPipelineId) {
          throw new Error('The pipeline was created but SaMi did not return its identifier. Refresh the workspace.');
        }
        setNewPipelineName('');
        setSelectedPipelineId(createdPipelineId);
      } else {
        await load();
      }
      if (payload.action === 'save_pipeline_view' || payload.action === 'delete_pipeline_view') {
        await loadSavedPipelineViews();
      }
      if (payload.action === 'save_lead_assignment_rule' || payload.action === 'delete_lead_assignment_rule') {
        await loadLeadAssignmentRules();
      }
      if (payload.action === 'create_lead') {
        setPendingLeadPayload(null);
        setDuplicateCandidates([]);
      }
      if (payload.action === 'bulk_reassign_leads') {
        const count = body.result?.updatedCount ?? payload.leadIds.length;
        const skipped = body.result?.skippedCount ?? 0;
        setBulkLeadMessage(`Reassigned ${count} lead${count === 1 ? '' : 's'} and recorded the handover reason in assignment history.${skipped ? ` ${skipped} unchanged lead${skipped === 1 ? '' : 's'} were skipped.` : ''}`);
        setSelectedLeadIds([]);
        setBulkLeadTeamId('');
        setBulkLeadSalespersonUserId('');
        setBulkLeadReason('');
      }
      if (payload.action === 'bulk_update_lead_status') {
        const count = body.result?.updatedCount ?? 0;
        const skipped = body.result?.skippedCount ?? 0;
        const verb = payload.mode === 'disqualify' ? 'Disqualified' : 'Reopened';
        setBulkLeadMessage(`${verb} ${count} lead${count === 1 ? '' : 's'} and recorded the reason in the activity history.${skipped ? ` ${skipped} lead${skipped === 1 ? '' : 's'} did not need that action and were skipped.` : ''}`);
        setSelectedLeadIds([]);
        setBulkLeadActionReason('');
      }
      if (payload.action === 'bulk_create_lead_activities') {
        const count = body.result?.createdCount ?? payload.leadIds.length;
        const skipped = body.result?.skippedCount ?? 0;
        setBulkLeadMessage(`Scheduled ${count} follow-up activit${count === 1 ? 'y' : 'ies'} across ${count} lead${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}.${skipped ? ` ${skipped} inactive lead${skipped === 1 ? '' : 's'} were skipped.` : ''}`);
        setSelectedLeadIds([]);
        setBulkFollowUpType('task');
        setBulkFollowUpSubject('');
        setBulkFollowUpDescription('');
        setBulkFollowUpDueDate('');
        setBulkFollowUpAssignedUserId('');
      }
      return true;
    } catch (caught) {
      setError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Sales action failed.');
      return false;
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  function beginLeadAssignmentRuleEdit(rule: SalesLeadAssignmentRule) {
    setAssignmentRuleDraft({
      ruleId: rule.id,
      name: rule.name,
      sourceMatch: rule.sourceMatch || '',
      salesTeamId: data.salesTeams.some(team => team.id === rule.salesTeamId) ? rule.salesTeamId : '',
      priority: String(rule.priority),
      isActive: rule.isActive,
    });
    setAssignmentRulesError('');
  }

  function resetLeadAssignmentRuleDraft() {
    setAssignmentRuleDraft({
      ruleId: null, name: '', sourceMatch: '', salesTeamId: '', priority: '100', isActive: true,
    });
    setAssignmentRulesError('');
  }

  async function saveLeadAssignmentRule(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setAssignmentRulesError('');
    if (!assignmentRuleDraft.name.trim()) {
      setAssignmentRulesError('Enter a name for this routing rule.');
      return;
    }
    if (!assignmentRuleDraft.salesTeamId) {
      setAssignmentRulesError('Choose a Sales team for this routing rule.');
      return;
    }
    const succeeded = await action({
      action: 'save_lead_assignment_rule',
      ruleId: assignmentRuleDraft.ruleId,
      name: assignmentRuleDraft.name.trim(),
      sourceMatch: assignmentRuleDraft.sourceMatch.trim() || null,
      salesTeamId: assignmentRuleDraft.salesTeamId,
      priority: Number(assignmentRuleDraft.priority),
      isActive: assignmentRuleDraft.isActive,
    });
    if (succeeded) resetLeadAssignmentRuleDraft();
  }

  async function deleteLeadAssignmentRule(rule: SalesLeadAssignmentRule) {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete routing rule "' + rule.name + '"? New leads will no longer route through it.')) return;
    setAssignmentRulesError('');
    await action({ action: 'delete_lead_assignment_rule', ruleId: rule.id });
    if (assignmentRuleDraft.ruleId === rule.id) resetLeadAssignmentRuleDraft();
  }

  async function savePipelineView(viewType: 'leads' | 'opportunities') {
    const isLeads = viewType === 'leads';
    const name = (isLeads ? leadSavedViewName : opportunitySavedViewName).trim();
    if (!name) {
      setPipelineViewsError('Enter a name before saving this view.');
      return;
    }
    const succeeded = await action({
      action: 'save_pipeline_view',
      name,
      viewType,
      statusView: isLeads ? leadStatusFilter : opportunityStatusFilter,
      scoreView: isLeads ? leadScoreFilter : 'all',
      searchQuery: isLeads ? leadSearch : opportunitySearch,
    });
    if (succeeded) {
      if (isLeads) setLeadSavedViewName('');
      else setOpportunitySavedViewName('');
      setPipelineViewsError('');
    }
  }

  function applySavedPipelineView(view: SalesPipelineSavedView) {
    if (view.viewType === 'leads') {
      setLeadSearch(view.searchQuery);
      setLeadStatusFilter(view.statusView);
      setLeadScoreFilter(view.scoreView || 'all');
    } else {
      setOpportunitySearch(view.searchQuery);
      setOpportunityStatusFilter(view.statusView as typeof opportunityStatusFilter);
    }
    setPipelineViewsError('');
  }

  async function deleteSavedPipelineView(view: SalesPipelineSavedView) {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete saved pipeline view "' + view.name + '"?')) return;
    const succeeded = await action({ action: 'delete_pipeline_view', viewId: view.id });
    if (succeeded) setPipelineViewsError('');
  }

  function beginQualification(leadId: string) {
    setQualifyingLeadId(leadId);
    setQualification({
      expectedValue: '',
      currency: normalizedCurrency(defaultCurrency),
      expectedCloseDate: '',
    });
    setError('');
  }

  async function qualifyLead(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>, lead: SalesLead) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const succeeded = await action({
      action: 'convert_lead',
      leadId: lead.id,
      pipelineId: selectedPipelineId || data.activePipelineId,
      name: lead.name,
      expectedValue: qualification.expectedValue,
      currency: normalizedCurrency(qualification.currency),
      expectedCloseDate: qualification.expectedCloseDate || null,
    });
    if (succeeded) {
      setQualifyingLeadId(null);
    }
  }

  async function createLead(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const form = event.currentTarget;
    const formData = new FormData(form);
    setDuplicateCandidates([]);
    setPendingLeadPayload(null);
    const payload: CreateLeadPayload = {
      action: 'create_lead',
      name: formData.get('name'),
      companyName: formData.get('companyName'),
      contactName: formData.get('contactName'),
      email: formData.get('email'),
      phone: formData.get('phone'),
      source: formData.get('source'),
      salesTeamId: formData.get('salesTeamId'),
      salespersonUserId: formData.get('salespersonUserId'),
    };
    const succeeded = await action(payload);
    if (succeeded) {
      form.reset();
      setCaptureLeadTeamId('');
    }
  }

  async function confirmCreateLeadWithDuplicates() {
    if (!pendingLeadPayload) return;
    const succeeded = await action({
      ...pendingLeadPayload,
      confirmDuplicates: true,
    });
    if (succeeded) {
      createLeadFormRef.current?.reset();
      setCaptureLeadTeamId('');
      setDuplicateCandidates([]);
      setPendingLeadPayload(null);
    }
  }

  function dismissDuplicateWarning() {
    setDuplicateCandidates([]);
    setPendingLeadPayload(null);
    setError('');
  }


  async function toggleLeadAssignmentHistory(leadId: string) {
    if (expandedLeadAssignmentHistoryId === leadId) {
      setExpandedLeadAssignmentHistoryId(null);
      setLeadAssignmentHistoryError('');
      return;
    }
    setExpandedLeadAssignmentHistoryId(leadId);
    setLeadAssignmentHistoryError('');
    setLeadAssignmentHistoryLoadingId(leadId);
    try {
      const response = await fetch('/api/apps/sales?leadAssignmentHistory=1&leadId=' + encodeURIComponent(leadId), {
        credentials: 'same-origin',
        cache: 'no-store',
        headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
      });
      const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as {
        leadAssignmentHistory?: SalesLeadAssignmentHistoryEntry[];
        error?: string;
      };
      if (!response.ok || !Array.isArray(body.leadAssignmentHistory)) {
        throw new Error(body.error || 'Could not load lead assignment history.');
      }
      setLeadAssignmentHistory(current => ({ ...current, [leadId]: body.leadAssignmentHistory! }));
    } catch (caught) {
      setLeadAssignmentHistoryError(caught instanceof Error ? caught.message : 'Could not load lead assignment history.');
    } finally {
      setLeadAssignmentHistoryLoadingId(current => current === leadId ? null : current);
    }
  }

  function beginLeadEdit(lead: SalesLead) {
    setEditingLeadId(lead.id);
    setQualifyingLeadId(null);
    setDisqualifyingLeadId(null);
    setActivityLeadId(null);
    setLeadDraft({
      name: lead.name || '',
      companyName: lead.company_name || '',
      contactName: lead.contact_name || '',
      email: lead.email || '',
      phone: lead.phone || '',
      source: lead.source || '',
      notes: lead.notes || '',
      salespersonUserId: lead.salesperson_user_id || '',
      salesTeamId: lead.sales_team_id || '',
      assignmentReason: '',
    });
    setError('');
  }

  async function updateLead(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>, lead: SalesLead) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const succeeded = await action({
      action: 'update_lead',
      leadId: lead.id,
      ...leadDraft,
      salespersonUserId: leadDraft.salespersonUserId || null,
      salesTeamId: leadDraft.salesTeamId || null,
      assignmentReason: leadDraft.assignmentReason,
    });
    if (succeeded) setEditingLeadId(null);
  }

  async function disqualifyLead(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>, lead: SalesLead) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const succeeded = await action({
      action: 'disqualify_lead',
      leadId: lead.id,
      reason: disqualificationReason,
    });
    if (succeeded) {
      setDisqualifyingLeadId(null);
      setDisqualificationReason('');
    }
  }

  function beginActivity(lead: SalesLead) {
    setActivityOpportunityId(null);
    setActivityLeadId(lead.id);
    setEditingLeadId(null);
    setQualifyingLeadId(null);
    setDisqualifyingLeadId(null);
    setActivityDraft({
      activityType: 'task',
      subject: '',
      description: '',
      dueDate: '',
      assignedUserId: lead.salesperson_user_id || '',
    });
    setError('');
  }

  function beginOpportunityActivity(opportunity: SalesOpportunity) {
    setActivityLeadId(null);
    setActivityOpportunityId(opportunity.id);
    setEditingOpportunityId(null);
    setActivityDraft({ activityType: 'task', subject: '', description: '', dueDate: '', assignedUserId: opportunity.salesperson_user_id || '' });
    setError('');
  }

  async function createOpportunityActivity(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>, opportunity: SalesOpportunity) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const succeeded = await action({
      action: 'create_opportunity_activity', opportunityId: opportunity.id,
      activityType: activityDraft.activityType, subject: activityDraft.subject,
      description: activityDraft.description, dueDate: activityDraft.dueDate || null,
      assignedUserId: activityDraft.assignedUserId || null,
    });
    if (succeeded) {
      setActivityOpportunityId(null);
      setActivityDraft({ activityType: 'task', subject: '', description: '', dueDate: '', assignedUserId: '' });
    }
  }

  async function createActivity(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>, lead: SalesLead) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const succeeded = await action({
      action: 'create_lead_activity',
      leadId: lead.id,
      activityType: activityDraft.activityType,
      subject: activityDraft.subject,
      description: activityDraft.description,
      dueDate: activityDraft.dueDate || null,
      assignedUserId: activityDraft.assignedUserId || null,
    });
    if (succeeded) {
      setActivityLeadId(null);
      setActivityDraft({ activityType: 'task', subject: '', description: '', dueDate: '', assignedUserId: '' });
    }
  }

  function beginActivityEdit(activity: ActivityRecord) {
    setEditingActivityId(activity.id);
    setEditingActivityRecordType('opportunity_id' in activity ? 'opportunity' : 'lead');
    setActivityEditDraft({
      activityType: activity.activity_type,
      subject: activity.subject || '',
      description: activity.description || '',
      dueDate: activity.due_date ? String(activity.due_date).slice(0, 10) : '',
      assignedUserId: activity.assigned_user_id || '',
    });
    setError('');
  }

  async function saveActivityEdit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>, activity: ActivityRecord) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const fields = {
      activityId: activity.id, activityType: activityEditDraft.activityType,
      subject: activityEditDraft.subject, description: activityEditDraft.description,
      dueDate: activityEditDraft.dueDate || null, assignedUserId: activityEditDraft.assignedUserId || null,
    };
    const succeeded = 'opportunity_id' in activity
      ? await action({ action: 'edit_opportunity_activity', ...fields })
      : await action({ action: 'edit_lead_activity', ...fields });
    if (succeeded) { setEditingActivityId(null); setEditingActivityRecordType(null); }
  }

  async function updateActivity(activity: string | ActivityRecord, status: 'completed' | 'cancelled') {
    if (typeof activity === 'string') await action({ action: 'update_lead_activity', activityId: activity, status });
    else if ('opportunity_id' in activity) await action({ action: 'update_opportunity_activity', activityId: activity.id, status });
    else await action({ action: 'update_lead_activity', activityId: activity.id, status });
  }

  function beginOpportunityEdit(opportunity: SalesOpportunity) {
    setEditingOpportunityId(opportunity.id);
    setClosingOpportunityId(null);
    setClosingOpportunityStageId(null);
    setOpportunityDraft({
      name: opportunity.name || '',
      customerName: opportunity.customer_name || '',
      contactName: opportunity.contact_name || '',
      email: opportunity.email || '',
      phone: opportunity.phone || '',
      expectedValue: String(opportunity.expected_value ?? 0),
      currency: normalizedCurrency(opportunity.currency || defaultCurrency),
      expectedCloseDate: opportunity.expected_close_date ? String(opportunity.expected_close_date).slice(0, 10) : '',
      source: opportunity.source || '',
      notes: opportunity.notes || '',
      salespersonUserId: opportunity.salesperson_user_id || '',
    });
    setError('');
  }

  async function saveOpportunityEdit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>, opportunity: SalesOpportunity) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const succeeded = await action({
      action: 'update_opportunity',
      opportunityId: opportunity.id,
      name: opportunityDraft.name,
      customerName: opportunityDraft.customerName,
      contactName: opportunityDraft.contactName,
      email: opportunityDraft.email,
      phone: opportunityDraft.phone,
      expectedValue: opportunityDraft.expectedValue,
      currency: normalizedCurrency(opportunityDraft.currency),
      expectedCloseDate: opportunityDraft.expectedCloseDate || null,
      source: opportunityDraft.source,
      notes: opportunityDraft.notes,
      salespersonUserId: opportunityDraft.salespersonUserId || null,
    });
    if (succeeded) setEditingOpportunityId(null);
  }

  function changeOpportunityStage(opportunityId: string, stageId: string) {
    const stage = data.stages.find(item => item.id === stageId);
    if (!stage) return;
    if (stage.stage_type === 'lost') {
      setClosingOpportunityId(opportunityId);
      setClosingOpportunityStageId(stageId);
      setOpportunityLossReason('');
      setEditingOpportunityId(null);
      setError('');
      return;
    }
    void action({ action: 'move_opportunity', opportunityId, stageId });
    setClosingOpportunityId(null);
    setClosingOpportunityStageId(null);
    setOpportunityLossReason('');
  }

  function beginOpportunityLoss(opportunity: SalesOpportunity) {
    const lostStage = data.stages.find(stage => stage.stage_type === 'lost');
    if (!lostStage) {
      setError('A Lost pipeline stage is not configured. Refresh the Sales workspace and try again.');
      return;
    }
    setClosingOpportunityId(opportunity.id);
    setClosingOpportunityStageId(lostStage.id);
    setOpportunityLossReason('');
    setEditingOpportunityId(null);
    setError('');
  }

  async function confirmOpportunityLost(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>, opportunity: SalesOpportunity) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!closingOpportunityStageId || !opportunityLossReason.trim()) return;
    const succeeded = await action({
      action: 'move_opportunity',
      opportunityId: opportunity.id,
      stageId: closingOpportunityStageId,
      reason: opportunityLossReason.trim(),
    });
    if (succeeded) {
      setClosingOpportunityId(null);
      setClosingOpportunityStageId(null);
      setOpportunityLossReason('');
    }
  }

  async function markOpportunityWon(opportunity: SalesOpportunity) {
    const wonStage = data.stages.find(stage => stage.stage_type === 'won');
    if (!wonStage) {
      setError('A Won pipeline stage is not configured. Refresh the Sales workspace and try again.');
      return;
    }
    await action({
      action: 'move_opportunity',
      opportunityId: opportunity.id,
      stageId: wonStage.id,
      reason: 'Marked won',
    });
    setClosingOpportunityId(null);
    setClosingOpportunityStageId(null);
    setOpportunityLossReason('');
  }

  async function reopenOpportunity(opportunity: SalesOpportunity) {
    const openStage = data.stages.find(stage => stage.stage_type === 'open');
    if (!openStage) {
      setError('An active pipeline stage is not configured. Refresh the Sales workspace and try again.');
      return;
    }
    await action({
      action: 'move_opportunity',
      opportunityId: opportunity.id,
      stageId: openStage.id,
      reason: 'Reopened opportunity',
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <header className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-5">
        <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-slate-400">
          Roadmap Part 11
        </p>
        <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-black">Leads &amp; Opportunities</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
          Qualify prospects with realistic deal value and expected close dates, then create a quotation without losing customer context.
          Leads are shared; opportunities, stages and outcomes are scoped to the selected pipeline.
        </p>
        <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,1.5fr)]">
          <label className="space-y-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
            <span>Opportunity pipeline</span>
            <select
              aria-label="Opportunity pipeline"
              value={selectedPipelineId || data.activePipelineId}
              onChange={event => {
                setError('');
                setSelectedPipelineId(event.target.value);
              }}
              disabled={busy || data.pipelines.length === 0}
              className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-normal text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {data.pipelines.map(pipeline => (
                <option key={pipeline.id} value={pipeline.id}>
                  {pipeline.name}{pipeline.is_default ? ' · Default' : ''}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          {canManagePipeline ? (
            <form
              onSubmit={event => {
                event.preventDefault();
                if (!newPipelineName.trim() || busy) return;
                void action({ action: 'create_pipeline', name: newPipelineName.trim() });
              }}
              className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-end"
            >
              <label className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
                <span>Create a separate pipeline</span>
                <input
                  value={newPipelineName}
                  onChange={event => setNewPipelineName(event.target.value)}
                  maxLength={120}
                  placeholder="e.g. Enterprise Sales"
                  aria-label="New sales pipeline name"
                  className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-normal text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100"
                />
              </label>
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={busy || !newPipelineName.trim()}
                className="h-10 shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                Create pipeline
              </button>
            </form>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </header>

      {error ? (
        <div role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 p-3 text-sm text-red-600">
          {error}
        </div>
      ) : null}

      {canManagePipeline ? (
        <>
        <section className="sami-surface mb-4 rounded-[24px] p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <h3 className="font-black">Automatic lead-routing rules</h3>
              <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-xs text-slate-500">
                Route new leads to teams from their source. Rules run by ascending priority; a blank source match is the fallback rule.
                Choosing a team or salesperson during lead capture overrides automatic routing.
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="rounded-full border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500">
              {leadAssignmentRules.filter(rule => rule.isActive && data.salesTeams.some(team => team.id === rule.salesTeamId)).length} active rules
            </span>
          </div>
          {assignmentRulesLoading ? (
            <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">Loading lead-routing rules…</p>
          ) : leadAssignmentRules.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 text-xs text-slate-500">
              No routing rules yet. Add a source-specific rule or a blank-source fallback.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
              {leadAssignmentRules.map(rule => {
                const teamIsActive = data.salesTeams.some(team => team.id === rule.salesTeamId);
                return (
                  <article key={rule.id} className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <p className="break-words text-sm font-black">{rule.name}</p>
                        <span className="rounded-full border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500">Priority {rule.priority}</span>
                        <span className={rule.isActive && teamIsActive ? 'rounded-full bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300' : 'rounded-full bg-slate-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500'}>
                          {rule.isActive && teamIsActive ? 'Active' : rule.isActive ? 'Team unavailable' : 'Paused'}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                        Source: {rule.sourceMatch || 'Any source (fallback)'} · Team: {rule.salesTeamName || 'Unavailable team'}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-3 text-xs font-black">
                      <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => beginLeadAssignmentRuleEdit(rule)} className="text-slate-600 hover:underline disabled:opacity-50 dark:text-slate-300">Edit</button>
                      <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => void deleteLeadAssignmentRule(rule)} className="text-rose-600 hover:underline disabled:opacity-50">Delete</button>
                    </div>
                  </article>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
          {assignmentRulesError ? <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-xs text-rose-600">{assignmentRulesError}</p> : null}
          <form onSubmit={event => void saveLeadAssignmentRule(event)} className="mt-4 grid gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
            <h4 className="text-sm font-black sm:col-span-2 xl:col-span-3">{assignmentRuleDraft.ruleId ? 'Edit lead-routing rule' : 'Add lead-routing rule'}</h4>
            <label className="space-y-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
              <span>Rule name *</span>
              <input required maxLength={80} value={assignmentRuleDraft.name} onChange={event => setAssignmentRuleDraft(current => ({ ...current, name: event.target.value }))} placeholder="Website enquiries to retail team" className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-normal text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100" />
            </label>
            <label className="space-y-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
              <span>Lead source contains</span>
              <input maxLength={120} value={assignmentRuleDraft.sourceMatch} onChange={event => setAssignmentRuleDraft(current => ({ ...current, sourceMatch: event.target.value }))} placeholder="website demo, referral, event…" className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-normal text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100" />
              <span className="block font-normal">Leave blank to catch any source.</span>
            </label>
            <label className="space-y-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
              <span>Route to Sales team *</span>
              <select required value={assignmentRuleDraft.salesTeamId} onChange={event => setAssignmentRuleDraft(current => ({ ...current, salesTeamId: event.target.value }))} className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-normal text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
                <option value="">Choose a team</option>
                {data.salesTeams.map(team => <option key={team.id} value={team.id}>{team.name}</option>)}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label className="space-y-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
              <span>Priority (lower runs first) *</span>
              <input type="number" required min={1} max={10000} step={1} value={assignmentRuleDraft.priority} onChange={event => setAssignmentRuleDraft(current => ({ ...current, priority: event.target.value }))} className="h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-normal text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100" />
            </label>
            <label className="flex items-center gap-2 self-end pb-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
              <input type="checkbox" checked={assignmentRuleDraft.isActive} onChange={event => setAssignmentRuleDraft(current => ({ ...current, isActive: event.target.checked }))} />
              Rule enabled
            </label>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2">
              <button type="submit" disabled={busy || !assignmentRuleDraft.name.trim() || !assignmentRuleDraft.salesTeamId} className="h-10 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 font-black disabled:opacity-50">
                {busy ? 'Saving…' : assignmentRuleDraft.ruleId ? 'Update rule' : 'Save rule'}
              </button>
              {assignmentRuleDraft.ruleId ? <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={resetLeadAssignmentRuleDraft} className="h-10 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 font-black disabled:opacity-50">Cancel edit</button> : null}
            </div>
          </form>
        </section>
        <form
          ref={createLeadFormRef}
          className="sami-surface grid gap-3 rounded-[24px] p-5 md:grid-cols-2"
          onSubmit={createLead}
        >
          <h3 className="font-black md:col-span-2">Capture lead</h3>
          {['name', 'companyName', 'contactName', 'email', 'phone', 'source'].map(field => (
            <label key={field} className="space-y-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
              <span>
                {field.replace(/[A-Z]/g, match => ' ' + match).replace(/^./, match => match.toUpperCase())}
                {field === 'name' ? ' (required)' : ''}
              </span>
              <input
                name={field}
                type={field === 'email' ? 'email' : 'text'}
                required={field === 'name'}
                autoComplete={field === 'email' ? 'email' : field === 'phone' ? 'tel' : 'off'}
                className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-normal text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100"
              />
            </label>
          ))}
          <label className="space-y-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
            <span>Route to Sales team</span>
            <select
              name="salesTeamId"
              value={captureLeadTeamId}
              onChange={event => setCaptureLeadTeamId(event.target.value)}
              className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-normal text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100"
            >
              <option value="">Use routing rules (no team override)</option>
              {data.salesTeams.map(team => <option key={team.id} value={team.id}>{team.name}</option>)}
            </select>
            {captureLeadTeamId ? <p className="text-[11px] font-normal">This team overrides routing rules. Leave the salesperson blank to assign to the least-loaded active team member.</p> : <p className="text-[11px] font-normal">Active source rules can choose a team automatically; if none match, the lead remains unassigned.</p>}
          </label>
          <label className="space-y-1 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500">
            <span>Assigned salesperson (optional)</span>
            <select
              key={captureLeadTeamId}
              name="salespersonUserId"
              defaultValue=""
              className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm font-normal text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100"
            >
              <option value="">{captureLeadTeamId ? 'Auto-assign using team workload' : 'Auto-assign if a rule matches'}</option>
              {data.salespeople
                .filter(person => !captureLeadTeamId || Boolean(data.salesTeams.find(team => team.id === captureLeadTeamId)?.member_user_ids.includes(person.id)))
                .map(person => <option key={person.id} value={person.id}>{person.name} · {person.email}</option>)}
            </select>
            {captureLeadTeamId && !data.salespeople.some(person => data.salesTeams.find(team => team.id === captureLeadTeamId)?.member_user_ids.includes(person.id)) ? <p role="alert" className="text-[11px] font-normal text-rose-600">This team has no active eligible members. Add an active member before routing leads.</p> : null}
          </label>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={busy}
            className="h-11 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-4 text-sm font-black disabled:opacity-60 md:col-span-2"
          >
            {busy ? 'Saving…' : 'Create lead'}
          </button>
        </form>
        {pendingLeadPayload && duplicateCandidates.length > 0 ? (
          <section
            aria-live="polite"
            className="mt-4 rounded-[24px] border border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/[0.06] p-5"
          >
            <h4 className="font-black">Possible duplicate leads</h4>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
              These existing leads share the submitted email or phone. Review them before continuing.
              Creating anyway will keep a separate lead record.
            </p>
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
              {duplicateCandidates.map(candidate => (
                <article key={candidate.id} className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-white/60 p-3 dark:bg-slate-950/30">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <p className="break-words text-sm font-black">{candidate.name}</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                        {candidate.lead_number} · {candidate.status}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-1 break-words text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                        {[candidate.company_name, candidate.contact_name, candidate.email, candidate.phone]
                          .filter(Boolean)
                          .join(' · ') || 'No additional contact details'}
                      </p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                        Match: {candidate.match_reason === 'email_and_phone'
                          ? 'Email and phone'
                          : candidate.match_reason === 'email'
