                      return Boolean(
                        result,
                      );
                    }
                  }
                />
              )
            }

            {
              quote.optionalItems
                .length >
                0 &&
              (
                <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
                        Upsell
                      </p>
                      <h2 className="mt-1 text-sm font-black">
                        Optional products
                      </h2>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-black text-slate-500">
                      {
                        quote.optionalItems.length
                      }
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                    {
                      quote.optionalItems.map(
                        item => (
                          <div
                            key={
                              item.id
                            }
                            className="flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between"
                          >
                            <div>
                              <p className="text-xs font-black">
                                {
                                  item.description
                                }
                              </p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                                {
                                  item.quantity
                                } {
                                  item.unit
                                } · {
                                  money(
                                    item.unitPrice,
                                    quote.currency,
                                  )
                                }
                              </p>
                            </div>
                            <Badge
                              value={
                                item.isSelected
                                  ? 'selected'
                                  : 'optional'
                              }
                            />
                          </div>
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  </div>
                </div>
              )
            }

            {quote.acceptedAt && (
              <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-black">Customer acceptance evidence</h2>
                <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">Accepted by</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold">{quote.acceptedByName || 'Name not recorded'}</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">Accepted at</p>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-sm font-semibold">{new Date(quote.acceptedAt).toLocaleString()}</p>
                  </div>
                  {quote.acceptedByEmail && (
                    <div><p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">Signer email</p><p className="mt-1 break-words text-sm">{quote.acceptedByEmail}</p></div>
                  )}
                  {quote.acceptanceNote && (
                    <div><p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">Acceptance note</p><p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm">{quote.acceptanceNote}</p></div>
                  )}
                </div>
                {quote.acceptedSignatureConsentText && (
                  <div className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3">
                    <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">Electronic signature consent recorded</p>
                    <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6">{quote.acceptedSignatureConsentText}</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {quote.customerRevisionRequests.length > 0 && (
              <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
                <h2 className="text-sm font-black">Customer change requests</h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">These customer requests are part of the quotation activity trail; they do not change the quotation or approval status by themselves.</p>
                <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                  {quote.customerRevisionRequests.map(request => (
                    <div key={request.id} className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <p className="text-xs font-black">{request.requesterName || 'Customer'}</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">{new Date(request.createdAt).toLocaleString()}</p>
                      </div>
                      {request.requesterEmail && <p className="mt-1 break-words text-xs text-slate-500">{request.requesterEmail}</p>}
                      <p className="mt-2 whitespace-pre-wrap text-sm leading-6">{request.reason}</p>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {
              quote.revisions
                .length >
                0 &&
              (
                <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                    Revision history
                  </h2>
                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                    {
                      quote.revisions.map(
                        revision => (
                          <div
                            key={
                              revision.id
                            }
                            className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3"
                          >
                            <p className="text-xs font-black">
                              Revision {
                                revision.revisionNumber
                              }
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                              {
                                revision.createdAt
                              }
                              {
                                revision.reason
                                  ? ' · ' +
                                    revision.reason
                                  : ''
                              }
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  </div>
                </div>
              )
            }

            <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                Lifecycle history
              </h2>

              <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                {
                  quote.history.length ===
                    0
                    ? (
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                          No lifecycle changes recorded yet.
                        </p>
                      )
                    : quote.history.map(
                        item => (
                          <div
                            key={
                              item.id
                            }
                            className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] pb-3 last:border-0 last:pb-0"
                          >
                            <p className="text-xs font-black">
                              {
                                item.fromStatus
                                  ? item.fromStatus +
                                    ' → '
                                  : ''
                              }
                              {
                                item.toStatus
                              }
                            </p>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                              {
                                item.createdAt
                              }
                              {
                                item.reason
                                  ? ' · ' +
                                    item.reason
                                  : ''
                              }
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        ),
                      )
                }
              </div>
            </div>

            {
              quote.acceptedAt &&
              (
                <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
                  <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-300">
                        Customer acceptance
                      </p>
                      <h2 className="mt-1 text-sm font-black">
                        Signed commercial commitment
                      </h2>
                    </div>
                    <Check className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-600" />
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <TextCard
                      title="Accepted by"
                      value={
                        quote.acceptedByName
                      }
                    />
                    <TextCard
                      title="Signer email"
                      value={
                        quote.acceptedByEmail
                      }
                    />
                  </div>

                  <p className="mt-3 text-[11px] leading-5 text-slate-500">
                    Accepted {
                      quote.acceptedAt
                    }. This evidence is stored with the quotation lifecycle and remains available after conversion.
                  </p>

                  {
                    quote.acceptanceNote &&
                    (
                      <div className="mt-3">
                        <TextCard
                          title="Acceptance note"
                          value={
                            quote.acceptanceNote
                          }
                        />
                      </div>
                    )
                  }
                </div>
              )
            }

            <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4" aria-labelledby="quote-activity-heading">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                <div>
                  <h2 id="quote-activity-heading" className="text-sm font-black">Quote activity</h2>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">A single chronological view of lifecycle changes, revisions, customer requests and delivery attempts.</p>
                </div>
                <span className="rounded-full border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold">{quoteActivity.length} events</span>
              </div>
              <ol className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                {quoteActivity.slice(0, 10).map((event, index) => (
                  <li key={event.id} className="relative pl-5">
                    {index < Math.min(quoteActivity.length, 10) - 1 && <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute left-[5px] top-3 h-[calc(100%+8px)] w-px bg-[var(--sami-border)]" />}
                    <span aria-hidden="true" className="absolute left-0 top-1.5 h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-600 ring-4 ring-blue-500/10" />
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">{event.kind}</p>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs font-bold">{event.title}</p>
                        {event.detail && <p className="mt-1 whitespace-pre-wrap break-words text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">{event.detail}</p>}
                      </div>
                      <time dateTime={event.at} className="shrink-0 text-[10px] text-slate-500">{new Date(event.at).toLocaleString()}</time>
                    </div>
                  </li>
                ))}
                {quoteActivity.length === 0 && <li className="text-xs text-slate-500">No quotation activity has been recorded yet.</li>}
              </ol>
              {quoteActivity.length > 10 && <p className="mt-3 border-t border-[var(--sami-border)] pt-3 text-[10px] text-slate-500">Showing the 10 most recent events. Detailed records remain available in the sections above.</p>}
            </section>

            <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                Delivery log
              </h2>
              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
                {
                  quote.deliveries.length ===
                    0
                    ? (
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                          This quotation has not been delivered yet.
                        </p>
                      )
                    : quote.deliveries.map(
                        delivery => (
                          <div
                            key={
                              delivery.id
                            }
                            className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3"
                          >
                            <div>
                              <p className="text-xs font-black capitalize">
                                {
                                  delivery.channel
                                }
                              </p>
                              <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                                {
                                  delivery.provider ||
                                  'provider'
                                }
                                {' · '}
                                {
                                  delivery.createdAt
                                }
                              </p>
                            </div>
                            <Badge
                              value={
                                delivery.status
                              }
                            />
                          </div>
                        ),
                      )
                }
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <aside className="space-y-4">
            <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
              <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                Commercial summary
              </h2>
              <div className="mt-3 space-y-2 text-sm">
                <Summary
                  label="Subtotal"
                  value={
                    money(
                      quote.subtotal,
                      quote.currency,
                    )
                  }
                />
                <Summary
                  label="Discount"
                  value={
                    '− ' +
                    money(
                      quote.discountTotal,
                      quote.currency,
                    )
                  }
                />
                <Summary
                  label="Tax"
                  value={
                    money(
                      quote.taxTotal,
                      quote.currency,
                    )
                  }
                />
                <Summary
                  label="Shipping"
                  value={
                    money(
                      quote.shippingTotal,
                      quote.currency,
                    )
                  }
                />
                <Summary
                  label="Deposit / advance"
                  value={
                    quote.depositRequiredAmount > 0
                      ? money(quote.depositRequiredAmount, quote.currency)
                      : 'None required'
                  }
                />
                {
                  workspace
                    .capabilities
                    .canViewMargin &&
                  quote.marginAmount !==
                    null &&
                  (
                    <>
                      <Summary
                        label="Margin"
                        value={
                          money(
                            quote.marginAmount,
                            quote.currency,
                          )
                        }
                      />
                      <Summary
                        label="Margin %"
                        value={
                          (
                            quote.marginPercent ||
                            0
                          ).toFixed(
                            1,
                          ) +
                          '%'
                        }
                      />
                    </>
                  )
                }

                <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-t border-[var(--sami-border)] pt-3">
                  <span className="font-black">
                    Total
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-lg font-black text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300">
                    {
                      money(
                        quote.totalAmount,
                        quote.currency,
                      )
                    }
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {
              ['draft', 'not_required', 'rejected'].includes(
                quote.approvalStatus,
              ) &&
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canEdit &&
              (
                <ActionCard
                  title="Internal approval"
                  text="Submit this draft for the company Sales approval policy."
                >
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={
                      isBusy
                    }
                    onClick={
                      () =>
                        void run(
                          {
                            action:
                              'request_quote_approval',
                            quoteId:
                              quote.id,
                          },
                          'Quotation submitted for internal approval.',
                        )
                    }
                    className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    Request approval
                  </button>
                </ActionCard>
              )
            }

            {
              quote.approvalStatus ===
                'pending' &&
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canApproveInternally &&
              (
                <form
                  className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
                  onSubmit={
                    async event => {
                      event.preventDefault();

                      const form =
                        new FormData(
                          event.currentTarget,
                        );

                      await run(
                        {
                          action:
                            'review_quote_approval',
                          quoteId:
                            quote.id,
                          decision:
                            form.get(
                              'decision',
                            ),
                          reason:
                            form.get(
                              'reason',
                            ),
                        },
                        'Quotation approval decision recorded.',
                      );
                    }
                  }
                >
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                    Review approval
                  </h2>
                  <select
                    name="decision"
                    className="mt-3 h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
                  >
                    <option value="approve">
                      Approve
                    </option>
                    <option value="reject">
                      Reject
                    </option>
                  </select>
                  <textarea
                    name="reason"
                    rows={
                      3
                    }
                    placeholder="Reason for rejection when applicable"
                    className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={
                      isBusy
                    }
                    className="mt-2 h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    Submit decision
                  </button>
                </form>
              )
            }

            {
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canSend &&
              [
                'draft',
                'sent',
                'viewed',
              ].includes(
                quote.status,
              ) &&
              ![
                'draft',
                'pending',
                'rejected',
              ].includes(
                quote.approvalStatus,
              ) &&
              (
                <form
                  className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
                  onSubmit={
                    async event => {
                      event.preventDefault();

                      const form =
                        new FormData(
                          event.currentTarget,
                        );

                      const channels =
                        [
                          'email',
                          'whatsapp',
                          'sms',
                        ]
                          .filter(
                            channel =>
                              form.get(
                                channel,
                              ) ===
                                'on',
                          );

                      await run(
                        {
                          action:
                            'send_quote',
                          quoteId:
                            quote.id,
                          channels,
                        },
                        'Quotation delivery completed.',
                      );
                    }
                  }
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Send className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
                    <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                      Deliver quotation
                    </h2>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-3 grid gap-2">
                    {
                      [
                        'email',
                        'whatsapp',
                        'sms',
                      ].map(
                        channel => (
                          <label
                            key={
                              channel
                            }
                            className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3 text-xs font-bold capitalize"
                          >
                            <input
                              name={
                                channel
                              }
                              type="checkbox"
                              defaultChecked={
                                channel ===
                                  'email'
                              }
                            />
                            {
                              channel
                            }
                          </label>
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  </div>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={
                      isBusy
                    }
                    className="mt-3 h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    Send securely
                  </button>
                </form>
              )
            }

            {
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canApprove &&
              [
                'draft',
                'sent',
                'viewed',
              ].includes(
                quote.status,
              ) &&
              (
                <form
                  className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
                  onSubmit={
                    async event => {
                      event.preventDefault();

                      const form =
                        new FormData(
                          event.currentTarget,
                        );

                      await run(
                        {
                          action:
                            'change_quote_status',
                          quoteId:
                            quote.id,
                          status:
                            form.get(
                              'status',
                            ),
                          reason:
                            form.get(
                              'reason',
                            ),
                        },
                        'Customer response recorded.',
                      );
                    }
                  }
                >
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
                    Record customer response
                  </h2>
                  <select
                    name="status"
                    className="mt-3 h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
                  >
                    <option value="accepted">
                      Accepted
                    </option>
                    <option value="rejected">
                      Rejected
                    </option>
                  </select>
                  <textarea
                    name="reason"
                    rows={
                      3
                    }
                    placeholder="Reason / note"
                    className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={
                      isBusy
                    }
                    className="mt-2 h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] text-xs font-black disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    Save response
                  </button>
                </form>
              )
            }

            {
              quote.status ===
                'accepted' &&
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canConvert &&
              !quote.salesOrderId &&
              (
                <ActionCard
                  title="Convert accepted business"
                  text="Create a sales order, or create a draft invoice through the locked Invoicing workflow."
                >
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={
                      isBusy
                    }
                    onClick={
                      () =>
                        void run(
                          {
                            action:
                              'quote_to_order',
                            quoteId:
                              quote.id,
                          },
                          'Sales order created from the accepted quotation.',
                        )
                    }
                    className="inline-flex h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    <ShoppingCart className="h-4 w-4" />
                    Create sales order
                  </button>

                  <form
                    className="mt-2 space-y-2"
                    onSubmit={
                      event => {
                        event.preventDefault();

                        const form =
                          new FormData(
                            event.currentTarget,
                          );

                        confirmAction({
                          title:
                            'Create draft invoice?',
                          message:
                            'SaMi will create or reuse the sales order, then hand invoice creation to the locked Invoicing service.',
                          confirmLabel:
                            'Create invoice',
                          onConfirm:
                            () => {
                              void run(
                                {
                                  action:
                                    'quote_to_invoice',
                                  quoteId:
                                    quote.id,
                                  exchangeRate:
                                    quote.currency ===
                                      workspace.company.currency
                                      ? 1
                                      : Number(
                                          form.get(
                                            'exchangeRate',
                                          ) ||
                                          0,
                                        ),
                                },
                                'Draft invoice created.',
                              );
                            },
                        });
                      }
                    }
                  >
                    {
                      quote.currency !==
                        workspace.company.currency &&
                      (
                        <label className="block rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
                            Exchange rate
                          </span>
                          <input
                            name="exchangeRate"
                            type="number"
                            min="0.00000001"
                            step="0.00000001"
                            required
                            placeholder={
                              '1 ' +
                              quote.currency +
                              ' in ' +
                              workspace.company.currency
                            }
                            className="mt-2 h-10 w-full rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
                          />
                        </label>
                      )
                    }

                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      disabled={
                        isBusy
                      }
                      className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] text-xs font-black disabled:opacity-60"
                    >
                      Create draft invoice
                    </button>
                  </form>
                </ActionCard>
              )
            }

            {
              quote.salesOrderId &&
              (
                <LinkCard
                  label="Sales order"
                  href={
                    '/apps/sales/orders/' +
                    quote.salesOrderId
                  }
                  value="Open converted order"
                />
              )
            }

            {
              quote.latestInvoiceId &&
              (
                <LinkCard
                  label="Latest invoice"
                  href={
                    '/apps/invoicing/' +
                    quote.latestInvoiceId
                  }
                  value="Open invoice"
                />
              )
            }

            {
              workspace
                .capabilities
                .canCancel &&
              !quote.salesOrderId &&
              [
                'draft',
                'sent',
                'viewed',
                'accepted',
              ].includes(
                quote.status,
              ) &&
              (
                <form
                  className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
                  onSubmit={
                    async event => {
                      event.preventDefault();

                      const form =
                        new FormData(
                          event.currentTarget,
                        );

                      await run(
                        {
                          action:
                            'change_quote_status',
                          quoteId:
                            quote.id,
                          status:
                            'cancelled',
                          reason:
                            form.get(
                              'reason',
                            ),
                        },
                        'Quotation cancelled.',
                      );
                    }
                  }
                >
                  <h2 className="text-sm font-black text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
                    Cancel quotation
                  </h2>
                  <textarea
                    name="reason"
                    required
                    rows={
                      3
                    }
                    placeholder="Cancellation reason"
                    className="mt-3 w-full rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={
                      isBusy
                    }
                    className="mt-2 inline-flex h-11 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 text-xs font-black text-red-700 disabled:opacity-60 dark:text-red-300"
                  >
                    <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                    Cancel quotation
                  </button>
                </form>
              )
            }
          </aside>
        </section>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}


function TextCard({
  title,
  value,
}: {
  title:

import {
  FileDown,
  FileText,
  LayoutTemplate,
} from 'lucide-react';

import {
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from 'react';

import type {
  SalesWorkspaceData,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';


export default function SalesQuotePdfBuilder({
  data,
  busy,
  request,
  showSuccess,
  showError,
}: {
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData;
  busy:
    boolean;
  request:
    (
      payload:
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >,
    ) =>
      Promise<
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >
      >;
  showSuccess:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  showError:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
}) {
  const initialQuote =
    data.quotes[0];

  const [
    quoteId,
    setQuoteId,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote?.id ||
      '',
    );

  const selectedQuote =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        data.quotes.find(
          quote =>
            quote.id ===
            quoteId,
        ) ||
        null,
      [
        data.quotes,
        quoteId,
      ],
    );

  const [
    templateId,
    setTemplateId,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.templateId ||
      data.templates.find(
        template =>
          template.isDefault,
      )?.id ||
      data.templates[0]
        ?.id ||
      '',
    );

  const selectedTemplate =
    data.templates.find(
      template =>
        template.id ===
        templateId,
    ) ||
    null;

  async function applyTemplate() {
    if (
      !selectedQuote ||
      !selectedTemplate
    ) {
      showError(
        'Choose quote and template',
        'Select both a quotation and a quotation template.',
      );
      return;
    }

    try {
      await request({
        action:
          'apply_quote_template',
        quoteId:
          selectedQuote.id,
        templateId:
          selectedTemplate.id,
      });

      showSuccess(
        'Template applied',
        selectedTemplate.name +
          ' is now attached to ' +
          selectedQuote.quoteNumber +
          '.',
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        'Template could not be applied',
        error instanceof
          Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not apply this template.',
      );
    }
  }

  const primary =
    selectedTemplate
      ?.primaryColor ||
    data.settings
      .primaryColor;

  const secondary =
    selectedTemplate
      ?.secondaryColor ||
    data.settings
      .secondaryColor;

  return (
    <section className="space-y-4">
      <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
        <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-slate-500">
          Roadmap Part 6
        </p>
        <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-black">
          Quote / PDF Builder
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-slate-500">
          Select a quotation, apply a presentation template to a draft, inspect the document styling and open the same server-generated PDF that customers receive.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[0.75fr_1.25fr]">
        <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <LayoutTemplate
              className="h-4 w-4"
            />
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black">
              Document configuration
            </h3>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
            <label className="block">
              <span className="text-xs font-black">
                Quotation
              </span>
              <select
                value={
                  quoteId
                }
                onChange={
                  event => {
                    const next =
                      event.target.value;

                    setQuoteId(
                      next,
                    );

                    const quote =
                      data.quotes.find(
                        item =>
                          item.id ===
                          next,
                      );

                    if (
                      quote?.templateId
                    ) {
                      setTemplateId(
                        quote.templateId,
                      );
                    }
                  }
                }
                className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
              >
                {
                  data.quotes.length ===
                    0 &&
                  (
                    <option value="">
                      No quotations
                    </option>
                  )

                        }

                          quote.customerName
                        }
                      </option>
                    ),
                  )
                }
              </select>
            </label>

            <label className="block">
              <span className="text-xs font-black">

              <select

                className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
              >
                <option value="">
                  Choose template
                </option>
                {
                  data.templates.map(

                        }

                      >
                        {

                              ? ' · Default'
                              : ''
                          )

                    ),

                }
              </select>
            </label>

            <div className="grid gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                disabled={
                  busy ||
                  !selectedQuote ||
                  !selectedTemplate ||
                  selectedQuote.status !==
                    'draft' ||
                  !data.capabilities

                }
                onClick={
                  applyTemplate
                }
                className="h-10 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-50"

              {

                  >
                    <FileDown
                      className="h-4 w-4"
                    />
                    Open generated PDF

                )
              }
            </div>

            {

                'draft' &&
              (
                <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Sent or accepted quotations keep their locked commercial presentation. Revise the quotation first if a new template is required.

import type { SalesRepresentativePerformanceRow } from '@/lib/apps/sales/representative-performance';

function money(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return currency + ' ' + value.toLocaleString();
  }
}
function rate(value: number | null) {
  return value == null ? '—' : Math.round(value).toLocaleString() + '%';
}
function days(value: number | null) {
  return value == null ? '—' : Math.round(value).toLocaleString() + ' days';
}

export default function SalesRepresentativePerformance({ rows }: { rows: SalesRepresentativePerformanceRow[] }) {
  const currencies = Array.from(new Set(rows.map(row => row.currency)));
  return (
    <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
      <header>
        <h2 className="text-base font-black">Salesperson pipeline performance</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">Current open pipeline and overdue deals, plus win/loss outcomes recorded over the last 90 days. Currency totals remain separate.</p>
      </header>
      {!rows.length ? (
        <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-slate-500">No open opportunities or recorded wins/losses are available for this reporting period.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-6">
          {currencies.map(currency => {
            const items = rows.filter(row => row.currency === currency);
            return (
              <section key={currency} aria-label={currency + ' salesperson performance'}>
                <h3 className="mb-3 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">{currency}</h3>
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[1040px] text-left text-sm">
                    <thead><tr className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">Salesperson</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Open deals</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Open pipeline</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Weighted</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Overdue</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Won · 90d</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Won value · 90d</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Lost · 90d</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Win rate · 90d</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Avg. days to win</th>
                    </tr></thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                      {items.map((row, index) => <tr key={(row.representativeId ?? 'unassigned') + ':' + currency + ':' + index}>
                        <th scope="row" className="max-w-[200px] truncate px-3 py-3 font-bold">{row.representativeName}</th>
                        <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.openOpportunityCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{money(row.openPipelineValue, currency)}</td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold tabular-nums">{money(row.weightedPipelineValue, currency)}</td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums"><span className={row.overdueOpportunityCount > 0 ? 'font-black text-red-600' : ''}>{row.overdueOpportunityCount.toLocaleString()}</span></td>
                        <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.wonCount90Days.toLocaleString()}</td>

import type { SalesReturnFulfillmentQualityReport } from '@/lib/apps/sales/return-fulfillment-quality';

function money(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return currency + ' ' + value.toLocaleString();
  }
}

function quantity(value: number) {
  return value.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 4 });
}

function duration(value: number | null) {
  if (value == null) return '—';
  if (value < 24) return Math.round(value * 10) / 10 + ' h';
  const days = value / 24;
  return Math.round(days * 10) / 10 + ' d';
}

function statusLabel(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/_/g, ' ');
}

export default function SalesReturnFulfillmentQuality({ report }: { report: SalesReturnFulfillmentQualityReport }) {
  const currencies = Array.from(new Set(report.returnsByStatus.map(row => row.currency)));
  const reasonCurrencies = Array.from(new Set(report.returnReasons.map(row => row.currency)));

  return (
    <section className="space-y-5">
      <header>
        <h2 className="text-base font-black">Returns and delivery quality</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
          Return requests and shipments from the last 90 days. Return credits use the associated order currency. Shipment timing is based on recorded timestamps, not promised delivery dates.
        </p>
      </header>

      {!report.canViewShipping && !report.canViewReturns && (
        <p className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
          Your Sales Reports access does not include shipment or return reporting permissions.
        </p>
      )}

      {report.canViewShipping && (
        <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
          <h3 className="text-sm font-black">Shipment execution</h3>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">Dispatch and delivery duration excludes records with missing or invalid timestamps.</p>
          {report.shipmentsByStatus.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-slate-500">No shipments were created in the last 90 days.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full min-w-[760px] text-left text-sm">
                <thead><tr className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                  <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">Status</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Shipments</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Orders</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Units on shipments</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Avg. time to ship</th>
                  <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Avg. transit time</th>
                </tr></thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                  {report.shipmentsByStatus.map(row => (
                    <tr key={row.status}>
                      <th scope="row" className="px-3 py-3 font-bold capitalize">{statusLabel(row.status)}</th>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.shipmentCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.orderCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{quantity(row.itemQuantity)}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{duration(row.averageHoursToShip)}</td>
                      <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{duration(row.averageHoursToDeliver)}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      )}

      {report.canViewReturns && (
        <>
          <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black">Return lifecycle by status</h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">Cancelled sales orders are excluded; status counts retain cancelled returns. Credit, available credit, and refunds are kept separate by currency.</p>
            {report.returnsByStatus.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-slate-500">No returns were requested in the last 90 days.</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-5 space-y-6">
                {currencies.map(currency => {
                  const rows = report.returnsByStatus.filter(row => row.currency === currency);
                  return (
                    <section key={currency} aria-label={currency + ' return status'}>
                      <h4 className="mb-3 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">{currency}</h4>
                      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                        <table className="w-full min-w-[940px] text-left text-sm">
                          <thead><tr className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">Status</th>
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Returns</th>
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Orders</th>
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Units returned</th>
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Credit notes</th>
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Available credit</th>
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Refunded</th>
                          </tr></thead>
                          <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                            {rows.map(row => (

                                <th scope="row" className="px-3 py-3 font-bold capitalize">{statusLabel(row.status)}</th>

                                <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{money(row.creditAmount, currency)}</td>
                                <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{money(row.availableCredit, currency)}</td>

                              </tr>
                            ))}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      </div>
                    </section>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </section>

          <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black">Return reasons</h3>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">Recorded reasons can be free-form, so similar explanations may appear as separate rows.</p>
            {report.returnReasons.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-slate-500">No return reasons are available for this period.</p>
            ) : (
              <div className="mt-5 space-y-6">
                {reasonCurrencies.map(currency => {
                  const rows = report.returnReasons.filter(row => row.currency === currency);
                  return (
                    <section key={currency} aria-label={currency + ' return reasons'}>
                      <h4 className="mb-3 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">{currency}</h4>
                      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                        <table className="w-full min-w-[640px] text-left text-sm">
                          <thead><tr className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">Recorded reason</th>
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Returns</th>
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Units</th>
                            <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Credit notes</th>
                          </tr></thead>
                          <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                            {rows.map(row => (
                              <tr key={row.reason + ':' + currency}>
                                <th scope="row" className="max-w-[520px] truncate px-3 py-3 font-bold">{row.reason}</th>
                                <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.returnCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                                <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{quantity(row.itemQuantity)}</td>
                                <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{money(row.creditAmount, currency)}</td>
                              </tr>
                            ))}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      </div>
                    </section>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}
          </section>
        </>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

export function buildSalesSidebarItems(
  data:
    Awaited<
      ReturnType<
        typeof getSalesWorkspaceData
      >
    >,
) {
  const badges:
    Partial<
      Record<
        SalesRouteView,
        number
      >
    > = {
      quotes:
        data.quotes.length,
      orders:
        data.orders.length,
      customers:
        data.billingCustomers.length,
      templates:
        data.templates.length,
      catalogue:
        data.catalogItems.length,
      pricelists:
        data.pricelists.length,
    };

  return SALES_SIDEBAR_VIEWS
    .filter(
      view =>
        canAccessSalesView(
          data.capabilities,
          view,
        ),
    )
    .map(
      view => {
        const item =
          SALES_NAVIGATION[
            view
          ];

        return {
          key:
            view,
          label:
            item.label,
          href:
            item.href,
          description:
            item.description,
          sectionLabel:
            item.group,
          badge:
            badges[
              view
            ],
        };
      },
    );
}


export default async function SalesSectionPage({
  view,
}: {
  view:
    SalesRouteView;
}) {
  const currentPath =
    getSalesRoutePath(
      view,
    );

  const session =
    await requirePageSession(
      currentPath,
    );

  const [
    accountContext,
    permissionContext,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getAccountContextForUser(
        session.user.id,
        session.currentTenantId,
      ),
      getPermissionContext(),
    ]);

  const shell =
    resolveWorkspaceShellAccess({
      modules:
        accountContext.modules,
      subscription:
        accountContext.subscription,
      permissions:
        permissionContext,
    });

  if (
    !shell
      .accessibleModuleKeys
      .includes(
        'sales',
      )
  ) {
    notFound();
  }

  const [
    data,
    notificationResult,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getSalesWorkspaceData(),

      getWorkspaceNotificationSummary()
        .catch(
          () => null,
        ),
    ]);

  if (
    !canAccessSalesView(
      data.capabilities,
      view,
    )
  ) {
    notFound();
  }

  const reportsAvailable = view === 'reports' && data.capabilities.canViewReports;
  const reportData = reportsAvailable
    ? await Promise.all([
        getSalesManagementInsights(),
        getSalesOpportunityFunnelData(),
        getSalesOpportunityRiskQueue(),
        getSalesPipelineOutcomeReport(),
        getSalesPipelineVelocityReport(),
        getSalesActivityExecutionReport(),
        getSalesRepresentativePerformance(),
        getSalesLeadSourceEffectiveness(),
        getSalesCommissionPerformance(),
        getSalesProductPerformance(),
        getSalesReturnFulfillmentQualityReport(),
        getSalesTargetAttainmentReport(),
        getSalesQuotationEffectivenessReport(),
        getSalesCommercialMarginQualityReport(),
      ])
    : null;
  const managementInsights = reportData?.[0] ?? null;
  const opportunityFunnel = reportData?.[1] ?? null;
  const opportunityRiskQueue = reportData?.[2] ?? null;
  const pipelineOutcomeReport = reportData?.[3] ?? null;
  const pipelineVelocityReport = reportData?.[4] ?? null;
  const activityExecutionReport = reportData?.[5] ?? null;
  const representativePerformance = reportData?.[6] ?? null;
  const leadSourceEffectiveness = reportData?.[7] ?? null;
  const commissionPerformance = reportData?.[8] ?? null;
  const productPerformance = reportData?.[9] ?? null;
  const returnFulfillmentQuality = reportData?.[10] ?? null;
  const targetAttainmentReport = reportData?.[11] ?? null;
  const quotationEffectiveness = reportData?.[12] ?? null;
  const commercialMarginQuality = reportData?.[13] ?? null;

  return (
    <SalesModuleShell
      user={
        session.user
      }
      tenant={
        accountContext.tenant
      }
      modules={
        shell.accessibleModules
      }
      appSidebarItems={
        buildSalesSidebarItems(
          data,
        )
      }
      activeSidebarKey={
        getSalesParentView(
          view,
        )
      }
      sidebarCapabilities={{
        aiEnabled:
          shell.aiAvailable,

        notificationsEnabled:
          permissionContext
            .permissionSet
            .has(
              SAMI_PERMISSIONS
                .NOTIFICATIONS_VIEW,
            ),
      }}
      unreadNotifications={
        notificationResult
          ?.unreadCount ||
        0
      }
      companyName={
        data.company.name
      }
    >
      {view === 'approvals' ? (
        <SalesApprovalsManager />
      ) : managementInsights && opportunityFunnel && opportunityRiskQueue && pipelineOutcomeReport && pipelineVelocityReport && activityExecutionReport && representativePerformance && leadSourceEffectiveness && commissionPerformance && productPerformance && returnFulfillmentQuality && targetAttainmentReport && quotationEffectiveness && commercialMarginQuality ? (
        <>
          <SalesManagementInsights
            data={managementInsights}
            currency={data.company.currency}
            metrics={{
              quoteCount: data.metrics.quoteCount,
              acceptedCount: data.metrics.acceptedCount,
              convertedCount: data.metrics.convertedCount,
            }}
          />
          <SalesOpportunityFunnel rows={opportunityFunnel} riskRows={opportunityRiskQueue} />
          <SalesPipelineOutcomes
            summaries={pipelineOutcomeReport.summaries}
            lossReasons={pipelineOutcomeReport.lossReasons}
          />
          <SalesPipelineVelocity transitions={pipelineVelocityReport.transitions} />
          <SalesActivityExecution report={activityExecutionReport} />
          <SalesRepresentativePerformance rows={representativePerformance.rows} />
          <SalesLeadSourceEffectiveness report={leadSourceEffectiveness} />
          <SalesCommissionPerformance rows={commissionPerformance.rows} />
          <SalesProductPerformance rows={productPerformance.rows} />
          <SalesReturnFulfillmentQuality report={returnFulfillmentQuality} />
          <SalesTargetAttainmentReport report={targetAttainmentReport} />
          <SalesQuotationEffectiveness report={quotationEffectiveness} />
          <SalesCommercialMarginQuality report={commercialMarginQuality} />
        </>
      ) : (
        <SalesWorkspaceClient
          initialData={data}
          initialView={view}
          userId={session.user.id}
        />
      )}
    </SalesModuleShell>
  );
}

import type { SalesTargetAttainmentReport as Report, SalesTargetAttainmentRow } from '@/lib/apps/sales/target-attainment-report';

function money(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return currency + ' ' + value.toLocaleString();
  }
}

function statusLabel(status: SalesTargetAttainmentRow['status']) {
  return status.replace(/_/g, ' ');
}

function scopeLabel(row: SalesTargetAttainmentRow) {
  if (row.targetScope === 'company') return 'Company';
  if (row.targetScope === 'team') return row.teamName || 'Sales team';
  return row.salespersonName || 'Salesperson';
}

function value(value: number, metric: SalesTargetAttainmentRow['metric'], currency: string) {
  return metric === 'orders' ? value.toLocaleString() : money(value, currency);
}

export default function SalesTargetAttainmentReport({ report }: { report: Report }) {
  if (!report.canViewTargets) {
    return (
      <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
        <h2 className="text-base font-black">Sales target attainment</h2>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">Target progress is hidden because your access does not include both Sales reporting and target-view permissions.</p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  const metrics: Array<SalesTargetAttainmentRow['metric']> = ['revenue', 'margin', 'orders'];

  return (
    <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
      <header>
        <h2 className="text-base font-black">Sales target attainment</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
          Active targets spanning the last 90 days through the next 90 days. Revenue and margin are shown in {report.companyCurrency}; actuals stop at today. Team and salesperson results use each order’s currently assigned team and owner.
        </p>
      </header>
      {report.rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-slate-500">No active sales targets overlap this reporting window.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-6">
          {metrics.map(metric => {
            const rows = report.rows.filter(row => row.metric === metric);
            if (rows.length === 0) return null;
            return (
              <section key={metric} aria-label={metric + ' target attainment'}>
                <h3 className="mb-3 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">{metric === 'orders' ? 'Order volume' : metric + ' target'}</h3>
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] text-left text-sm">
                    <thead><tr className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">Scope</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">Period</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Target</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Actual to date</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Attainment</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">Progress</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">Status</th>
                    </tr></thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                      {rows.map(row => (
                        <tr key={row.id}>
                          <th scope="row" className="max-w-[220px] truncate px-3 py-3 font-bold">{scopeLabel(row)}</th>
                          <td className="whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-3 text-slate-500">{row.periodStart} – {row.periodEnd}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{value(row.targetValue, metric, report.companyCurrency)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold tabular-nums">{value(row.actualValue, metric, report.companyCurrency)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.attainmentPercent.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%</td>
                          <td className="min-w-[180px] px-3 py-3">
                            <div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-[var(--sami-border)]">
                              <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-[var(--sami-accent)]" style={{ width: Math.min(100, Math.max(0, row.attainmentPercent)) + '%' }} />
                            </div>
                            <span className="mt-1 block text-[10px] text-slate-500">{row.elapsedPercent.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}% of period elapsed</span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3">
                            <span className="inline-flex rounded-full border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2 py-1 text-xs font-bold capitalize">{statusLabel(row.status)}</span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </section>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

FILE: app\apps\sales\SalesTemplatesManager.tsx
