'use client';

import {
  FileText,
  LayoutTemplate,
  Pencil,
  Plus,
  Trash2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';

import {
  useState,
} from 'react';

import type {
  SalesWorkspaceData,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';


export default function SalesTemplatesManager({
  data,
  busy,
  request,
  showSuccess,
  showError,
}: {
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData;
  busy:
    boolean;
  request:
    (
      payload:
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >,
    ) =>
      Promise<
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >
      >;
  showSuccess:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  showError:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
}) {
  const [
    templates,
    setTemplates,
  ] =
    useState(
      data.templates,
    );

  const [
    formKey,
    setFormKey,
  ] =
    useState(
      0,
    );

  const [
    editingTemplate,
    setEditingTemplate,
  ] =
    useState<(typeof data.templates)[number] | null>(null);

  async function save(
    form:
      HTMLFormElement,
  ) {
    const values =
      new FormData(
        form,
      );

    try {
      const result =
        await request({
          action:
            'save_template',
          templateId:
            editingTemplate?.id,
          name:
            values.get(
              'name',
            ),
          primaryColor:
            values.get(
              'primaryColor',
            ),
          secondaryColor:
            values.get(
              'secondaryColor',
            ),
          footerText:
            values.get(
              'footerText',
            ),
          notes:
            values.get(
              'notes',
            ),
          terms:
            values.get(
              'terms',
            ),
          isDefault:
            values.get(
              'isDefault',
            ) ===
              'on',
        });

      const id =
        typeof result.id ===
          'string'
          ? result.id
          : '';

      const name =
        String(
          values.get(
            'name',
          ) ||
          '',
        )
          .trim();

      const isDefault =
        values.get(
          'isDefault',
        ) ===
          'on';

      if (
        id &&
        name
      ) {
        setTemplates(
          current => [
            {
              id,
              name,
              isDefault,
              notes:
                String(
                  values.get(
                    'notes',
                  ) ||
                  '',
                ) ||
                null,
              terms:
                String(
                  values.get(
                    'terms',
                  ) ||
                  '',
                ) ||
                null,
              footerText:
                String(
                  values.get(
                    'footerText',
                  ) ||
                  '',
                ) ||
                null,
              primaryColor:
                String(
                  values.get(
                    'primaryColor',
                  ) ||
                  data.settings
                    .primaryColor,
                ),
              secondaryColor:
                String(
                  values.get(
                    'secondaryColor',
                  ) ||
                  data.settings
                    .secondaryColor,
                ),
            },
            ...current
              .map(
                template => ({
                  ...template,
                  isDefault:
                    isDefault
                      ? false
                      : template
                          .isDefault,
                }),
              )
              .filter(
                template =>
                  template.id !==
                  id,
              ),
          ],
        );
      }

      form.reset();
      setEditingTemplate(null);
      setFormKey(
        value =>
          value +
          1,
      );

      showSuccess(
        'Template saved',
        'The quotation template is ready for new quotations.',
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        'Template could not be saved',
        error instanceof
          Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not save the quotation template.',
      );
    }
  }

  async function removeTemplate(
    template:
      (typeof data.templates)[number],
  ) {
    if (
      !window.confirm(
        'Delete the quotation template "' +
          template.name +
          '"? Existing quotations and their history will be kept.',
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      await request({
        action:
          'delete_template',
        templateId:
          template.id,
      });

      setTemplates(
        current =>
          current.filter(
            item =>
              item.id !==
              template.id,
          ),
      );

      if (
        editingTemplate?.id ===
        template.id
      ) {
        setEditingTemplate(null);
        setFormKey(value => value + 1);
      }

      showSuccess(
        'Template deleted',
        'The template was removed from the library. Existing quotations remain unchanged.',
      );
    } catch (error) {
      showError(
        'Template could not be deleted',
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not delete this quotation template.',
      );
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="space-y-4">
      <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
        <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-slate-500">
          Roadmap Part 5
        </p>
        <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-black">
          Quotation templates
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-slate-500">
          Create reusable quotation presentation defaults for notes, commercial terms, footer copy and document branding. Templates stay separate from global Sales policy.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[0.85fr_1.15fr]">
        {
          data.capabilities
            .canManageSettings &&
          (
            <form
              key={
                formKey
              }
              className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
              onSubmit={
                async event => {
                  event.preventDefault();

                  await save(
                    event.currentTarget,
                  );
                }
              }
            >
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Plus
                  className="h-4 w-4"
                />
                <h3 className="text-sm font-black">
                  {editingTemplate ? 'Edit template' : 'New template'}
                </h3>
              </div>

              <div className="mt-4 space-y-3">
                {editingTemplate && <input type="hidden" name="templateId" value={editingTemplate.id} />}
                <Field
                  name="name"
                  label="Template name"
                  defaultValue={editingTemplate?.name || ''}
                  required
                />
                <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                  <Field
                    name="primaryColor"
                    label="Primary color"
                    defaultValue={
                      editingTemplate?.primaryColor || data.settings.primaryColor
                    }
                  />
                  <Field
                    name="secondaryColor"
                    label="Secondary color"
                    defaultValue={
                      editingTemplate?.secondaryColor || data.settings.secondaryColor
                    }
                  />
                </div>
                <Area
                  name="notes"
                  label="Default notes"
                  defaultValue={editingTemplate?.notes || ''}
                />
                <Area
                  name="terms"
                  label="Default terms"
                  defaultValue={editingTemplate?.terms || ''}
                />
                <Area
                  name="footerText"
                  label="Document footer"
                  defaultValue={editingTemplate?.footerText || ''}
                />

                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3 text-xs font-bold">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    name="isDefault"
                    defaultChecked={editingTemplate?.isDefault || false}
                    className="h-4 w-4"
                  />
                  Make this the default quotation template
                </label>

                <button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={
                    busy
                  }
                  className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 text-sm font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                >
                  {editingTemplate ? 'Update template' : 'Save template'}
                </button>
                {editingTemplate && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    disabled={busy}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setEditingTemplate(null);
                      setFormKey(value => value + 1);
                    }}
                    className="flex h-10 w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-4 text-sm font-bold disabled:opacity-60"
                  >
                    <X className="h-4 w-4" /> Cancel editing
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </form>
          )
        }

        <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <LayoutTemplate
              className="h-4 w-4"
            />

'use client';

type ForecastRow = {
  horizonDays: number;
  currency: string;
  opportunityCount: number;
  openPipelineValue: number;
  weightedPipelineValue: number;
};

const HORIZONS = [
  { days: 30, label: 'Next 30 days' },
  { days: 60, label: 'Next 60 days' },
  { days: 90, label: 'Next 90 days' },
] as const;

function formatMoney(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return `${currency} ${value.toLocaleString()}`;
  }
}

export default function SalesWeightedForecast({ rows }: { rows: ForecastRow[] }) {
  return (
    <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
      <header>
        <h2 className="text-sm font-black">Weighted pipeline forecast</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
          Open opportunities expected to close within each horizon. Weighted value uses the opportunity probability.
          Values stay grouped by currency and are never combined across currencies.
        </p>
      </header>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
          No open opportunities have an expected close date within the next 90 days. Add expected close dates to build the forecast.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {HORIZONS.map(horizon => {
            const horizonRows = rows.filter(row => row.horizonDays === horizon.days);
            return (
              <section key={horizon.days} className="min-w-0 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em]">{horizon.label}</h3>
                {horizonRows.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">No opportunities with a close date in this horizon.</p>
                ) : (
                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                    {horizonRows.map(row => (
                      <div key={horizon.days + '-' + row.currency} className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] pb-3 last:border-0 last:pb-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                          <span className="text-xs font-black">{row.currency}</span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">{row.opportunityCount.toLocaleString()} opportunities</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-2 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                          <div>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Open pipeline</p>
                            <p className="break-words text-sm font-bold tabular-nums">{formatMoney(row.openPipelineValue, row.currency)}</p>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Probability-weighted</p>
                            <p className="break-words text-sm font-black tabular-nums">{formatMoney(row.weightedPipelineValue, row.currency)}</p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </section>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function isQuoteExpiringWithinSevenDays(
  quote: SalesWorkspaceData['quotes'][number],
) {
  if (
    (quote.status !== 'sent' && quote.status !== 'viewed') ||
    !quote.validUntil
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const parts = quote.validUntil.slice(0, 10).split('-').map(Number);
  const [year, month, day] = parts;

  if (
    parts.length !== 3 ||
    !year ||
    !month ||
    !day ||
    !Number.isFinite(year) ||
    !Number.isFinite(month) ||
    !Number.isFinite(day)
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const now = new Date();
  const today = Date.UTC(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  const expiry = Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day);
  const daysUntilExpiry = Math.round((expiry - today) / 86_400_000);

  return daysUntilExpiry >= 0 && daysUntilExpiry <= 7;
}


function matchesQuoteStatusView(
  quote: SalesWorkspaceData['quotes'][number],
  view: QuoteStatusView,
) {
  switch (view) {
    case 'all':
      return true;
    case 'draft':
      return quote.status === 'draft';
    case 'needs_approval':
      return quote.approvalStatus === 'pending';
    case 'awaiting_response':
      return quote.status === 'sent' ||
        quote.status === 'viewed';
    case 'accepted':
      return quote.status === 'accepted';
    case 'converted':
      return quote.status === 'converted';
    case 'expired':
      return quote.status === 'expired';
    case 'expiring_soon':
      return isQuoteExpiringWithinSevenDays(quote);
    case 'closed_without_sale':
      return quote.status === 'rejected' ||
        quote.status === 'expired' ||
        quote.status === 'cancelled';
  }
}

type SalesRegisterPage<T> = {
  rows: T[];
  offset: number;
  limit: number;
  totalCount: number;
  hasMore: boolean;
  nextOffset: number;
  queueCounts?: Record<string, number>;
};

async function requestSalesRegisterPage<T>(
  kind: 'quotes' | 'orders',
  query: URLSearchParams,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<SalesRegisterPage<T>> {
  query.set('register', kind);
  const response = await fetch('/api/apps/sales?' + query.toString(), {
    cache: 'no-store',
    signal,
  });
  const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as {
    success?: boolean;
    error?: string;
    register?: SalesRegisterPage<T>;
  };
  if (!response.ok || body.success !== true || !body.register) {
    throw new Error(body.error || 'Could not load the Sales register.');
  }
  return body.register;
}

function money(
  value:
    number,
  currency:
    string,
) {
  try {
    return new Intl
      .NumberFormat(
        'en-KE',
        {
          style:
            'currency',
          currency,
          maximumFractionDigits:
            2,
        },
      )
      .format(
        value,
      );
  } catch {
    return (
      currency +
      ' ' +
      value.toLocaleString()
    );
  }
}


function Status({
  value,
}: {
  value:
    string;
}) {
  const success =
    [
      'accepted',
      'converted',
      'approved',
      'fulfilled',
      'invoiced',
      'closed',
    ].includes(
      value,
    );

  const danger =
    [
      'rejected',
      'expired',
      'cancelled',
    ].includes(
      value,
    );

  return (
    <span
      className={[
        'inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em] ring-1 ring-inset',
        success
          ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 ring-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-300'
          : danger
            ? 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-700 ring-red-500/20 dark:text-red-300'
            : 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 ring-blue-500/20 dark:text-blue-300',
      ].join(
        ' ',
      )}
    >
      {
        value.replaceAll(
          '_',
          ' ',
        )
      }
    </span>
  );
}


function exportSales(
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData,
  selectedQuotes?:
    SalesWorkspaceData['quotes'],
  selectedOrders?:
    SalesWorkspaceData['orders'],
) {
  const rows: (
    string |
    number |
    null |
    undefined
  )[][] = [
    [
      'Type',
      'Number',
      'Customer',
      'Status',
      'Date',
      'Currency',
      'Amount',
    ],
  ];

  const quotesToExport =
    selectedOrders
      ? []
      : selectedQuotes ??
        data.quotes;

  rows.push(
    ...quotesToExport.map(
      quote => [
        'Quotation',
        quote.quoteNumber,
        quote.customerName,
        quote.status,
        quote.quoteDate,
        quote.currency,
        quote.totalAmount,
      ],
    ),
  );

  if (selectedOrders) {
    rows.push(
      ...selectedOrders.map(
        order => [
          'Sales order',
          order.orderNumber,
          order.customerName,
          order.status,
          order.orderDate,
          order.currency,
          order.totalAmount,
        ],
      ),
    );
  } else if (!selectedQuotes) {
    rows.push(
      ...data.orders.map(
        order => [
          'Sales order',
          order.orderNumber,
          order.customerName,
          order.status,
          order.orderDate,
          order.currency,
          order.totalAmount,
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  const csv =
    rows
      .map(
        row =>
          row
            .map(
              value =>
                '"' +
                String(
                  value ??
                  '',
                )
                  .replaceAll(
                    '"',
                    '""',
                  ) +
                '"',
            )
            .join(
              ',',
            ),
      )
      .join(
        '\n',
      );

  const url =
    URL.createObjectURL(
      new Blob(
        [
          csv,
        ],
        {
          type:
            'text/csv;charset=utf-8',
        },
      ),
    );

  const anchor =
    document.createElement(
      'a',
    );

  anchor.href =
    url;

  anchor.download =
    (
      selectedQuotes
        ? 'sales-quotations-selected-'
        : selectedOrders
          ? 'sales-orders-selected-'
          : 'sales-register-'
    ) +
    new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .slice(
        0,
        10,
      ) +
    '.csv';

  document.body
    .appendChild(
      anchor,
    );

  anchor.click();
  anchor.remove();

  URL.revokeObjectURL(
    url,
  );
}

  ] = useState<LinkedOpportunity | null>(null);

  const [
    opportunityLaunchResolved,
    setOpportunityLaunchResolved,
  ] = useState(initialView !== 'newQuote');

  const [
    opportunityLaunchError,
    setOpportunityLaunchError,

  useEffect(

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialView !== 'newQuote') {
      setLinkedOpportunityId('');
      setLinkedOpportunity(null);
      setOpportunityLaunchError('');
      setOpportunityLaunchResolved(true);
      return;
    }

    const requestedId = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
      .get('opportunityId')
      ?.trim();

    if (!requestedId) {
      setLinkedOpportunityId('');
      setLinkedOpportunity(null);
      setOpportunityLaunchError('');
      setOpportunityLaunchResolved(true);
      return;
    }

    let cancelled = false;
    setLinkedOpportunityId(requestedId);
    setLinkedOpportunity(null);
    setOpportunityLaunchError('');
    setOpportunityLaunchResolved(false);

    void fetch('/api/apps/sales?pipeline=1', { cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(async response => {
        const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(body.error || 'Could not load the selected opportunity.');
        }
        return body;
      })
      .then(body => {
        const opportunities = body?.pipeline?.opportunities;
        const opportunity = Array.isArray(opportunities)
          ? opportunities.find((item: LinkedOpportunity) => String(item.id) === requestedId)
          : null;
        if (!opportunity) {
          throw new Error('The opportunity is unavailable. Return to Leads & Opportunities and try again.');
        }
        if (!cancelled) setLinkedOpportunity(opportunity as LinkedOpportunity);
      })
      .catch(error => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setOpportunityLaunchError(
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'Could not load the selected opportunity.',
        );
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setOpportunityLaunchResolved(true);
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [initialView]);

  useEffect(() => {

    async function loadSavedViews() {
      setSavedViewsLoading(true);
      setSavedViewsError('');

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          '/api/apps/sales?savedViews=1',
          {
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            cache: 'no-store',
            headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
          },
        );
        const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

        if (!response.ok || body.success !== true) {
          throw new Error(body.error || 'Could not load saved quotation views.');

        if (!cancelled) {
          setSavedQuoteViews(
            Array.isArray(body.savedViews)
              ? body.savedViews as SalesSavedQuoteView[]
              : [],
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setSavedViewsError(
            error instanceof Error
              ? error.message
              : 'Could not load saved quotation views.',
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setSavedViewsLoading(false);
      }
    }

    void loadSavedViews();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (view !== 'quotes') return;
    const signature = search.trim() + '|' + quoteStatusView;
    const baseChanged = quoteBaseData.current !== initialData.quotes;
    if (signature === previousQuoteQuery.current && !baseChanged) return;
    const requestId = ++quoteRegisterRequestId.current;
    setSelectedQuoteIds([]);
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setQuoteRegisterLoading(true);
    setQuoteRegisterError('');
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        offset: '0',
        limit: '250',
        search: search.trim(),
        statusView: quoteStatusView,
      });
      void requestSalesRegisterPage<SalesWorkspaceData['quotes'][number]>('quotes', query, controller.signal)
        .then(page => {
          if (requestId !== quoteRegisterRequestId.current) return;
          previousQuoteQuery.current = signature;
          quoteBaseData.current = initialData.quotes;
          setQuoteRecords(page.rows);
          setQuoteRegisterHasMore(page.hasMore);
          setQuoteRegisterTotalCount(page.totalCount);
          setQuoteRegisterQueueCounts(page.queueCounts || {});
        })
        .catch(error => {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted && requestId === quoteRegisterRequestId.current) {
            setQuoteRegisterError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load quotations.');
          }
        })
        .finally(() => {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted && requestId === quoteRegisterRequestId.current) setQuoteRegisterLoading(false);
        });
    }, 250);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      controller.abort();
      if (requestId === quoteRegisterRequestId.current) setQuoteRegisterLoading(false);
    };
  }, [view, search, quoteStatusView, initialData.quotes, initialData.metrics.quoteCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (view !== 'orders') return;
    const signature = search.trim() + '|' + orderStatusView + '|' + orderSortBy;
    const baseChanged = orderBaseData.current !== initialData.orders;
    if (signature === previousOrderQuery.current && !baseChanged) return;
    const requestId = ++orderRegisterRequestId.current;

    }, 250);
    return () => {

      controller.abort();

  async function loadMoreQuoteRecords() {
    if (quoteRegisterLoading || !quoteRegisterHasMore) return;
    const requestId = ++quoteRegisterRequestId.current;
    setQuoteRegisterLoading(true);
    setQuoteRegisterError('');
    try {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        offset: String(quoteRecords.length),
        limit: '250',
        search: search.trim(),
        statusView: quoteStatusView,
      });
      const page = await requestSalesRegisterPage<SalesWorkspaceData['quotes'][number]>('quotes', query);
      if (requestId !== quoteRegisterRequestId.current) return;
      setQuoteRecords(current => {
        const existing = new Set(current.map(row => row.id));
        return [...current, ...page.rows.filter(row => !existing.has(row.id))];
      });
      setQuoteRegisterHasMore(page.hasMore);
      setQuoteRegisterTotalCount(page.totalCount);
      setQuoteRegisterQueueCounts(page.queueCounts || {});
    } catch (error) {
      if (requestId === quoteRegisterRequestId.current) {
        setQuoteRegisterError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load more quotations.');
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestId === quoteRegisterRequestId.current) setQuoteRegisterLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const visibleQuotes =
    useMemo(
      () => {
        const query =
          search
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();

        return initialData
          .quotes
          .filter(
            quote =>
              matchesQuoteStatusView(
                quote,
                quoteStatusView,
              ) &&
              (
                !query ||
                [

                  quote.customerName,
                  quote.customerEmail || '',
                  quote.status,
                  quote.approvalStatus,
                  quote.reference ||
                  '',
                ]
                  .some(
                    value =>
                      value
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(

                  )
              ),
          );
      },

        search,
        quoteStatusView,

              quote.status === 'draft' &&
              (
                quote.approvalStatus === 'approved' ||
                quote.approvalStatus === 'not_required'
              ),

        selectedQuoteIds,

  const visibleOrders =
    useMemo(
      () => {
        const query =
          search
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();

        const matchingOrders = orderRecords.filter(
          order =>
            matchesSalesOrderView(order, orderStatusView) &&
            (
              !query ||
              [
                order.orderNumber,
                order.customerName,
                order.reference || '',
                order.status,
                order.fulfillmentStatus,
                order.invoiceStatus,
              ].some(value =>
                value
                  .toLowerCase()
                  .includes(query),
              )
            ),
        );

        return matchingOrders.sort((left, right) => {
          let difference = 0;

          switch (orderSortBy) {
            case 'newest':
              difference = right.orderDate.localeCompare(left.orderDate);
              break;
            case 'oldest':
              difference = left.orderDate.localeCompare(right.orderDate);
              break;
            case 'value_high':
              difference = right.baseTotalAmount - left.baseTotalAmount;
              break;
            case 'value_low':
              difference = left.baseTotalAmount - right.baseTotalAmount;
              break;
            case 'delivery_first':
              difference = left.deliveredPercent - right.deliveredPercent;
              break;
            case 'invoice_first':
              difference = left.invoicedPercent - right.invoicedPercent;
              break;
            case 'customer_az':
              difference = left.customerName.localeCompare(right.customerName);
              break;
          }

          return difference || left.orderNumber.localeCompare(right.orderNumber);
        });
      },
      [
        orderRecords,
        orderStatusView,
        orderSortBy,
        search,
      ],
    );

  const allVisibleOrdersSelected =
    visibleOrders.length > 0 &&
    visibleOrders.every(
      order => selectedOrderIds.includes(order.id),
    );

  const invoiceableSelectedOrderIds =
    useMemo(

              order.invoiceStatus !== 'invoiced',
          )
          .map(order => order.id),
      [
        orderRecords,
        selectedOrderIds,
      ],
    );

  async function saveCurrentQuoteView() {
    const name = savedViewName.trim();

    if (!name) {
      showWarning('Name required', 'Enter a name for this saved quotation view.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const result = await request({
        action: 'save_quote_view',
        name,
        statusView: quoteStatusView,
        searchQuery: search,
      });

      const savedView = result as unknown as SalesSavedQuoteView;
      setSavedQuoteViews(current => [
        savedView,
        ...current.filter(view => view.id !== savedView.id),
      ]);
      setSavedViewName('');
      setSavedViewsError('');
      showSuccess('View saved', 'Your quotation filters are saved to your Sales workspace.');
    } catch (error) {
      showError(
        'View could not be saved',
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not save this quotation view.',
      );
    }
  }

  async function removeSavedQuoteView(view: SalesSavedQuoteView) {

      );
    }
  }

  async function bulkSendSelectedQuotes() {
    const quoteIds = sendableSelectedQuoteIds;

    if (quoteIds.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    if (!window.confirm(
      'Send ' + quoteIds.length +
      ' eligible draft quotation(s) to customers now? Each quotation is sent using the configured Sales delivery channel.',
    )) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const result = await request({
        action: 'bulk_send_quotes',
        quoteIds,
      });

      const sentCount = Number(result.sentCount || 0);
      const failedCount = Number(result.failedCount || 0);
      const outcomes = Array.isArray(result.results)
        ? result.results as Array<{
            quoteId: string;
            success: boolean;
            error?: string;
          }>
        : [];
      const failures = outcomes.filter(outcome => !outcome.success);

      if (failedCount > 0) {
        setSelectedQuoteIds(
          failures
            .map(outcome => outcome.quoteId)
            .filter(Boolean),
        );
        const failureSummary = failures
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map(outcome => {
            const quote = quoteRecords.find(
              item => item.id === outcome.quoteId,
            );
            return (quote?.quoteNumber || 'Quotation') +
              ': ' + (outcome.error || 'Delivery failed');
          })
          .join(' · ');

        showWarning(
          'Some quotations were not sent',
          sentCount + ' sent; ' + failedCount + ' failed.' +
            (failureSummary ? ' ' + failureSummary : ''),
        );
      } else {
        setSelectedQuoteIds([]);
        showSuccess(
          'Quotations sent',
          sentCount + ' draft quotation(s) were sent to customers.',
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError(
        'Quotations could not be sent',
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not send the selected quotations.',
      );
    }
  }

  async function bulkInvoiceSelectedOrders() {
    const orderIds = invoiceableSelectedOrderIds;

    if (orderIds.length === 0) {
      showWarning(
        'No invoiceable orders selected',
        'Select confirmed orders that are not yet fully invoiced.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (orderIds.length > 25) {
      showWarning(
        'Batch is too large',
        'Invoice at most 25 sales orders at a time.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!window.confirm(
      'Create a separate invoice for each of the ' + orderIds.length +
      ' selected order(s)? Each order follows its own invoice policy. Successful retries reuse the original invoice.',
    )) {
      return;
    }

    const orders = orderIds.map(orderId => {
      let idempotencyKey = bulkInvoiceIdempotencyKeys.current[orderId];

      if (!idempotencyKey) {
        idempotencyKey = 'sales-bulk-' + crypto.randomUUID();
        bulkInvoiceIdempotencyKeys.current[orderId] = idempotencyKey;
      }

      return { orderId, idempotencyKey };
    });

    try {
      const result = await request({
        action: 'bulk_invoice_orders',
        orders,
      });

      const outcomes = Array.isArray(result.results)
        ? result.results as Array<{
            orderId: string;
            success: boolean;
            invoiceId?: string;
            reused?: boolean;
            error?: string;
          }>
        : [];
      const successes = outcomes.filter(outcome => outcome.success);
      const failures = outcomes.filter(outcome => !outcome.success);

      for (const outcome of successes) {
        delete bulkInvoiceIdempotencyKeys.current[outcome.orderId];
      }

      if (failures.length > 0) {
        setSelectedOrderIds(failures.map(outcome => outcome.orderId));
        const details = failures
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map(outcome => {
            const order = orderRecords.find(item => item.id === outcome.orderId);
            return (order?.orderNumber || 'Sales order') + ': ' +
              (outcome.error || 'Invoice creation failed');
          })
          .join(' · ');

        showWarning(
          'Some orders could not be invoiced',
          successes.length + ' succeeded; ' + failures.length + ' failed.' +
            (details ? ' ' + details : ''),
        );
      } else {
        setSelectedOrderIds([]);
        showSuccess(
          'Invoices created',
          successes.length + ' sales-order invoice(s) created or safely recovered.',
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError(
        'Bulk invoicing interrupted',
        (error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not complete bulk invoicing.') +
          ' Retry the same selection; request keys are retained to prevent duplicate invoices.',
      );
    }
  }

  async function request(
    payload:
      Record<
        string,
        unknown
      >,
  ) {
    if (
      inFlight.current
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'Another Sales action is still being saved.',
      );
    }

    inFlight.current =
      true;

    setRequestBusy(
      true,
    );

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          '/api/apps/sales',
          {
            method:
              'POST',
            credentials:
              'same-origin',
            cache:
              'no-store',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type':
                'application/json',
              Accept:
                'application/json',
            },
            body:
              JSON.stringify(
                payload,
              ),
          },
        );

      const body =
        await response
          .json()
          .catch(
            () => ({}),
          ) as {
            success?:
              boolean;
            error?:
              string;
            result?:
              Record<
                string,
                unknown
              >;
          };

      if (
        !response.ok ||
        body.success !==
          true
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          body.error ||
          'SaMi could not complete the Sales action.',
        );
      }

      startTransition(
        () => {
          router.refresh();
        },
      );

      return body.result ||
        {};
    } finally {
      inFlight.current =
        false;

      setRequestBusy(
        false,
      );
    }
  }

  async function saveQuote(
    payload:
      Record<
        string,
        unknown
      >,
  ) {
    try {
      const result = await request(
        payload,
      );

      setComposerOpen(
        false,
      );

      showSuccess(
        'Quotation saved',
        linkedOpportunityId
          ? 'The quotation is linked to its opportunity.'
          : 'The commercial document was saved successfully.',
      );

      if (linkedOpportunityId && result.id) {
        router.push('/apps/sales/quotes/' + encodeURIComponent(String(result.id)));
      }

      return true;
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      const message =
        error instanceof
          Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not save this quotation.';

      if (
        message.includes(
          'still being saved',
        )
      ) {
        showWarning(
          'Action already in progress',
          message,
        );
      } else {
        showError(
          'Quotation could not be saved',
          message,
        );
      }

      return false;
    }
