                        }}
                        className={[
                          'inline-flex min-h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold transition-colors',
                          orderStatusView === option.key
                            ? 'border-blue-600 bg-blue-600 text-white'
                            : 'border-[var(--sami-border)] hover:border-blue-500/60',
                        ].join(' ')}
                      >
                        {option.label}
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-black/5 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] dark:bg-white/10">
                          {orderRegisterQueueCounts?.[option.key] ?? '—'}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                  <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    Sort
                    <select
                      aria-label="Sort sales orders"
                      value={orderSortBy}
                      onChange={event => setOrderSortBy(event.target.value as SalesOrderSortBy)}
                      className="h-9 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-2 text-xs font-bold text-[var(--sami-text)]"
                    >
                      {ORDER_SORT_OPTIONS.map(option => (
                        <option key={option.key} value={option.key}>
                          {option.label}
                        </option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </label>
                </div>
                <p className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                  Focus on delivery or invoicing work. Sort by age, value, customer or the least-complete delivery and invoice work.
                </p>
              </div>

              <section className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-3" aria-label="Saved sales order views">
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-end lg:justify-between">
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                      Saved order views
                    </h3>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      Save the current fulfillment or invoicing queue and search so you can reopen the same work list later.
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <form
                    className="flex w-full flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row lg:w-auto"
                    onSubmit={event => {
                      event.preventDefault();
                      void saveCurrentOrderView();
                    }}
                  >
                    <label className="sr-only" htmlFor="sales-saved-order-view-name">Saved order view name</label>
                    <input
                      id="sales-saved-order-view-name"
                      value={savedOrderViewName}
                      onChange={event => setSavedOrderViewName(event.target.value)}
                      maxLength={80}
                      placeholder="e.g. Orders to invoice"
                      className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-xs sm:w-64"
                    />
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      disabled={busy || !savedOrderViewName.trim()}
                      className="inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3.5 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                    >
                      <BookmarkPlus className="h-4 w-4" />
                      Save order view
                    </button>
                  </form>
                </div>

                {savedOrderViewsError && (
                  <p role="alert" className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-red-500/30 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-red-600">
                    {savedOrderViewsError}
                  </p>
                )}

                {savedOrderViewsLoading ? (
                  <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">Loading your saved order views…</p>
                ) : savedOrderViews.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    No saved order views yet. Save this queue and search to create your first one.
                  </p>
                ) : (
                  <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                    {savedOrderViews.map(view => (
                      <div
                        key={view.id}
                        className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-1"
                      >
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => applySavedOrderView(view)}
                          className={[
                            'max-w-[280px] truncate rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-xs font-bold',
                            orderStatusView === view.statusView && search === view.searchQuery && orderSortBy === view.sortBy
                              ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                              : 'hover:bg-slate-500/10',
                          ].join(' ')}
                          title={view.name}
                        >
                          {view.name}
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          aria-label={'Delete saved order view ' + view.name}
                          onClick={() => void removeSavedOrderView(view)}
                          className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-500 hover:text-red-600"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </section>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <div className="flex justify-end">
                  <div
                    role="group"
                    aria-label="Sales order display mode"
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-1"
                  >
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-pressed={orderDisplayMode === 'register'}
                      onClick={() => setOrderDisplayMode('register')}
                      className={[
                        'inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 text-xs font-bold',
                        orderDisplayMode === 'register'
                          ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                          : 'hover:bg-slate-500/10',
                      ].join(' ')}
                    >
                      <List className="h-4 w-4" />
                      Register
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      aria-pressed={orderDisplayMode === 'cards'}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setOrderDisplayMode('cards');
                        setSelectedOrderIds([]);
                      }}
                      className={[
                        'inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 text-xs font-bold',
                        orderDisplayMode === 'cards'
                          ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white'
                          : 'hover:bg-slate-500/10',
                      ].join(' ')}
                    >
                      <LayoutGrid className="h-4 w-4" />
                      Cards
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {selectedOrderIds.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-3" aria-live="polite">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-black">
                          {selectedOrderIds.length} sales order{selectedOrderIds.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} selected
                        </p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                          {invoiceableSelectedOrderIds.length} confirmed order(s) eligible for invoicing. Maximum 25 per batch.
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                        {initialData.capabilities.canManageOrders &&
                          invoiceableSelectedOrderIds.length > 0 && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              disabled={busy || invoiceableSelectedOrderIds.length > 25}
                              onClick={() => void bulkInvoiceSelectedOrders()}
                              className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-3.5 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
                            >
                              <Send className="h-4 w-4" />
                              Invoice eligible orders ({invoiceableSelectedOrderIds.length})
                            </button>
                          )}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            const selectedOrders = orderRecords.filter(
                              order => selectedOrderIds.includes(order.id),
                            );
                            if (selectedOrders.length > 0) {
                              exportSales(initialData, undefined, selectedOrders);
                            }
                          }}
                          className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3.5 text-xs font-black"
                        >
                          <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
                          Export selected CSV
                        </button>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setSelectedOrderIds([])}
                          className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black"
                        >
                          Clear selection
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {invoiceableSelectedOrderIds.length > 25 && (
                      <p role="alert" className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-700">
                        Select no more than 25 eligible orders for a single invoice batch.
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                {visibleOrders.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-8 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
                    No sales orders match this view.
                  </div>
                ) : orderDisplayMode === 'register' ? (
                  <div className="sami-surface overflow-hidden rounded-[24px]" aria-label="Sales order register">
                    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                      <table className="w-full min-w-[1120px] text-left text-sm" aria-label="Sales order register">
                        <thead className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-slate-500/[0.04] text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.09em] text-slate-400">
                          <tr>
                            <th scope="col" className="w-12 px-4 py-3">
                              <input
                                type="checkbox"
                                aria-label="Select all visible sales orders"
                                checked={allVisibleOrdersSelected}
                                disabled={busy || visibleOrders.length === 0}
                                onChange={event => {
                                  if (event.target.checked) {
                                    setSelectedOrderIds(current => Array.from(new Set([
                                      ...current,
                                      ...visibleOrders.map(order => order.id),
                                    ])));
                                  } else {
                                    const visibleIds = new Set(visibleOrders.map(order => order.id));
                                    setSelectedOrderIds(current => current.filter(id => !visibleIds.has(id)));
                                  }
                                }}
                                className="h-4 w-4 rounded accent-blue-600"
                              />
                            </th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Order</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Customer</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Order date</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Status</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Fulfillment</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Invoicing</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Delivered</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3">Invoiced</th>
                            <th scope="col" className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Order value</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                          {visibleOrders.map(order => (
                            <tr key={order.id} className="hover:bg-slate-500/[0.03]">
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <input
                                  type="checkbox"
                                  aria-label={'Select sales order ' + order.orderNumber}
                                  checked={selectedOrderIds.includes(order.id)}
                                  disabled={busy}
                                  onChange={event => {
                                    if (event.target.checked) {
                                      setSelectedOrderIds(current =>
                                        current.includes(order.id) ? current : [...current, order.id],
                                      );
                                    } else {
                                      setSelectedOrderIds(current =>
                                        current.filter(id => id !== order.id),
                                      );
                                    }
                                  }}
                                  className="h-4 w-4 rounded accent-blue-600"
                                />
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <Link
                                  href={'/apps/sales/orders/' + order.id}
                                  className="font-black text-blue-600 hover:underline"
                                >
                                  {order.orderNumber}
                                </Link>
                                {order.quoteNumber && (
                                  <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-500">
                                    From {order.quoteNumber}
                                  </p>
                                )}
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">{order.customerName}</td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-slate-500">{order.orderDate}</td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <Status value={order.status} />
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs font-semibold">
                                  {salesOrderFulfillmentLabel(order.fulfillmentStatus)}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-xs font-semibold">
                                  {salesOrderInvoiceLabel(order.invoiceStatus)}
                                </span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">{Math.round(order.deliveredPercent)}%</span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3">
                                <span className="font-bold tabular-nums">{Math.round(order.invoicedPercent)}%</span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-black whitespace-nowrap">
                                {money(order.totalAmount, order.currency)}
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid gap-3">
                    {visibleOrders.map(order => (
                      <Link
                        key={order.id}
                        href={'/apps/sales/orders/' + order.id}
                        className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-4 transition hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:shadow-md"
                      >
                        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
                          <div>
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                              <p className="font-black">{order.orderNumber}</p>
                              <Status value={order.status} />
                            </div>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
                              {order.customerName}
                            </p>
                          </div>

                          <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:min-w-[460px]">
                            <Progress
                              label="Delivered"
                              value={order.deliveredPercent}
                              state={order.fulfillmentStatus}
                            />
                            <Progress
                              label="Invoiced"
                              value={order.invoicedPercent}
                              state={order.invoiceStatus}
                            />
                            <div className="sm:text-right">
                              <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
                                Order value
                              </p>
                              <p className="mt-1 font-black">
                                {money(order.totalAmount, order.currency)}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </Link>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
              {orderRegisterError && <p role="alert" className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-600">{orderRegisterError}</p>}
              <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm text-slate-500">
                <span>Showing {orderRecords.length.toLocaleString()} of {orderRegisterTotalCount.toLocaleString()} sales orders</span>
                {orderRegisterHasMore && (
                  <button type="button" disabled={orderRegisterLoading} onClick={() => void loadMoreOrderRecords()} className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-4 py-2 font-semibold disabled:opacity-50">
                    {orderRegisterLoading ? 'Loading sales orders…' : 'Load more sales orders'}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

            </section>
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'organization' &&
          initialData
            .capabilities
            .canViewOrganization &&
          (
            <SalesOrganizationManager
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'operations' &&
          initialData
            .capabilities
            .canViewOperations &&
          (
            <SalesOperationsManager
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'reports' &&
          (
            <Reports
              data={
                initialData
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'settings' &&
          (
            <Settings
              data={
                initialData
              }
              busy={
                busy
              }
              request={
                request
              }
              showSuccess={
                showSuccess
              }
              showError={
                showError
              }
            />
          )
        }

        {
          view ===
            'newQuote' &&
          (
            <section className="sami-surface rounded-[26px] p-4 sm:p-5">
              <div className="mb-4">
                <h2 className="text-lg font-black">
                  {linkedOpportunity ? 'New quotation · ' + linkedOpportunity.name : 'New quotation'}
                </h2>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Build the commercial offer from the selected opportunity. The link remains attached through the quotation lifecycle.
                </p>
              </div>

              {!opportunityLaunchResolved ? (
                <p className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
                  Loading opportunity details…
                </p>
              ) : opportunityLaunchError ? (
                <div className="space-y-3 rounded-xl border border-amber-300/60 p-4 text-sm">
                  <p className="text-amber-700">{opportunityLaunchError}</p>
                  <Link href="/apps/sales/opportunities" className="font-black text-blue-600 hover:underline">
                    Return to Leads & Opportunities
                  </Link>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <SalesQuoteComposer
                  key={linkedOpportunity?.id || 'standalone-new-quote'}
                  data={initialData}
                  linkedOpportunity={linkedOpportunity}
                  busy={busy}
                  onSave={saveQuote}
                  onCancel={() => {
                    router.push(
                      linkedOpportunityId
                        ? '/apps/sales/opportunities'
                        : '/apps/sales/quotes',
                    );
                  }}
                />
              )}
            </section>
          )
        }
      </div>
    </>
  );
}


function Overview({
  data,
}: {
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData;
}) {
  return (
    <section className="space-y-4">
      <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-4">
        <Metric
          label="Quoted value"
          value={
            currencyTotalsLabel(
              data.metrics.quoteValueByCurrency,
              data.company.currency,
            )
          }
          note={
            data.metrics
              .quoteCount +
            ' quotations'
          }
        />
        <Metric
          label="Accepted value"
          value={
            currencyTotalsLabel(
              data.metrics.acceptedValueByCurrency,
              data.company.currency,
            )
          }
          note={
            data.metrics
              .acceptedCount +
            ' accepted'
          }
        />
        <Metric
          label="Sales orders"
          value={
            currencyTotalsLabel(
              data.metrics.orderValueByCurrency,
              data.company.currency,
            )
          }
          note={
            data.metrics.orderCount +
            ' orders'
          }
        />
        <Metric
          label="Awaiting response"
          value={
            String(
              data.metrics
                .sentCount,
            )
          }
          note="sent quotations"
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
            Recent quotations
          </h2>
          <div className="mt-3 divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
            {
              data.quotes
                .slice(
                  0,
                  7,
                )
                .map(
                  quote => (
                    <Link
                      key={
                        quote.id
                      }
                      href={
                        '/apps/sales/quotes/' +
                        quote.id
                      }
                      className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 py-3"
                    >
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <p className="truncate text-sm font-black">
                          {
                            quote.quoteNumber
                          }
                          {' · '}
                          {
                            quote.customerName
                          }
                        </p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                          {
                            quote.quoteDate
                          }
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <p className="text-xs font-black">
                          {
                            money(
                              quote.totalAmount,
                              quote.currency,
                            )
                          }
                        </p>
                        <div className="mt-1">
                          <Status
                            value={
                              quote.status
                            }
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </Link>
                  ),
                )
            }
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
            Pipeline health
          </h2>
          <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <SmallMetric
              label="Draft"
              value={
                data.metrics
                  .draftCount
              }
            />
            <SmallMetric
              label="Sent"
              value={
                data.metrics
                  .sentCount
              }
            />
            <SmallMetric
              label="Accepted"
              value={
                data.metrics
                  .acceptedCount
              }
            />
            <SmallMetric
              label="Converted"
              value={
                data.metrics
                  .convertedCount
              }
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}


function Reports({
  data,
}: {
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData;
}) {
  return (
    <section className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-3">
      <ReportCard
        title="Quote status"
        rows={
          data.statusCounts.map(
            item => ({
              label:
                item.status.replaceAll('_', ' ') + ' · ' + item.currency,
              primary:
                String(
                  item.count,
                ),
              secondary:
                money(
                  item.amount,
                  item.currency,
                ),
            }),
          )
        }
      />
      <ReportCard
        title="Monthly quotation value"
        rows={
          data.monthly.map(
            item => ({
              label:
                item.month + ' · ' + item.currency,
              primary:
                String(
                  item.quoteCount,
                ) +
                ' quotes',
              secondary:
                money(
                  item.amount,
                  item.currency,
                ),
            }),
          )
        }
      />
      <ReportCard
        title="Top customers"
        rows={
          data.topCustomers.map(
            item => ({
              label:
                item.customerName + ' · ' + item.currency,
              primary:
                String(
                  item.quoteCount,
                ) +
                ' quotes',
              secondary:
                money(
                  item.amount,
                  item.currency,
                ),
            }),
          )
        }
      />
    </section>
  );
}


function Settings({
  data,
  busy,
  request,
  showSuccess,
  showError,
}: {
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData;
  busy:
    boolean;
  request:
    (
      payload:
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >,
    ) =>
      Promise<
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >
      >;
  showSuccess:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  showError:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
}) {
  return (
    <section className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[1.2fr_0.8fr]">
      <form
        className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4"
        onSubmit={
          async event => {
            event.preventDefault();

            const form =
              new FormData(
                event.currentTarget,
              );

            try {
              await request({
                action:
                  'update_settings',
                defaultCurrency:
                  form.get(
                    'defaultCurrency',
                  ),
                defaultValidityDays:
                  form.get(
                    'defaultValidityDays',
                  ),
                quoteApprovalThreshold:
                  form.get(
                    'quoteApprovalThreshold',
                  ),
                invoicePolicy:
                  form.get(
                    'invoicePolicy',
                  ),
                requireQuoteApproval:
                  form.get(
                    'requireQuoteApproval',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                allowPartialInvoicing:
                  form.get(
                    'allowPartialInvoicing',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                allowOnlineAcceptance:
                  form.get(
                    'allowOnlineAcceptance',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                allowOnlineRejection:
                  form.get(
                    'allowOnlineRejection',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                requireBillingCustomerForInvoice:
                  form.get(
                    'requireBillingCustomerForInvoice',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                lockConfirmedOrders:
                  form.get(
                    'lockConfirmedOrders',
                  ) ===
                    'on',
                primaryColor:
                  form.get(
                    'primaryColor',
                  ),
                secondaryColor:
                  form.get(
                    'secondaryColor',
                  ),
                footerText:
                  form.get(
                    'footerText',
                  ),
                termsAndConditions:
                  form.get(
                    'termsAndConditions',
                  ),
                defaultNotes:
                  form.get(
                    'defaultNotes',
                  ),
                emailMessage:
                  form.get(
                    'emailMessage',
                  ),
              });

              showSuccess(
                'Sales settings saved',
                'The company Sales policy was updated.',
              );
            } catch (
              error
            ) {
              showError(
                'Sales settings failed',
                error instanceof
                  Error
                  ? error.message
                  : 'SaMi could not save Sales settings.',
              );
            }
          }
        }
      >
        <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
          Sales policy
        </h2>

        <div className="mt-4 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <SettingInput
            name="defaultCurrency"
            label="Default currency"
            defaultValue={
              data.settings
                .defaultCurrency
            }
          />
          <SettingInput
            name="defaultValidityDays"
            label="Quote validity days"
            type="number"
            defaultValue={
              String(
                data.settings
                  .defaultValidityDays,
              )
            }
          />
          <SettingInput
            name="quoteApprovalThreshold"
            label="Approval threshold (base currency)"
            type="number"
            defaultValue={
              String(
                data.settings
                  .quoteApprovalThreshold,
              )
            }
          />

          <label>
            <SettingLabel>
              Invoicing policy
            </SettingLabel>
            <select
              name="invoicePolicy"
              defaultValue={
                data.settings
                  .invoicePolicy
              }
              className="mt-1 h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
            >
              <option value="ordered">
                Ordered quantities
              </option>
              <option value="delivered">
                Delivered quantities
              </option>
            </select>
          </label>

          <SettingInput
            name="primaryColor"
            label="Primary color"
            defaultValue={
              data.settings
                .primaryColor
            }
          />
          <SettingInput
            name="secondaryColor"
            label="Secondary color"
            defaultValue={
              data.settings
                .secondaryColor
            }
          />

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <SettingArea
              name="defaultNotes"
              label="Default quote notes"
              defaultValue={
                data.settings
                  .defaultNotes ||
                ''
              }
            />
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <SettingArea
              name="termsAndConditions"
              label="Terms & conditions"
              defaultValue={
                data.settings
                  .termsAndConditions ||
                ''
              }
            />
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <SettingArea
              name="emailMessage"
              label="Default delivery message"
              defaultValue={
                data.settings
                  .emailMessage ||
                ''
              }
            />
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <SettingArea
              name="footerText"
              label="Document footer"
              defaultValue={
                data.settings
                  .footerText ||
                ''
              }
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <Check
            name="requireQuoteApproval"
            label="Require internal quote approval"
            defaultChecked={
              data.settings
                .requireQuoteApproval
            }
          />
          <Check
            name="allowPartialInvoicing"
            label="Allow partial invoicing"
            defaultChecked={
              data.settings
                .allowPartialInvoicing
            }
          />
          <Check
            name="allowOnlineAcceptance"
            label="Allow online acceptance"
            defaultChecked={
              data.settings
                .allowOnlineAcceptance
            }
          />
          <Check
            name="allowOnlineRejection"
            label="Allow online rejection"
            defaultChecked={
              data.settings
                .allowOnlineRejection
            }
          />
          <Check
            name="requireBillingCustomerForInvoice"
            label="Require billing customer"
            defaultChecked={
              data.settings
                .requireBillingCustomerForInvoice
            }
          />
          <Check
            name="lockConfirmedOrders"
            label="Lock confirmed commercial terms"
            defaultChecked={
              data.settings
                .lockConfirmedOrders
            }
          />
        </div>

        <div className="mt-5 flex justify-end">
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={
              busy
            }
            className="h-11 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-5 text-sm font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            Save settings
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </section>
  );
}


function Toolbar({
  title,
  search,
  setSearch,
  onExport,
}: {
  title:
    string;
  search:
    string;
  setSearch:
    (
      value:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  onExport:
    () =>
      void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="sami-surface flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-[22px] p-4 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
      <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
        {
          title
        }
      </h2>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row">
        <label className="relative block">
          <Search className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-3 h-4 w-4 text-slate-400" />
          <input
            value={
              search
            }
            onChange={
              event =>
                setSearch(
                  event.target
                    .value,
                )
            }
            placeholder="Search"
            className="h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent pl-9 pr-3 text-xs sm:w-64"
          />
        </label>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={
            onExport
          }
          className="inline-flex h-10 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-3 text-xs font-black"
        >
          <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
          Export
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


function currencyTotalsLabel(
  rows: Array<{ currency: string; amount: number }>,
  fallbackCurrency: string,
) {
  if (rows.length === 0) return fallbackCurrency + ' 0.00';
  return rows.map(row =>
    row.currency + ' ' + row.amount.toLocaleString('en-KE', {
      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }),
  ).join(' · ');
}


function Metric({
  label,
  value,
  note,
}: {
  label:
    string;
  value:
    string;
  note:
    string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="sami-surface rounded-[22px] p-4">
      <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
        {
          label
        }
      </p>
      <p className="mt-2 break-words text-base font-black leading-snug">
        {
          value
        }
      </p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-500">
        {
          note
        }
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}


function SmallMetric({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label:
    string;
  value:
    number;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-3">
      <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
        {
          label
        }
      </p>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xl font-black">
        {
          value
        }
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}


function Progress({
  label,
  value,
  state,
}: {
  label:
    string;
  value:
    number;
  state:
    string;
}) {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-400">
        <span>
          {
            label
          }
        </span>
        <span>
          {
            value
          }%
        </span>
      </div>
      <div className="mt-2 h-2 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-slate-500/10">
        <div
          className="h-full rounded-full bg-blue-600"
          style={{
            width:
              Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(
                  100,
                  value,
                ),
              ) +
              '%',
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <p className="mt-1 text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-400">
        {
          state.replaceAll(
            '_',
            ' ',
          )
        }
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}


function ReportCard({
  title,
  rows,
}: {
  title:
    string;
  rows:
    Array<{
      label:
        string;
      primary:
        string;
      secondary:
        string;
    }>;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4">
      <h2 className="text-sm font-black">
        {
          title
        }
      </h2>

      <div className="mt-3 space-y-2">
        {
          rows.length ===
            0
            ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                  No report data yet.
                </p>
              )
            : rows.map(
                (
                  row,
                  index,
                ) => (
                  <div
                    key={
                      row.label +
                      index
                    }
                    className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] py-2 last:border-0"
                  >
                    <p className="text-xs font-black capitalize">
                      {
                        row.label
                      }
                    </p>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <p className="text-xs font-black">
                        {
                          row.primary
                        }
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">
                        {
                          row.secondary
                        }
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ),
              )
        }
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  children,
}: {

    React.ReactNode;
}) {

      }

  );
}


function SettingInput({
  name,
  label,
  type =
    'text',
  defaultValue =
    '',
  required =
    false,
}: {
  name:
    string;
  label:
    string;
  type?:
    string;
  defaultValue?:
    string;
  required?:
    boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <SettingLabel>
        {
          label
        }
      </SettingLabel>
      <input
        name={
          name
        }
        type={
          type
        }
        defaultValue={
          defaultValue
        }
        required={
          required
        }
        min={
          type ===
            'number'
            ? '0'
            : undefined
        }
        step={
          type ===
            'number'
            ? '0.01'
            : undefined
        }
        className="mt-1 h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm"
      />
    </label>
  );
}


function SettingArea({
  name,

    '',
}: {

}) {
  return (

      <SettingLabel>
        {
          label
        }
      </SettingLabel>
      <textarea
        name={
          name
        }
        rows={
          4
        }
        defaultValue={
          defaultValue
        }
        className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm"
      />
    </label>
  );
}

}: {

        name={

        type="checkbox"
        defaultChecked={
          defaultChecked
        }
        className="h-4 w-4"
      />
      {
        label
      }
    </label>
  );
}

import type {
  CSSProperties,
} from 'react';

import Link from 'next/link';

import {
  ArrowLeft,
} from 'lucide-react';

import AppSurfaceShell from '@/app/components/apps/AppSurfaceShell';
import SamiAppIconTile from '@/app/components/apps/SamiAppIconTile';
import styles from '@/app/apps/[appKey]/EnterpriseModuleWorkspaceShell.module.css';

import {
  SAMI_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/auth/permission-catalog';

import {
  loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp,
} from '@/app/apps/_shared/loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp';

import SalesInboxWorkspaceClient from '@/app/apps/sales_inbox/SalesInboxWorkspaceClient';

const MODULE_KEY = 'sales_inbox';

export default async function SalesInboxWorkspace({
  section,
}: {
  section?: string | null;
}) {
  const {
    session,
    account,
    shell,
    app,
    data,
    notifications,
    resolved,
    can,
    visual,
    uiProfile,
  } =
    await loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp(
      MODULE_KEY,
      section,
    );

  const appBaseHref =
    '/apps/sales_inbox';

  const appSidebarItems = [
    {
      key: 'overview',
      label: 'Overview',
      href: appBaseHref,
      description: 'KPIs, priorities and current operating state.',
    },
    ...data.tables
      .filter(
        table =>
          !table.settingTable,
      )
      .map(
        table => ({
          key: table.key,
          label: table.label,
          href:
            appBaseHref +
            '/' +
            encodeURIComponent(
              table.key,
            ),
          description:
            'Open ' +
            table.label.toLowerCase() +
            ' records.',
          badge: table.count,
        }),
      ),
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canReport
        ? [{
            key: 'reports',
            label: 'Reports',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/reports',
            description: 'Module analysis and operational reporting.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
    {
      key: 'activity',
      label: 'Activity',
      href:
        appBaseHref +
        '/activity',
      description: 'Recent module changes and user actions.',
    },
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canManageSettings &&
      data.tables.some(
        table =>
          table.settingTable,
      )
        ? [{
            key: 'settings',
            label: 'Settings',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/settings',
            description: 'Module defaults, policy and configuration.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
  ];

  const activeSidebarKey =
    resolved.view === 'records'
      ? resolved.tableKey
      : resolved.view;

  return (
    <AppSurfaceShell
      appKey={app.registryKey}
      appCategory={app.category}
      appIconKey={app.iconKey}
      profile={uiProfile}
      user={session.user}
      tenant={account.tenant}
      membership={account.membership}
      subscription={shell.subscription}
      modules={shell.accessibleModules}
      appSidebarItems={appSidebarItems}
      activeSidebarKey={activeSidebarKey}
      sidebarCapabilities={{
        aiEnabled: shell.aiAvailable,
        filesEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.FILES_VIEW,
          ),
        notificationsEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.NOTIFICATIONS_VIEW,
          ),
      }}
      unreadNotifications={
        notifications?.unreadCount ||
        0
      }
      title={app.name}
      description={app.description}
      contextLabel={data.company.name}
      actions={
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <SamiAppIconTile
            appKey={app.registryKey}
            category={app.category}
            iconKey={app.iconKey}
            size="sm"
          />

          <Link
            href="/apps"
            className={[
              'inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs font-semibold shadow-[var(--sami-shadow-sm)] transition hover:-translate-y-px',
              visual.border,
              visual.soft,
              visual.text,
            ].join(' ')}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">
              All Apps
            </span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div
        className={styles.enterpriseWorkspace}
        data-module={MODULE_KEY}
        data-archetype={uiProfile.archetype}
        data-navigation={uiProfile.navigation}
        data-density={uiProfile.density}
        data-header={uiProfile.header}
        style={{
          '--sami-module-accent':
            uiProfile.accent,
          '--sami-module-secondary':
            uiProfile.secondary,
        } as CSSProperties}
      >
        <SalesInboxWorkspaceClient
          initialData={data}
          userId={session.user.id}
          initialView={resolved.view}
          initialTableKey={resolved.tableKey}
          accessibleModuleKeys={
            shell.accessibleModules.map(
              module =>
                module.registryKey,
            )
          }
        />
      </div>
    </AppSurfaceShell>
  );
}

FILE: app\apps\shifts\ShiftsWorkspace.tsx

import type {
  CSSProperties,
} from 'react';

import Link from 'next/link';

import {
  ArrowLeft,
} from 'lucide-react';

import AppSurfaceShell from '@/app/components/apps/AppSurfaceShell';
import SamiAppIconTile from '@/app/components/apps/SamiAppIconTile';
import styles from '@/app/apps/[appKey]/EnterpriseModuleWorkspaceShell.module.css';

import {
  SAMI_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/auth/permission-catalog';

import {
  loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp,
} from '@/app/apps/_shared/loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp';

import ShiftsWorkspaceClient from '@/app/apps/shifts/ShiftsWorkspaceClient';

const MODULE_KEY = 'shifts';

export default async function ShiftsWorkspace({
  section,
}: {
  section?: string | null;
}) {
  const {
    session,
    account,
    shell,
    app,
    data,
    notifications,
    resolved,
    can,
    visual,
    uiProfile,
  } =
    await loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp(
      MODULE_KEY,
      section,
    );

  const appBaseHref =
    '/apps/shifts';

  const appSidebarItems = [
    {
      key: 'overview',
      label: 'Overview',
      href: appBaseHref,
      description: 'KPIs, priorities and current operating state.',
    },
    ...data.tables
      .filter(
        table =>
          !table.settingTable,
      )
      .map(
        table => ({
          key: table.key,
          label: table.label,
          href:
            appBaseHref +
            '/' +
            encodeURIComponent(
              table.key,
            ),
          description:
            'Open ' +
            table.label.toLowerCase() +
            ' records.',
          badge: table.count,
        }),
      ),
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canReport
        ? [{
            key: 'reports',
            label: 'Reports',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/reports',
            description: 'Module analysis and operational reporting.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
    {
      key: 'activity',
      label: 'Activity',
      href:
        appBaseHref +
        '/activity',
      description: 'Recent module changes and user actions.',
    },
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canManageSettings &&
      data.tables.some(
        table =>
          table.settingTable,
      )
        ? [{
            key: 'settings',
            label: 'Settings',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/settings',
            description: 'Module defaults, policy and configuration.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
  ];

  const activeSidebarKey =
    resolved.view === 'records'
      ? resolved.tableKey
      : resolved.view;

  return (
    <AppSurfaceShell
      appKey={app.registryKey}
      appCategory={app.category}
      appIconKey={app.iconKey}
      profile={uiProfile}
      user={session.user}
      tenant={account.tenant}
      membership={account.membership}
      subscription={shell.subscription}
      modules={shell.accessibleModules}
      appSidebarItems={appSidebarItems}
      activeSidebarKey={activeSidebarKey}
      sidebarCapabilities={{
        aiEnabled: shell.aiAvailable,
        filesEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.FILES_VIEW,
          ),
        notificationsEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.NOTIFICATIONS_VIEW,
          ),
      }}
      unreadNotifications={
        notifications?.unreadCount ||
        0
      }
      title={app.name}
      description={app.description}
      contextLabel={data.company.name}
      actions={
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <SamiAppIconTile
            appKey={app.registryKey}
            category={app.category}
            iconKey={app.iconKey}
            size="sm"
          />

          <Link
            href="/apps"
            className={[
              'inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs font-semibold shadow-[var(--sami-shadow-sm)] transition hover:-translate-y-px',
              visual.border,
              visual.soft,
              visual.text,
            ].join(' ')}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">
              All Apps
            </span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div
        className={styles.enterpriseWorkspace}
        data-module={MODULE_KEY}
        data-archetype={uiProfile.archetype}
        data-navigation={uiProfile.navigation}
        data-density={uiProfile.density}
        data-header={uiProfile.header}
        style={{
          '--sami-module-accent':
            uiProfile.accent,
          '--sami-module-secondary':
            uiProfile.secondary,
        } as CSSProperties}
      >
        <ShiftsWorkspaceClient
          initialData={data}
          userId={session.user.id}
          initialView={resolved.view}
          initialTableKey={resolved.tableKey}
          accessibleModuleKeys={
            shell.accessibleModules.map(
              module =>
                module.registryKey,
            )
          }
        />
      </div>
    </AppSurfaceShell>
  );
}

import type {
  CSSProperties,
} from 'react';

import Link from 'next/link';

  ArrowLeft,
} from 'lucide-react';

import AppSurfaceShell from '@/app/components/apps/AppSurfaceShell';
import SamiAppIconTile from '@/app/components/apps/SamiAppIconTile';
import styles from '@/app/apps/[appKey]/EnterpriseModuleWorkspaceShell.module.css';

import {
  SAMI_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/auth/permission-catalog';

import {
  loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp,
} from '@/app/apps/_shared/loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp';

import SocialMarketingWorkspaceClient from '@/app/apps/social_marketing/SocialMarketingWorkspaceClient';

const MODULE_KEY = 'social_marketing';

export default async function SocialMarketingWorkspace({
  section,
}: {
  section?: string | null;
}) {
  const {
    session,
    account,
    shell,
    app,
    data,
    notifications,
    resolved,
    can,
    visual,
    uiProfile,
  } =
    await loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp(
      MODULE_KEY,
      section,
    );

  const appBaseHref =
    '/apps/social_marketing';

  const appSidebarItems = [
    {
      key: 'overview',
      label: 'Overview',
      href: appBaseHref,
      description: 'KPIs, priorities and current operating state.',
    },
    ...data.tables
      .filter(
        table =>
          !table.settingTable,
      )
      .map(
        table => ({
          key: table.key,
          label: table.label,
          href:
            appBaseHref +
            '/' +
            encodeURIComponent(
              table.key,
            ),
          description:
            'Open ' +
            table.label.toLowerCase() +
            ' records.',
          badge: table.count,
        }),
      ),
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canReport
        ? [{
            key: 'reports',
            label: 'Reports',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/reports',
            description: 'Module analysis and operational reporting.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
    {
      key: 'activity',
      label: 'Activity',
      href:
        appBaseHref +
        '/activity',
      description: 'Recent module changes and user actions.',
    },
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canManageSettings &&
      data.tables.some(
        table =>
          table.settingTable,
      )
        ? [{
            key: 'settings',
            label: 'Settings',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/settings',
            description: 'Module defaults, policy and configuration.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
  ];

  const activeSidebarKey =
    resolved.view === 'records'
      ? resolved.tableKey
      : resolved.view;

  return (
    <AppSurfaceShell
      appKey={app.registryKey}
      appCategory={app.category}
      appIconKey={app.iconKey}
      profile={uiProfile}
      user={session.user}
      tenant={account.tenant}
      membership={account.membership}
      subscription={shell.subscription}
      modules={shell.accessibleModules}
      appSidebarItems={appSidebarItems}
      activeSidebarKey={activeSidebarKey}
      sidebarCapabilities={{
        aiEnabled: shell.aiAvailable,
        filesEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.FILES_VIEW,
          ),
        notificationsEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.NOTIFICATIONS_VIEW,
          ),
      }}
      unreadNotifications={
        notifications?.unreadCount ||
        0
      }
      title={app.name}
      description={app.description}
      contextLabel={data.company.name}
      actions={
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <SamiAppIconTile
            appKey={app.registryKey}
            category={app.category}
            iconKey={app.iconKey}
            size="sm"
          />

            href="/apps"
            className={[

              visual.border,
              visual.soft,

              All Apps

  section,
}: {
  section?: string | null;
}) {
  const {
    session,
    account,
    shell,
    app,
    data,
    notifications,
    resolved,
    can,
    visual,
    uiProfile,
  } =
    await loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp(
      MODULE_KEY,
      section,
    );

  const appBaseHref =
    '/apps/surveys';

  const appSidebarItems = [
    {
      key: 'overview',
      label: 'Overview',
      href: appBaseHref,
      description: 'KPIs, priorities and current operating state.',
    },
    ...data.tables
      .filter(
        table =>
          !table.settingTable,
      )
      .map(
        table => ({
          key: table.key,
          label: table.label,
          href:
            appBaseHref +
            '/' +
            encodeURIComponent(
              table.key,
            ),
          description:
            'Open ' +
            table.label.toLowerCase() +
            ' records.',
          badge: table.count,
        }),
      ),
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canReport
        ? [{
            key: 'reports',
            label: 'Reports',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/reports',
            description: 'Module analysis and operational reporting.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
    {
      key: 'activity',
      label: 'Activity',
      href:
        appBaseHref +
        '/activity',
      description: 'Recent module changes and user actions.',
    },
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canManageSettings &&
      data.tables.some(
        table =>
          table.settingTable,
      )
        ? [{
            key: 'settings',
            label: 'Settings',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/settings',
            description: 'Module defaults, policy and configuration.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
  ];

  const activeSidebarKey =
    resolved.view === 'records'
      ? resolved.tableKey
      : resolved.view;

  return (
    <AppSurfaceShell
      appKey={app.registryKey}
      appCategory={app.category}
      appIconKey={app.iconKey}
      profile={uiProfile}
      user={session.user}
      tenant={account.tenant}
      membership={account.membership}
      subscription={shell.subscription}
      modules={shell.accessibleModules}
      appSidebarItems={appSidebarItems}
      activeSidebarKey={activeSidebarKey}
      sidebarCapabilities={{
        aiEnabled: shell.aiAvailable,
        filesEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.FILES_VIEW,
          ),
        notificationsEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.NOTIFICATIONS_VIEW,
          ),
      }}
      unreadNotifications={
        notifications?.unreadCount ||
        0
      }
      title={app.name}
      description={app.description}
      contextLabel={data.company.name}
      actions={
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <SamiAppIconTile
            appKey={app.registryKey}
            category={app.category}
            iconKey={app.iconKey}
            size="sm"
          />

          <Link
            href="/apps"
            className={[
              'inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs font-semibold shadow-[var(--sami-shadow-sm)] transition hover:-translate-y-px',
              visual.border,
              visual.soft,
              visual.text,
            ].join(' ')}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">
              All Apps
            </span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div
        className={styles.enterpriseWorkspace}
        data-module={MODULE_KEY}
        data-archetype={uiProfile.archetype}
        data-navigation={uiProfile.navigation}
        data-density={uiProfile.density}
        data-header={uiProfile.header}
        style={{
          '--sami-module-accent':
            uiProfile.accent,
          '--sami-module-secondary':
            uiProfile.secondary,
        } as CSSProperties}
      >
        <SurveysWorkspaceClient
          initialData={data}
          userId={session.user.id}
          initialView={resolved.view}
          initialTableKey={resolved.tableKey}
          accessibleModuleKeys={
            shell.accessibleModules.map(
              module =>
                module.registryKey,
            )
          }
        />
      </div>
    </AppSurfaceShell>
  );
}

import type {

  SAMI_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/auth/permission-catalog';

import {
  loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp,
} from '@/app/apps/_shared/loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp';

import TimesheetsWorkspaceClient from '@/app/apps/timesheets/TimesheetsWorkspaceClient';

const MODULE_KEY = 'timesheets';

export default async function TimesheetsWorkspace({
  section,
}: {
  section?: string | null;
}) {
  const {
    session,
    account,
    shell,
    app,
    data,
    notifications,
    resolved,
    can,
    visual,
    uiProfile,
  } =
    await loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp(
      MODULE_KEY,
      section,
    );

  const appBaseHref =
    '/apps/timesheets';

  const appSidebarItems = [
    {
      key: 'overview',
      label: 'Overview',
      href: appBaseHref,
      description: 'KPIs, priorities and current operating state.',
    },
    ...data.tables
      .filter(
        table =>
          !table.settingTable,
      )
      .map(
        table => ({
          key: table.key,
          label: table.label,
          href:
            appBaseHref +
            '/' +
            encodeURIComponent(
              table.key,
            ),
          description:
            'Open ' +
            table.label.toLowerCase() +
            ' records.',
          badge: table.count,
        }),
      ),
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canReport
        ? [{
            key: 'reports',
            label: 'Reports',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/reports',
            description: 'Module analysis and operational reporting.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
    {
      key: 'activity',
      label: 'Activity',
      href:
        appBaseHref +
        '/activity',
      description: 'Recent module changes and user actions.',
    },
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canManageSettings &&
      data.tables.some(
        table =>
          table.settingTable,
      )
        ? [{
            key: 'settings',
            label: 'Settings',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/settings',
            description: 'Module defaults, policy and configuration.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
  ];

  const activeSidebarKey =
    resolved.view === 'records'
      ? resolved.tableKey
      : resolved.view;

  return (
    <AppSurfaceShell
      appKey={app.registryKey}
      appCategory={app.category}
      appIconKey={app.iconKey}
      profile={uiProfile}
      user={session.user}
      tenant={account.tenant}
      membership={account.membership}
      subscription={shell.subscription}
      modules={shell.accessibleModules}
      appSidebarItems={appSidebarItems}
      activeSidebarKey={activeSidebarKey}
      sidebarCapabilities={{
        aiEnabled: shell.aiAvailable,
        filesEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.FILES_VIEW,
          ),
        notificationsEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.NOTIFICATIONS_VIEW,
          ),
      }}
      unreadNotifications={
        notifications?.unreadCount ||
        0
      }
      title={app.name}
      description={app.description}
      contextLabel={data.company.name}
      actions={
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <SamiAppIconTile
            appKey={app.registryKey}
            category={app.category}
            iconKey={app.iconKey}
            size="sm"
          />

          <Link
            href="/apps"
            className={[
              'inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs font-semibold shadow-[var(--sami-shadow-sm)] transition hover:-translate-y-px',
              visual.border,
              visual.soft,
              visual.text,
            ].join(' ')}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">
              All Apps
            </span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div
        className={styles.enterpriseWorkspace}
        data-module={MODULE_KEY}
        data-archetype={uiProfile.archetype}
        data-navigation={uiProfile.navigation}
        data-density={uiProfile.density}
        data-header={uiProfile.header}
        style={{
          '--sami-module-accent':
            uiProfile.accent,
          '--sami-module-secondary':
            uiProfile.secondary,
        } as CSSProperties}
      >
        <TimesheetsWorkspaceClient
          initialData={data}
          userId={session.user.id}
          initialView={resolved.view}
          initialTableKey={resolved.tableKey}
          accessibleModuleKeys={
            shell.accessibleModules.map(
              module =>
                module.registryKey,
            )
          }
        />
      </div>
    </AppSurfaceShell>
  );
}

import type {
  CSSProperties,
} from 'react';

import Link from 'next/link';

  ArrowLeft,
} from 'lucide-react';

import AppSurfaceShell from '@/app/components/apps/AppSurfaceShell';
import SamiAppIconTile from '@/app/components/apps/SamiAppIconTile';
import styles from '@/app/apps/[appKey]/EnterpriseModuleWorkspaceShell.module.css';

import {
  SAMI_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/auth/permission-catalog';

import {
  loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp,
} from '@/app/apps/_shared/loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp';

import WhiteboardWorkspaceClient from '@/app/apps/whiteboard/WhiteboardWorkspaceClient';

const MODULE_KEY = 'whiteboard';

export default async function WhiteboardWorkspace({
  section,
}: {
  section?: string | null;
}) {
  const {
    session,
    account,
    shell,
    app,
    data,
    notifications,
    resolved,
    can,
    visual,
    uiProfile,
  } =
    await loadStandaloneEnterpriseApp(
      MODULE_KEY,
      section,
    );

  const appBaseHref =
    '/apps/whiteboard';

  const appSidebarItems = [
    {
      key: 'overview',
      label: 'Overview',
      href: appBaseHref,
      description: 'KPIs, priorities and current operating state.',
    },
    ...data.tables
      .filter(
        table =>
          !table.settingTable,
      )
      .map(
        table => ({
          key: table.key,
          label: table.label,
          href:
            appBaseHref +
            '/' +
            encodeURIComponent(
              table.key,
            ),
          description:
            'Open ' +
            table.label.toLowerCase() +
            ' records.',
          badge: table.count,
        }),
      ),
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canReport
        ? [{
            key: 'reports',
            label: 'Reports',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/reports',
            description: 'Module analysis and operational reporting.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
    {
      key: 'activity',
      label: 'Activity',
      href:
        appBaseHref +
        '/activity',
      description: 'Recent module changes and user actions.',
    },
    ...(
      data.capabilities.canManageSettings &&
      data.tables.some(
        table =>
          table.settingTable,
      )
        ? [{
            key: 'settings',
            label: 'Settings',
            href:
              appBaseHref +
              '/settings',
            description: 'Module defaults, policy and configuration.',
          }]
        : []
    ),
  ];

  const activeSidebarKey =
    resolved.view === 'records'
      ? resolved.tableKey
      : resolved.view;

  return (
    <AppSurfaceShell
      appKey={app.registryKey}
      appCategory={app.category}
      appIconKey={app.iconKey}
      profile={uiProfile}
      user={session.user}
      tenant={account.tenant}
      membership={account.membership}
      subscription={shell.subscription}
      modules={shell.accessibleModules}
      appSidebarItems={appSidebarItems}
      activeSidebarKey={activeSidebarKey}
      sidebarCapabilities={{
        aiEnabled: shell.aiAvailable,
        filesEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.FILES_VIEW,
          ),
        notificationsEnabled:
          can(
            SAMI_PERMISSIONS.NOTIFICATIONS_VIEW,
          ),
      }}
      unreadNotifications={
        notifications?.unreadCount ||
        0
      }
      title={app.name}
      description={app.description}
      contextLabel={data.company.name}
      actions={
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <SamiAppIconTile
            appKey={app.registryKey}
            category={app.category}
            iconKey={app.iconKey}
            size="sm"
          />

          <Link
            href="/apps"
            className={[
              'inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3 text-xs font-semibold shadow-[var(--sami-shadow-sm)] transition hover:-translate-y-px',
              visual.border,
              visual.soft,
              visual.text,
            ].join(' ')}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">
              All Apps
            </span>
          </Link>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div
        className={styles.enterpriseWorkspace}
        data-module={MODULE_KEY}
        data-archetype={uiProfile.archetype}
        data-navigation={uiProfile.navigation}
        data-density={uiProfile.density}
        data-header={uiProfile.header}
        style={{
          '--sami-module-accent':
            uiProfile.accent,
          '--sami-module-secondary':

      >
        <WhiteboardWorkspaceClient
          initialData={data}
          userId={session.user.id}
          initialView={resolved.view}
          initialTableKey={resolved.tableKey}
          accessibleModuleKeys={
            shell.accessibleModules.map(
