import type { SalesProductPerformanceRow } from '@/lib/apps/sales/product-performance';

function money(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return currency + ' ' + value.toLocaleString();
  }
}

function quantity(value: number) {
  return value.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 4 });
}

export default function SalesProductPerformance({ rows }: { rows: SalesProductPerformanceRow[] }) {
  const currencies = Array.from(new Set(rows.map(row => row.currency)));
  return (
    <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
      <header>
        <h2 className="text-base font-black">Product and service performance</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
          Order lines from confirmed and closed orders dated within the last 90 days. Sales exclude tax and include line discounts; currency totals are kept separate. Returns are not netted into these order-line totals.
        </p>
      </header>
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-slate-500">No eligible order lines were found for the last 90 days.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-6">
          {currencies.map(currency => {
            const currencyRows = rows.filter(row => row.currency === currency);
            return (
              <section key={currency} aria-label={currency + ' product performance'}>
                <h3 className="mb-3 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">{currency}</h3>
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[1120px] text-left text-sm">
                    <thead>
                      <tr className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">Product / service</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">SKU</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Orders</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Lines</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Ordered</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Shipped</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Delivered</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Invoiced</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Net sales</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Discounts</th>
                        <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Margin</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                      {currencyRows.map(row => (
                        <tr key={row.productKey + ':' + currency}>
                          <th scope="row" className="max-w-[240px] truncate px-3 py-3 font-bold">{row.productName}</th>
                          <td className="max-w-[150px] truncate px-3 py-3 text-slate-500">{row.sku || '—'}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.orderCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.lineCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{quantity(row.quantityOrdered)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{quantity(row.quantityShipped)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{quantity(row.quantityDelivered)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{quantity(row.quantityInvoiced)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold tabular-nums">{money(row.netSales, currency)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{money(row.discountAmount, currency)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{money(row.marginAmount, currency)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}

                  </table>
                </div>

            );

    </section>
  );
}

FILE: app\apps\sales\SalesProductVariantsManager.tsx

'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Archive, Layers3, Pencil, Plus, RotateCcw, Save, X } from 'lucide-react';
import type { SalesWorkspaceData } from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';

type CatalogItem = SalesWorkspaceData['catalogItems'][number];
type Attribute = { name: string; value: string };
type Draft = {
  variantId: string;
  baseCatalogItemId: string;
  sku: string;
  unitPrice: string;
  unitCost: string;
  attributesText: string;
};
const emptyDraft = (baseCatalogItemId = ''): Draft => ({
  variantId: '',
  baseCatalogItemId,
  sku: '',
  unitPrice: '',
  unitCost: '',
  attributesText: 'Color=\nSize=',
});
function attributesFromText(value: string): Attribute[] {
  return value.split(/\r?\n/)
    .map(line => line.trim())
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map(line => {
      const index = line.indexOf('=');
      if (index <= 0 || index === line.length - 1) {
        throw new Error('Enter each option as Name=Value, for example Color=Blue.');
      }
      return { name: line.slice(0, index).trim(), value: line.slice(index + 1).trim() };
    });
}
function money(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency: currency || 'KES', maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return (currency || 'KES') + ' ' + Number(value || 0).toLocaleString();
  }
}

export default function SalesProductVariantsManager({
  data, busy, request, showSuccess, showError,
}: {
  data: SalesWorkspaceData;
  busy: boolean;
  request: (payload: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<Record<string, unknown>>;
  showSuccess: (title: string, message: string) => void;
  showError: (title: string, message: string) => void;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const products = useMemo(
    () => data.catalogItems.filter(item => !item.isVariant && item.itemType === 'product'),
    [data.catalogItems],
  );
  const variants = useMemo(
    () => data.catalogItems.filter(item => item.isVariant),
    [data.catalogItems],
  );
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<Draft>(() => emptyDraft(products[0]?.id || ''));
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [archiveId, setArchiveId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [attributeError, setAttributeError] = useState('');

  const editing = Boolean(draft.variantId);
  const canManage = data.capabilities.canManageCatalog;
  const selectedProduct = products.find(item => item.id === draft.baseCatalogItemId);
  const selectedVariant = variants.find(item => item.variantId === draft.variantId);

  function editVariant(item: CatalogItem) {
    setDraft({
      variantId: item.variantId || '',
      baseCatalogItemId: item.baseCatalogItemId || products[0]?.id || '',
      sku: item.sku || '',
      unitPrice: String(item.unitPrice),
      unitCost: String(item.unitCost ?? ''),
      attributesText: (item.variantAttributes || []).map(row => row.name + '=' + row.value).join('\n'),
    });
    setAttributeError('');
  }

  async function save(event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!canManage) return;
    if (!draft.baseCatalogItemId && !editing) {
      showError('Choose a product', 'Create a base product in the catalogue before adding variants.');
      return;
    }
    if (!draft.sku.trim()) {
      showError('SKU required', 'Every sellable variant needs its own unique SKU.');
      return;
    }
    let attributes: Attribute[];
    try {
      attributes = attributesFromText(draft.attributesText);
      if (!attributes.length) throw new Error('Add at least one variant attribute, such as Color=Blue.');
      if (new Set(attributes.map(item => item.name.toLowerCase())).size !== attributes.length) {
        throw new Error('Attribute names must be unique within a variant.');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      setAttributeError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Check the variant attributes.');
      return;
    }
    setAttributeError('');
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      await request(editing ? {
        action: 'update_product_variant',
        variantId: draft.variantId,
        sku: draft.sku.trim(),
        unitPrice: Number(draft.unitPrice),
        ...(data.capabilities.canViewMargin ? { unitCost: Number(draft.unitCost || 0) } : {}),
        attributes,
      } : {
        action: 'create_product_variant',
        baseCatalogItemId: draft.baseCatalogItemId,
        sku: draft.sku.trim(),
        unitPrice: Number(draft.unitPrice || selectedProduct?.unitPrice || 0),
        ...(data.capabilities.canViewMargin ? { unitCost: Number(draft.unitCost || 0) } : {}),
        attributes,
      });
      showSuccess(editing ? 'Variant updated' : 'Variant created',
        'The sellable SKU is saved in the shared catalogue and is available to quotations.');
      setDraft(emptyDraft(products[0]?.id || ''));
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Variant could not be saved', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not save this product variant.');
    } finally {
      setSaving(false);
    }
  }

  async function archiveVariant(item: CatalogItem) {
    if (!item.variantId) return;
    try {
      await request({ action: 'archive_product_variant', variantId: item.variantId });
      showSuccess('Variant archived', 'The SKU is no longer available for new quotations. Historical documents remain unchanged.');
      setArchiveId(null);
      if (draft.variantId === item.variantId) setDraft(emptyDraft(products[0]?.id || ''));
      router.refresh();
    } catch (error) {
      showError('Variant could not be archived', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not archive this SKU.');
    }
  }

  return (
    <section className="space-y-4">
      <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <span className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-600"><Layers3 className="h-5 w-5" /></span>
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.12em] text-slate-500">Sellable product SKUs</p>
            <h2 className="mt-1 text-xl font-black">Product variants</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-sm text-slate-500">Define options such as size, colour, capacity or packaging. Each combination is its own shared catalogue item with its own SKU and price, so quotations and subsequent invoices keep the exact variant sold.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr]">
        <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <h3 className="text-sm font-black">{editing ? 'Edit product variant' : 'Add variant'}</h3>
            {editing ? <button type="button" onClick={() => { setDraft(emptyDraft(products[0]?.id || '')); setAttributeError(''); }} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 text-xs font-bold"><X className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Cancel edit</button> : null}
          </div>
          {!canManage ? (
            <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">Catalogue-management permission is required to create or edit product variants.</p>
          ) : products.length === 0 && !editing ? (
            <p className="mt-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">Create a base product first, then add its variant SKUs here.</p>
          ) : (
            <form className="mt-4 space-y-4" onSubmit={save}>
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Base product
                <select value={draft.baseCatalogItemId} disabled={editing || saving || busy} onChange={event => {
                  const product = products.find(item => item.id === event.target.value);
                  setDraft(current => ({ ...current, baseCatalogItemId: event.target.value, unitPrice: product ? String(product.unitPrice) : current.unitPrice }));
                }} className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm">
                  {products.map(item => <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>{item.name}{item.sku ? ' · ' + item.sku : ''}</option>)}
                </select>
              </label>
              {selectedVariant ? <p className="rounded-lg bg-[var(--sami-surface-soft)] p-2 text-xs text-slate-500">Base product: {selectedVariant.baseProductName || selectedProduct?.name || 'Product'}</p> : null}
              <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Variant attributes * <span className="font-normal text-slate-500">one Name=Value pair per line</span>
                <textarea value={draft.attributesText} onChange={event => { setDraft(current => ({ ...current, attributesText: event.target.value })); setAttributeError(''); }} required rows={4} placeholder={'Color=Blue\nSize=Large'} className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent p-3 text-sm" />
              </label>
              {attributeError ? <p role="alert" className="text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">{attributeError}</p> : null}
              <div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Unique SKU *
                  <input value={draft.sku} onChange={event => setDraft(current => ({ ...current, sku: event.target.value }))} required maxLength={120} placeholder="e.g. TSHIRT-BLU-L" className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm" />
                </label>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Selling price *
                  <input type="number" value={draft.unitPrice} onChange={event => setDraft(current => ({ ...current, unitPrice: event.target.value }))} min={0} step="0.01" required className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm" />
                </label>
                {data.capabilities.canViewMargin ? <label className="block text-xs font-bold">Unit cost
                  <input type="number" value={draft.unitCost} onChange={event => setDraft(current => ({ ...current, unitCost: event.target.value }))} min={0} step="0.01" className="mt-1 h-10 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm" />
                </label> : null}
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">Variants must have distinct SKUs. The system blocks duplicate SKUs within the company and records variant changes in the activity history.</p>
              <button type="submit" disabled={busy || saving} className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-4 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-60"><Save className="h-4 w-4" /> {saving ? 'Saving…' : editing ? 'Save changes' : 'Create variant'}</button>
            </form>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3"><div><h3 className="text-sm font-black">Active variants</h3><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{variants.length} sellable SKU(s) in the loaded catalogue</p></div><button type="button" onClick={() => router.refresh()} className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 text-xs font-bold"><RotateCcw className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Refresh</button></div>

                  <p className="shrink-0 text-sm font-black tabular-nums">{money(item.unitPrice, data.company.currency)}</p>
                </div>

                  <button type="button" disabled={!canManage || busy || saving} onClick={() => editVariant(item)} className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 text-xs font-bold disabled:opacity-50"><Pencil className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Edit</button>
                  {archiveId === item.variantId ? <><button type="button" disabled={busy || saving} onClick={() => void archiveVariant(item)} className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg bg-rose-700 px-2.5 text-xs font-black text-white disabled:opacity-50"><Archive className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Confirm archive</button><button type="button" onClick={() => setArchiveId(null)} className="h-8 rounded-lg border border-[var(--sami-border)] px-2.5 text-xs font-bold">Cancel</button></> : <button type="button" disabled={!canManage || busy || saving} onClick={() => setArchiveId(item.variantId)} className="inline-flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-rose-500/30 px-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 disabled:opacity-50 dark:text-rose-300"><Archive className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> Archive</button>}
                </div>
              </article>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

  );

import type { SalesQuotationEffectivenessReport as Report, SalesQuotationEffectivenessRow } from '@/lib/apps/sales/quotation-effectiveness';

function money(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return currency + ' ' + value.toLocaleString();
  }
}

function days(value: number | null) {
  return value == null ? '—' : value.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 }) + ' days';
}

function EffectivenessTable({
  title,
  description,
  rows,
}: {
  title: string;
  description: string;
  rows: SalesQuotationEffectivenessRow[];
}) {
  const currencies = Array.from(new Set(rows.map(row => row.currency)));
  return (
    <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
      <h3 className="text-sm font-black">{title}</h3>
      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">{description}</p>
      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-slate-500">No quotations are available for this breakdown in the last 90 days.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-6">
          {currencies.map(currency => {
            const currencyRows = rows.filter(row => row.currency === currency);
            return (
              <section key={currency} aria-label={currency + ' quotation effectiveness'}>
                <h4 className="mb-3 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">{currency}</h4>
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[1180px] text-left text-sm">
                    <thead><tr className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-slate-500">
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 font-black">{title.includes('template') ? 'Template' : 'Salesperson'}</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Quotes</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Sent</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Accepted</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Converted</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Rejected</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Expired</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Quoted value</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Converted value</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Sent → accepted</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Accepted → order</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Days to accept</th>
                      <th className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-black">Days to order</th>
                    </tr></thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-[var(--sami-border)]">
                      {currencyRows.map(row => (
                        <tr key={row.dimensionKey + ':' + currency}>
                          <th scope="row" className="max-w-[220px] truncate px-3 py-3 font-bold">{row.dimensionLabel}</th>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.quoteCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.sentCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.acceptedCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold tabular-nums">{row.convertedCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.rejectedCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.expiredCount.toLocaleString()}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{money(row.quotedValue, currency)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right font-bold tabular-nums">{money(row.convertedValue, currency)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.sentToAcceptedRate.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{row.acceptedToOrderRate.toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })}%</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{days(row.sentToAcceptedDays)}</td>
                          <td className="px-3 py-3 text-right tabular-nums">{days(row.acceptedToOrderDays)}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              </section>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

export default function SalesQuotationEffectiveness({ report }: { report: Report }) {
  if (!report.canViewReports) {
    return (
      <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
        <h2 className="text-base font-black">Quotation effectiveness</h2>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">Quotation effectiveness is unavailable because your account does not have Sales report access.</p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section className="space-y-5">
      <header>
        <h2 className="text-base font-black">Quotation effectiveness</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
          Quotations dated in the last 90 days. Accepted means customer acceptance recorded or an accepted/converted status; converted means a linked order exists. Amounts remain separated by quotation currency.
        </p>
      </header>
      <EffectivenessTable
        title="Salesperson quote effectiveness"
        description="Compares sent, accepted and ordered quotations by the currently assigned salesperson. Only active internal tenant members are named."
        rows={report.bySalesperson}
      />
      <EffectivenessTable
        title="Quotation template effectiveness"
        description="Compares template performance. Quotes without a template and quotes linked to deleted templates remain visible separately."
        rows={report.byTemplate}
      />
    </section>
  );
}

'use client';

type DraftLine = {
  key: string;
  catalogItemId: string;
  description: string;
  sku: string;
  unit: string;
  quantity: string;
  unitPrice: string;
  unitCost: string;
  discountType:
    'percent' |
    'fixed';
  discountValue: string;
  taxName: string;
  taxRate: string;
};


function newKey() {
  return (
    globalThis.crypto
      ?.randomUUID?.() ||
    Math.random()
      .toString(36)
      .slice(2)
  );
}


function blankLine():
  DraftLine {
  return {
    key:
      newKey(),
    catalogItemId:
      '',
    description:
      '',
    sku:
      '',
    unit:
      'unit',
    quantity:
      '1',
    unitPrice:
      '0',
    unitCost:
      '0',
    discountType:
      'percent',
    discountValue:
      '0',
    taxName:
      '',
    taxRate:
      '0',
  };
}


function formatMoney(
  value:
    number,
  currency:
    string,
) {
  try {
    return new Intl
      .NumberFormat(
        'en-KE',
        {
          style:
            'currency',
          currency,
          maximumFractionDigits:
            2,
        },
      )
      .format(
        value,
      );
  } catch {
    return (
      currency +
      ' ' +
      value.toLocaleString()
    );
  }
}


export default function SalesQuoteComposer({
  data,
  initialQuote =
    null,
  linkedOpportunity = null,
  busy,
  onSave,
  onCancel,
}: {
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData;
  initialQuote?:
    SalesQuoteDetail |
    null;
  linkedOpportunity?: {
    id: string;
    opportunity_number: string;
    name: string;
    billing_customer_id: string | null;
    customer_name: string | null;
    contact_name: string | null;
    email: string | null;
    phone: string | null;
    currency: string;
    expected_value: number | string;
  } | null;
  busy:
    boolean;
  onSave:
    (
      payload:
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >,
    ) =>
      Promise<boolean>;
  onCancel:
    () => void;
}) {
  const [
    customerId,
    setCustomerId,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.billingCustomerId ||
      (
        data.capabilities.canUseBillingCustomers
          ? linkedOpportunity?.billing_customer_id
          : null
      ) ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    customerName,
    setCustomerName,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.customerName ||
      linkedOpportunity?.customer_name ||
      linkedOpportunity?.name ||
      linkedOpportunity?.contact_name ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    customerEmail,
    setCustomerEmail,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.customerEmail ||
      linkedOpportunity?.email ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    customerPhone,
    setCustomerPhone,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.customerPhone ||
      linkedOpportunity?.phone ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    billingAddress,
    setBillingAddress,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.billingAddress ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    shippingAddress,
    setShippingAddress,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.shippingAddress ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    reference,
    setReference,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.reference ||
      linkedOpportunity?.opportunity_number ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    currency,
    setCurrency,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.currency ||
      linkedOpportunity?.currency ||
      data.settings
        .defaultCurrency ||
      data.company
        .currency,
    );

  const [
    manualExchangeRate,
    setManualExchangeRate,
  ] =
    useState('');

  const [
    quoteDate,
    setQuoteDate,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.quoteDate ||
      new Date()
        .toISOString()
        .slice(
          0,
          10,
        ),
    );

  const [
    validUntil,
    setValidUntil,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.validUntil ||
      new Date(
        Date.now() +
        data.settings
          .defaultValidityDays *
        86400000,
      )
        .toISOString()
        .slice(
          0,
          10,
        ),
    );

  const [
    shippingTotal,
    setShippingTotal,
  ] =
    useState(
      String(
        initialQuote
          ?.shippingTotal ||
        0,
      ),
    );

  const [
    depositType,
    setDepositType,
  ] =
    useState<'none' | 'percent' | 'fixed'>(
      initialQuote?.depositType || 'none',
    );

  const [
    depositValue,
    setDepositValue,
  ] =
    useState(
      String(
        initialQuote?.depositValue || 0,
      ),
    );

  const [
    notes,
    setNotes,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.notes ||
      data.settings
        .defaultNotes ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    terms,
    setTerms,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.terms ||
      data.settings
        .termsAndConditions ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    internalNotes,
    setInternalNotes,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.internalNotes ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    templateId,
    setTemplateId,
  ] =
    useState(
      data.templates
        .find(
          item =>
            item.isDefault,
        )
        ?.id ||
      data.templates[0]
        ?.id ||
      '',
    );

  const [
    pricelistId,
    setPricelistId,
  ] =
    useState(
      initialQuote
        ?.pricelistId ||
      '',
    );


  const [
    lines,
    setLines,
  ] =
    useState<
      DraftLine[]
    >(
      initialQuote
        ?.lines
        .map(
          line => ({
            key:
              line.id,
            catalogItemId:
              line.catalogItemId ||
              '',
            description:
              line.description,
            sku:
              line.sku ||
              '',
            unit:
              line.unit,
            quantity:
              String(
                line.quantity,
              ),
            unitPrice:
              String(
                line.unitPrice,
              ),
            unitCost:
              String(
                line.unitCost ||
                0,
              ),
            discountType:
              line.discountType,
            discountValue:
              String(
                line.discountValue,
              ),
            taxName:
              line.taxName ||
              '',
            taxRate:
              String(
                line.taxRate,
              ),
          }),
        ) ||
      [
        blankLine(),
      ],
    );

  const totals =
    useMemo(
      () => {
        let subtotal =
          0;

        let discount =
          0;

        let tax =
          0;

        let cost =
          0;

        for (
          const line
          of lines
        ) {
          const qty =
            Math.max(
              0,
              Number(
                line.quantity,
              ) ||
              0,
            );

          const price =
            Math.max(
              0,
              Number(
                line.unitPrice,
              ) ||
              0,
            );

          const base =
            qty *
            price;

          const discountValue =
            Math.max(
              0,
              Number(
                line.discountValue,
              ) ||
              0,
            );

          const discountAmount =
            line.discountType ===
              'fixed'
              ? Math.min(
                  base,
                  discountValue,
                )
              : base *
                Math.min(
                  100,
                  discountValue,
                ) /
                100;

          const taxable =
            Math.max(
              0,
              base -
              discountAmount,
            );

          subtotal +=
            base;

          discount +=
            discountAmount;

          cost +=
            qty *
            Math.max(
              0,
              Number(
                line.unitCost,
              ) ||
              0,
            );

          tax +=
            taxable *
            Math.min(
              100,
              Math.max(
                0,
                Number(
                  line.taxRate,
                ) ||
                0,
              ),
            ) /
            100;
        }

        const shipping =
          Math.max(
            0,
            Number(
              shippingTotal,
            ) ||
            0,
          );

        const netRevenue =
          subtotal -
          discount;

        const margin =
          netRevenue -
          cost;

        return {
          subtotal,
          discount,
          tax,
          shipping,
          cost,
          margin,
          marginPercent:
            netRevenue >
              0
              ? margin /
                netRevenue *
                100
              : 0,
          total:
            subtotal -
            discount +
            tax +
            shipping,
        };
      },
      [
        lines,
        shippingTotal,
      ],
    );

  function patchLine(
    index:
      number,
    patch:
      Partial<DraftLine>,
  ) {
    setLines(
      current =>
        current.map(
          (
            line,
            currentIndex,
          ) =>
            currentIndex ===
              index
              ? {
                  ...line,
                  ...patch,
                }
              : line,
        ),
    );
  }

  function selectCatalog(
    index:
      number,
    value:
      string,
  ) {
    const item =
      data.catalogItems
        .find(
          candidate =>
            candidate.id ===
            value,
        );

    if (
      !item
    ) {
      patchLine(
        index,
        {
          catalogItemId:
            '',
        },
      );

      return;
    }

    patchLine(
      index,
      {
        catalogItemId:
          item.id,
        description:
          item.isVariant
            ? item.name
            : item.description ||
              item.name,
        sku:
          item.sku ||
          '',
        unit:
          item.unit ||
          'unit',
        unitPrice:
          String(
            item.unitPrice,
          ),
        unitCost:
          String(
            item.unitCost ||
            0,
          ),
        taxName:
          item.taxName ||
          '',
        taxRate:
          String(
            item.taxRate,
          ),
      },
    );
  }

  async function submit(
    event:
      React.FormEvent<
        HTMLFormElement
      >,
  ) {
    event.preventDefault();

    await onSave({
      action:
        initialQuote
          ? 'update_quote'
          : 'create_quote',
      quoteId:
        initialQuote
          ?.id,
      opportunityId:
        initialQuote
          ? undefined
          : linkedOpportunity?.id,
      billingCustomerId:
        customerId ||
        undefined,
      templateId:
        templateId ||
        undefined,
      pricelistId:
        pricelistId ||
        undefined,
      quoteDate,
      validUntil,
      currency,
      exchangeRate:
        currency !==
          data.company
            .currency &&
        manualExchangeRate
          ? Number(
              manualExchangeRate,
            )
          : undefined,
      reference,
      customerName:
        customerId
          ? undefined
          : customerName,
      customerEmail:
        customerId
          ? undefined
          : customerEmail,
      customerPhone:
        customerId
          ? undefined
          : customerPhone,
      billingAddress:
        customerId
          ? undefined
          : billingAddress,
      shippingAddress:
        customerId
          ? undefined
          : shippingAddress,
      shippingTotal:
        Number(
          shippingTotal,
        ),
      depositType,
      depositValue:
        depositType === 'none'
          ? 0
          : Number(depositValue),
      notes,
      terms,
      internalNotes,
      lines:
        lines.map(
          line => ({
            catalogItemId:
              line.catalogItemId ||
              undefined,
            description:
              line.description,
            sku:
              line.sku ||
              undefined,
            unit:
              line.unit,
            quantity:
              Number(
                line.quantity,
              ),
            unitPrice:
              Number(
                line.unitPrice,
              ),
            unitCost:
              data.capabilities
                .canManageMargin
                ? Number(
                    line.unitCost,
                  )
                : undefined,
            discountType:
              line.discountType,
            discountValue:
              Number(
                line.discountValue,
              ),
            taxName:
              line.taxName ||
              undefined,
            taxRate:
              Number(
                line.taxRate,
              ),
          }),
        ),
    });
  }

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={
        submit
      }
      className="space-y-5"
    >
      {linkedOpportunity ? (
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-blue-200/70 bg-blue-50/60 p-3 text-sm dark:border-blue-900/60 dark:bg-blue-950/20">
          <p className="font-black text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-200">
            Opportunity {linkedOpportunity.opportunity_number}
          </p>
          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300">
            Expected value: {formatMoney(Number(linkedOpportunity.expected_value || 0), linkedOpportunity.currency)}. The quote will be linked to this opportunity; review the line items and final quote total before saving.
          </p>
        </div>
      ) : null}
      <div className="grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-2">
        <section className="rounded-[22px] border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4">
          <p className="text-sm font-black">
            Customer
          </p>

          <div className="mt-3 grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
            {
              data.capabilities
                .canUseBillingCustomers &&
              data.billingCustomers
                .length >

              (
                <label className="sm:col-span-2">

                  >

                  }

                />

                  }

                  }

                    billingAddress
                  }

                    setBillingAddress
                  }
                />

                  <Input

                      shippingAddress

function Label({
  children,
}: {
  children:
    React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-400">
      {
        children
      }
    </span>
  );
}


function Input({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
  type =
    'text',
  required =
    false,
  disabled =
    false,
}: {
  label:
    string;
  value:
    string;
  onChange:
    (
      value:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  type?:
    string;
  required?:
    boolean;
  disabled?:
    boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <Label>
        {
          label
        }
      </Label>
      <input
        type={
          type
        }
        value={
          value
        }
        required={
          required
        }
        disabled={
          disabled
        }
        min={
          type ===
            'number'
            ? '0'
            : undefined
        }
        step={
          type ===
            'number'
            ? '0.01'
            : undefined
        }
        onChange={
          event =>
            onChange(
              event.target
                .value,
            )
        }
        className={"mt-1 h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 text-sm" + (disabled ? " cursor-not-allowed opacity-60" : "")}
      />
    </label>
  );
}


function Area({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  label:
    string;
  value:
    string;
  onChange:
    (
      value:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
}) {
  return (
    <label className="block">
      <Label>
        {
          label
        }
      </Label>
      <textarea
        rows={
          4
        }
        value={
          value
        }
        onChange={
          event =>
            onChange(
              event.target
                .value,
            )
        }
        className="mt-1 w-full rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm"
      />
    </label>
  );
}


function Row({
  label,
  value,
}: {
  label:
    string;
  value:
    string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
      <span className="text-slate-500">
        {
          label
        }
      </span>
      <span className="font-bold">
        {
          value
        }
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
