export function buildSalesSidebarItems(
  data:
    Awaited<
      ReturnType<
        typeof getSalesWorkspaceData
      >
    >,
) {
  const badges:
    Partial<
      Record<
        SalesRouteView,
        number
      >
    > = {
      quotes:
        data.quotes.length,
      orders:
        data.orders.length,
      customers:
        data.billingCustomers.length,
      templates:
        data.templates.length,
      catalogue:
        data.catalogItems.length,
      pricelists:
        data.pricelists.length,
    };

  return SALES_SIDEBAR_VIEWS
    .filter(
      view =>
        canAccessSalesView(
          data.capabilities,
          view,
        ),
    )
    .map(
      view => {
        const item =
          SALES_NAVIGATION[
            view
          ];

        return {
          key:
            view,
          label:
            item.label,
          href:
            item.href,
          description:
            item.description,
          sectionLabel:
            item.group,
          badge:
            badges[
              view
            ],
        };
      },
    );
}


export default async function SalesSectionPage({
  view,
}: {
  view:
    SalesRouteView;
}) {
  const currentPath =
    getSalesRoutePath(
      view,
    );

  const session =
    await requirePageSession(
      currentPath,
    );

  const [
    accountContext,
    permissionContext,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getAccountContextForUser(
        session.user.id,
        session.currentTenantId,
      ),
      getPermissionContext(),
    ]);

  const shell =
    resolveWorkspaceShellAccess({
      modules:
        accountContext.modules,
      subscription:
        accountContext.subscription,
      permissions:
        permissionContext,
    });

  if (
    !shell
      .accessibleModuleKeys
      .includes(
        'sales',
      )
  ) {
    notFound();
  }

  const [
    data,
    notificationResult,
  ] =
    await Promise.all([
      getSalesWorkspaceData(),

      getWorkspaceNotificationSummary()
        .catch(
          () => null,
        ),
    ]);

  if (
    !canAccessSalesView(
      data.capabilities,
      view,
    )
  ) {
    notFound();
  }

  const reportsAvailable = view === 'reports' && data.capabilities.canViewReports;
  const reportData = reportsAvailable
    ? await Promise.all([
        getSalesManagementInsights(),
        getSalesOpportunityFunnelData(),
        getSalesOpportunityRiskQueue(),
        getSalesPipelineOutcomeReport(),
        getSalesPipelineVelocityReport(),
        getSalesActivityExecutionReport(),
        getSalesRepresentativePerformance(),
        getSalesLeadSourceEffectiveness(),
        getSalesCommissionPerformance(),
        getSalesProductPerformance(),
        getSalesReturnFulfillmentQualityReport(),
        getSalesTargetAttainmentReport(),
        getSalesQuotationEffectivenessReport(),
        getSalesCommercialMarginQualityReport(),
      ])
    : null;
  const managementInsights = reportData?.[0] ?? null;
  const opportunityFunnel = reportData?.[1] ?? null;
  const opportunityRiskQueue = reportData?.[2] ?? null;
  const pipelineOutcomeReport = reportData?.[3] ?? null;
  const pipelineVelocityReport = reportData?.[4] ?? null;
  const activityExecutionReport = reportData?.[5] ?? null;
  const representativePerformance = reportData?.[6] ?? null;
  const leadSourceEffectiveness = reportData?.[7] ?? null;
  const commissionPerformance = reportData?.[8] ?? null;
  const productPerformance = reportData?.[9] ?? null;
  const returnFulfillmentQuality = reportData?.[10] ?? null;
  const targetAttainmentReport = reportData?.[11] ?? null;
  const quotationEffectiveness = reportData?.[12] ?? null;
  const commercialMarginQuality = reportData?.[13] ?? null;

  return (
    <SalesModuleShell
      user={
        session.user
      }
      tenant={
        accountContext.tenant
      }
      modules={
        shell.accessibleModules
      }
      appSidebarItems={
        buildSalesSidebarItems(
          data,
        )
      }
      activeSidebarKey={
        getSalesParentView(
          view,
        )
      }
      sidebarCapabilities={{
        aiEnabled:
          shell.aiAvailable,

        notificationsEnabled:
          permissionContext
            .permissionSet
            .has(
              SAMI_PERMISSIONS
                .NOTIFICATIONS_VIEW,
            ),
      }}
      unreadNotifications={
        notificationResult
          ?.unreadCount ||
        0
      }
      companyName={
        data.company.name
      }
    >
      {view === 'approvals' ? (
        <SalesApprovalsManager />
      ) : managementInsights && opportunityFunnel && opportunityRiskQueue && pipelineOutcomeReport && pipelineVelocityReport && activityExecutionReport && representativePerformance && leadSourceEffectiveness && commissionPerformance && productPerformance && returnFulfillmentQuality && targetAttainmentReport && quotationEffectiveness && commercialMarginQuality ? (
        <>
          <SalesManagementInsights
            data={managementInsights}
            currency={data.company.currency}
            metrics={{
              quoteCount: data.metrics.quoteCount,
              acceptedCount: data.metrics.acceptedCount,
              convertedCount: data.metrics.convertedCount,
            }}
          />
          <SalesOpportunityFunnel rows={opportunityFunnel} riskRows={opportunityRiskQueue} />
          <SalesPipelineOutcomes
            summaries={pipelineOutcomeReport.summaries}
            lossReasons={pipelineOutcomeReport.lossReasons}
          />
          <SalesPipelineVelocity transitions={pipelineVelocityReport.transitions} />
          <SalesActivityExecution report={activityExecutionReport} />
          <SalesRepresentativePerformance rows={representativePerformance.rows} />
          <SalesLeadSourceEffectiveness report={leadSourceEffectiveness} />
          <SalesCommissionPerformance rows={commissionPerformance.rows} />
          <SalesProductPerformance rows={productPerformance.rows} />
          <SalesReturnFulfillmentQuality report={returnFulfillmentQuality} />
          <SalesTargetAttainmentReport report={targetAttainmentReport} />
          <SalesQuotationEffectiveness report={quotationEffectiveness} />
          <SalesCommercialMarginQuality report={commercialMarginQuality} />
        </>
      ) : (
        <SalesWorkspaceClient
          initialData={data}
          initialView={view}
          userId={session.user.id}
        />
      )}
    </SalesModuleShell>
  );
}

import type { SalesTargetAttainmentReport as Report, SalesTargetAttainmentRow } from '@/lib/apps/sales/target-attainment-report';

function money(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', { style: 'currency', currency, maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return currency + ' ' + value.toLocaleString();
  }
}

function statusLabel(status: SalesTargetAttainmentRow['status']) {
  return status.replace(/_/g, ' ');
}

function scopeLabel(row: SalesTargetAttainmentRow) {
  if (row.targetScope === 'company') return 'Company';
  if (row.targetScope === 'team') return row.teamName || 'Sales team';
  return row.salespersonName || 'Salesperson';
}

function value(value: number, metric: SalesTargetAttainmentRow['metric'], currency: string) {
  return metric === 'orders' ? value.toLocaleString() : money(value, currency);
}

export default function SalesTargetAttainmentReport({ report }: { report: Report }) {
  if (!report.canViewTargets) {
    return (
      <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
        <h2 className="text-base font-black">Sales target attainment</h2>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">Target progress is hidden because your access does not include both Sales reporting and target-view permissions.</p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  const metrics: Array<SalesTargetAttainmentRow['metric']> = ['revenue', 'margin', 'orders'];

  return (
    <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-6">
      <header>
        <h2 className="text-base font-black">Sales target attainment</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
          Active targets spanning the last 90 days through the next 90 days. Revenue and margin are shown in {report.companyCurrency}; actuals stop at today. Team and salesperson results use each order’s currently assigned team and owner.
        </p>
      </header>
      {report.rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-slate-500">No active sales targets overlap this reporting window.</p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-5 space-y-6">
          {metrics.map(metric => {
            const rows = report.rows.filter(row => row.metric === metric);
            if (rows.length === 0) return null;
            return (
              <section key={metric} aria-label={metric + ' target attainment'}>
                <h3 className="mb-3 text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-slate-500">{metric === 'orders' ? 'Order volume' : metric + ' target'}</h3>
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full min-w-[900px] text-left text-sm">

'use client';

import {
  FileText,
  LayoutTemplate,
  Pencil,
  Plus,

  X,
} from 'lucide-react';

import {
  useState,
} from 'react';

import type {
  SalesWorkspaceData,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';


export default function SalesTemplatesManager({
  data,
  busy,
  request,
  showSuccess,
  showError,
}: {
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData;
  busy:
    boolean;
  request:
    (
      payload:
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >,
    ) =>
      Promise<
        Record<
          string,
          unknown
        >
      >;
  showSuccess:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
  showError:
    (
      title:
        string,
      message:
        string,
    ) =>
      void;
}) {
  const [
    templates,
    setTemplates,
  ] =
    useState(
      data.templates,
    );

  const [
    formKey,
    setFormKey,
  ] =
    useState(
      0,
    );

  const [
    editingTemplate,
    setEditingTemplate,
  ] =
    useState<(typeof data.templates)[number] | null>(null);

  async function save(
    form:
      HTMLFormElement,
  ) {
    const values =
      new FormData(
        form,
      );

    try {
      const result =
        await request({
          action:
            'save_template',
          templateId:
            editingTemplate?.id,
          name:
            values.get(
              'name',
            ),
          primaryColor:
            values.get(
              'primaryColor',
            ),
          secondaryColor:
            values.get(
              'secondaryColor',
            ),
          footerText:
            values.get(
              'footerText',
            ),
          notes:
            values.get(
              'notes',
            ),
          terms:
            values.get(
              'terms',
            ),
          isDefault:
            values.get(
              'isDefault',
            ) ===
              'on',
        });

      const id =
        typeof result.id ===
          'string'
          ? result.id
          : '';

      const name =
        String(
          values.get(
            'name',
          ) ||
          '',
        )
          .trim();

      const isDefault =
        values.get(
          'isDefault',
        ) ===
          'on';

      if (
        id &&
        name
      ) {
        setTemplates(
          current => [
            {
              id,
              name,
              isDefault,
              notes:
                String(
                  values.get(
                    'notes',
                  ) ||
                  '',
                ) ||
                null,
              terms:
                String(
                  values.get(
                    'terms',
                  ) ||
                  '',
                ) ||
                null,
              footerText:
                String(
                  values.get(
                    'footerText',
                  ) ||
                  '',
                ) ||
                null,
              primaryColor:
                String(
                  values.get(
                    'primaryColor',
                  ) ||
                  data.settings
                    .primaryColor,
                ),
              secondaryColor:
                String(
                  values.get(
                    'secondaryColor',
                  ) ||
                  data.settings
                    .secondaryColor,
                ),
            },
            ...current
              .map(
                template => ({
                  ...template,
                  isDefault:
                    isDefault
                      ? false
                      : template
                          .isDefault,
                }),
              )
              .filter(
                template =>
                  template.id !==
                  id,
              ),
          ],
        );
      }

      form.reset();
      setEditingTemplate(null);
      setFormKey(
        value =>
          value +
          1,
      );

      showSuccess(
        'Template saved',
        'The quotation template is ready for new quotations.',
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      showError(
        'Template could not be saved',
        error instanceof
          Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not save the quotation template.',
      );
    }
  }

  async function removeTemplate(

        setFormKey(value => value + 1);

'use client';

type ForecastRow = {
  horizonDays: number;
  currency: string;
  opportunityCount: number;
  openPipelineValue: number;
  weightedPipelineValue: number;
};

const HORIZONS = [
  { days: 30, label: 'Next 30 days' },
  { days: 60, label: 'Next 60 days' },
  { days: 90, label: 'Next 90 days' },
] as const;

function formatMoney(value: number, currency: string) {
  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('en-KE', {
      style: 'currency',
      currency,
      maximumFractionDigits: 2,
    }).format(value);
  } catch {
    return `${currency} ${value.toLocaleString()}`;
  }
}

export default function SalesWeightedForecast({ rows }: { rows: ForecastRow[] }) {
  return (
    <section className="sami-surface rounded-[24px] p-4 sm:p-5">
      <header>
        <h2 className="text-sm font-black">Weighted pipeline forecast</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
          Open opportunities expected to close within each horizon. Weighted value uses the opportunity probability.
          Values stay grouped by currency and are never combined across currencies.
        </p>
      </header>

      {rows.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="mt-4 rounded-xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4 text-sm text-slate-500">
          No open opportunities have an expected close date within the next 90 days. Add expected close dates to build the forecast.
        </p>
      ) : (
        <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {HORIZONS.map(horizon => {
            const horizonRows = rows.filter(row => row.horizonDays === horizon.days);
            return (
              <section key={horizon.days} className="min-w-0 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--sami-border)] p-4">
                <h3 className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em]">{horizon.label}</h3>
                {horizonRows.length === 0 ? (
                  <p className="mt-3 text-xs text-slate-500">No opportunities with a close date in this horizon.</p>
                ) : (
                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-3">
                    {horizonRows.map(row => (
                      <div key={horizon.days + '-' + row.currency} className="border-b border-[var(--sami-border)] pb-3 last:border-0 last:pb-0">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                          <span className="text-xs font-black">{row.currency}</span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">{row.opportunityCount.toLocaleString()} opportunities</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-2 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                          <div>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Open pipeline</p>
                            <p className="break-words text-sm font-bold tabular-nums">{formatMoney(row.openPipelineValue, row.currency)}</p>
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Probability-weighted</p>
                            <p className="break-words text-sm font-black tabular-nums">{formatMoney(row.weightedPipelineValue, row.currency)}</p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </section>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

'use client';

import {
  useEffect,
  useMemo,

  useTransition,
} from 'react';

  Download,
  LayoutGrid,

  Trash2,
} from 'lucide-react';

import {
  useRouter,
} from 'next/navigation';

import SaMiOverlay from '@/app/components/SaMiOverlay';

import {
  useSaMiOverlay,
} from '@/app/components/useSaMiOverlay';

import WorkspaceTutorial, {
  type WorkspaceTutorialStep,
} from '@/app/components/workspace/WorkspaceTutorial';

import SalesQuoteComposer from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesQuoteComposer';

import SalesCustomersManager from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesCustomersManager';

import SalesTemplatesManager from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesTemplatesManager';

import SalesProductCatalogueManager from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesProductCatalogueManager';

import SalesPricelistsManager from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesPricelistsManager';

import SalesAdvancedPricingManager from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesAdvancedPricingManager';

import SalesCurrenciesManager from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesCurrenciesManager';

import SalesOrganizationManager from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesOrganizationManager';

import SalesOperationsManager from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesOperationsManager';

import SalesPipelineBoard from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesPipelineBoard';

import SalesPipelineManager from '@/app/apps/sales/SalesPipelineManager';

  SalesWorkspaceData,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/types';


type View =
  | 'overview'
  | 'pipeline'
  | 'opportunities'
  | 'customers'
  | 'quotes'
  | 'newQuote'
  | 'templates'
  | 'pdfBuilder'
  | 'catalogue'
  | 'pricelists'
  | 'advancedPricing'
  | 'currencies'
  | 'orders'
  | 'organization'
  | 'operations'
  | 'reports'
  | 'settings';


type QuoteStatusView = SalesQuoteStatusView;


const QUOTE_STATUS_VIEWS: {
  key: QuoteStatusView;
  label: string;
}[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'All quotations' },
  { key: 'draft', label: 'Drafts' },
  { key: 'needs_approval', label: 'Awaiting approval' },
  { key: 'awaiting_response', label: 'Awaiting customer' },
  { key: 'accepted', label: 'Accepted' },
  { key: 'converted', label: 'Converted to order' },
  { key: 'expired', label: 'Expired' },
  { key: 'expiring_soon', label: 'Expiring in 7 days' },
  { key: 'closed_without_sale', label: 'Closed without sale' },
];


function isQuoteExpiringWithinSevenDays(
  quote: SalesWorkspaceData['quotes'][number],
) {
  if (
    (quote.status !== 'sent' && quote.status !== 'viewed') ||
    !quote.validUntil
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const parts = quote.validUntil.slice(0, 10).split('-').map(Number);
  const [year, month, day] = parts;

  if (
    parts.length !== 3 ||
    !year ||
    !month ||
    !day ||
    !Number.isFinite(year) ||
    !Number.isFinite(month) ||
    !Number.isFinite(day)
  ) {
    return false;
  }

  const now = new Date();
  const today = Date.UTC(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  const expiry = Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day);
  const daysUntilExpiry = Math.round((expiry - today) / 86_400_000);

  return daysUntilExpiry >= 0 && daysUntilExpiry <= 7;
}


function matchesQuoteStatusView(
  quote: SalesWorkspaceData['quotes'][number],
  view: QuoteStatusView,
) {
  switch (view) {
    case 'all':
      return true;
    case 'draft':
      return quote.status === 'draft';
    case 'needs_approval':
      return quote.approvalStatus === 'pending';
    case 'awaiting_response':
      return quote.status === 'sent' ||
        quote.status === 'viewed';
    case 'accepted':
      return quote.status === 'accepted';
    case 'converted':
      return quote.status === 'converted';
    case 'expired':
      return quote.status === 'expired';
    case 'expiring_soon':
      return isQuoteExpiringWithinSevenDays(quote);
    case 'closed_without_sale':
      return quote.status === 'rejected' ||
        quote.status === 'expired' ||
        quote.status === 'cancelled';
  }
}


const ORDER_STATUS_VIEWS: {
  key: SalesOrderStatusView;
  label: string;
}[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'All orders' },
  { key: 'awaiting_fulfillment', label: 'Awaiting fulfillment' },
  { key: 'partially_fulfilled', label: 'Partially fulfilled' },
  { key: 'fulfilled', label: 'Fulfilled' },
  { key: 'not_invoiced', label: 'Not invoiced' },
  { key: 'partially_invoiced', label: 'Partially invoiced' },
  { key: 'invoiced', label: 'Fully invoiced' },
];


const ORDER_SORT_OPTIONS: {
  key: SalesOrderSortBy;
  label: string;
}[] = [
  { key: 'newest', label: 'Newest order' },
  { key: 'oldest', label: 'Oldest order' },
  { key: 'value_high', label: 'Highest value' },
  { key: 'value_low', label: 'Lowest value' },
  { key: 'delivery_first', label: 'Delivery progress: lowest first' },
  { key: 'invoice_first', label: 'Invoicing progress: lowest first' },
  { key: 'customer_az', label: 'Customer A–Z' },
];


function salesOrderFulfillmentLabel(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'not_started':
      return 'Awaiting fulfillment';
    case 'partial':
      return 'Partially fulfilled';
    case 'fulfilled':
      return 'Fulfilled';
    default:
      return status.replaceAll('_', ' ');
  }
}


function salesOrderInvoiceLabel(status: string) {
  switch (status) {
    case 'not_invoiced':
      return 'Not invoiced';
    case 'partial':
      return 'Partially invoiced';
    case 'invoiced':
      return 'Fully invoiced';
    default:
      return status.replaceAll('_', ' ');
  }
}


function matchesSalesOrderView(
  order: SalesWorkspaceData['orders'][number],
  view: SalesOrderStatusView,
) {
  switch (view) {
    case 'all':
      return true;
    case 'awaiting_fulfillment':
      return order.fulfillmentStatus === 'not_started';
    case 'partially_fulfilled':
      return order.fulfillmentStatus === 'partial';
    case 'fulfilled':
      return order.fulfillmentStatus === 'fulfilled';
    case 'not_invoiced':
      return order.invoiceStatus === 'not_invoiced';
    case 'partially_invoiced':
      return order.invoiceStatus === 'partial';
    case 'invoiced':
      return order.invoiceStatus === 'invoiced';
  }
}



type SalesRegisterPage<T> = {
  rows: T[];
  offset: number;
  limit: number;
  totalCount: number;
  hasMore: boolean;
  nextOffset: number;
  queueCounts?: Record<string, number>;
};

async function requestSalesRegisterPage<T>(
  kind: 'quotes' | 'orders',
  query: URLSearchParams,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<SalesRegisterPage<T>> {
  query.set('register', kind);
  const response = await fetch('/api/apps/sales?' + query.toString(), {
    cache: 'no-store',
    signal,
  });
  const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})) as {
    success?: boolean;
    error?: string;
    register?: SalesRegisterPage<T>;
  };
  if (!response.ok || body.success !== true || !body.register) {
    throw new Error(body.error || 'Could not load the Sales register.');
  }
  return body.register;
}

  email: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  currency: string;
  expected_value: number | string;
  latest_quote_id: string | null;
  stage_type: string;
};

function money(
  value:
    number,
  currency:
    string,
) {
  try {
    return new Intl
      .NumberFormat(
        'en-KE',
        {
          style:
            'currency',
          currency,
          maximumFractionDigits:
            2,
        },
      )
      .format(
        value,
      );
  } catch {
    return (
      currency +
      ' ' +
      value.toLocaleString()
    );
  }
}


function Status({
  value,
}: {
  value:
    string;
}) {
  const success =
    [
      'accepted',
      'converted',
      'approved',
      'fulfilled',
      'invoiced',
      'closed',
    ].includes(
      value,
    );

  const danger =
    [
      'rejected',
      'expired',
      'cancelled',
    ].includes(
      value,
    );

  return (
    <span
      className={[
        'inline-flex rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-[0.08em] ring-1 ring-inset',
        success
          ? 'bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-700 ring-emerald-500/20 dark:text-emerald-300'
          : danger
            ? 'bg-red-500/10 text-red-700 ring-red-500/20 dark:text-red-300'
            : 'bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-700 ring-blue-500/20 dark:text-blue-300',
      ].join(
        ' ',
      )}
    >
      {
        value.replaceAll(
          '_',
          ' ',
        )
      }
    </span>
  );
}


function exportSales(
  data:
    SalesWorkspaceData,
  selectedQuotes?:
    SalesWorkspaceData['quotes'],
  selectedOrders?:
    SalesWorkspaceData['orders'],
) {
  const rows: (
    string |
    number |
    null |
    undefined
  )[][] = [
    [
      'Type',
      'Number',
      'Customer',
      'Status',
      'Date',
      'Currency',
      'Amount',
    ],
  ];

  const quotesToExport =
    selectedOrders
      ? []
      : selectedQuotes ??
        data.quotes;

  rows.push(
    ...quotesToExport.map(
      quote => [
        'Quotation',
        quote.quoteNumber,
        quote.customerName,
        quote.status,
        quote.quoteDate,
        quote.currency,
        quote.totalAmount,
      ],
    ),
  );

  if (selectedOrders) {
    rows.push(
      ...selectedOrders.map(
        order => [
          'Sales order',
          order.orderNumber,
          order.customerName,
          order.status,
          order.orderDate,
          order.currency,
          order.totalAmount,
        ],
      ),
    );
  } else if (!selectedQuotes) {
    rows.push(
      ...data.orders.map(
        order => [
          'Sales order',
          order.orderNumber,
          order.customerName,
          order.status,
          order.orderDate,
          order.currency,
          order.totalAmount,
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  const csv =
    rows
      .map(
        row =>
          row
            .map(
              value =>
                '"' +
                String(
                  value ??
                  '',
                )
                  .replaceAll(
                    '"',
                    '""',
                  ) +
                '"',
            )
            .join(
              ',',
            ),
      )
      .join(
        '\n',
      );

  const url =
    URL.createObjectURL(
      new Blob(
        [
          csv,
        ],
        {
          type:
            'text/csv;charset=utf-8',
        },
      ),
    );

  const anchor =
    document.createElement(
      'a',
    );

  anchor.href =
    url;

  anchor.download =
    (
      selectedQuotes
        ? 'sales-quotations-selected-'
        : selectedOrders
          ? 'sales-orders-selected-'
          : 'sales-register-'
    ) +
    new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .slice(
        0,
        10,
      ) +
    '.csv';

  document.body
    .appendChild(
      anchor,
    );

  anchor.click();
  anchor.remove();

  URL.revokeObjectURL(
    url,
  );
}


export default function SalesWorkspaceClient({
  initialData,
  initialView =
    'overview',
  userId,
}: {
  initialData:
    SalesWorkspaceData;
  initialView?:
    View;
  userId:
    string;
}) {
  const router =
    useRouter();

  const [
    view,
    setView,
  ] =
    useState<View>(
      initialView,
    );

  const [
    linkedOpportunityId,
    setLinkedOpportunityId,
  ] = useState('');

  const [
    linkedOpportunity,
    setLinkedOpportunity,
  ] = useState<LinkedOpportunity | null>(null);

  const [
    opportunityLaunchResolved,
    setOpportunityLaunchResolved,
  ] = useState(initialView !== 'newQuote');

  const [
    opportunityLaunchError,
    setOpportunityLaunchError,
  ] = useState('');

  useEffect(
    () => {
      setView(
        initialView,
      );
    },
    [
      initialView,
    ],
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialView !== 'newQuote') {
      setLinkedOpportunityId('');
      setLinkedOpportunity(null);
      setOpportunityLaunchError('');
      setOpportunityLaunchResolved(true);
      return;
    }

    const requestedId = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search)
      .get('opportunityId')
      ?.trim();

    if (!requestedId) {
      setLinkedOpportunityId('');
      setLinkedOpportunity(null);
      setOpportunityLaunchError('');
      setOpportunityLaunchResolved(true);
      return;
    }

    let cancelled = false;
    setLinkedOpportunityId(requestedId);
    setLinkedOpportunity(null);
    setOpportunityLaunchError('');
    setOpportunityLaunchResolved(false);

    void fetch('/api/apps/sales?pipeline=1', { cache: 'no-store' })
      .then(async response => {
        const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error(body.error || 'Could not load the selected opportunity.');
        }
        return body;
      })
      .then(body => {
        const opportunities = body?.pipeline?.opportunities;
        const opportunity = Array.isArray(opportunities)
          ? opportunities.find((item: LinkedOpportunity) => String(item.id) === requestedId)
          : null;
        if (!opportunity) {
          throw new Error('The opportunity is unavailable. Return to Leads & Opportunities and try again.');
        }
        if (!cancelled) setLinkedOpportunity(opportunity as LinkedOpportunity);
      })
      .catch(error => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setOpportunityLaunchError(
          error instanceof Error
            ? error.message
            : 'Could not load the selected opportunity.',
        );
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setOpportunityLaunchResolved(true);
      });

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [initialView]);

  const [
    search,
    setSearch,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    quoteStatusView,
    setQuoteStatusView,
  ] =
    useState<QuoteStatusView>(
      'all',
    );

  const [
    orderStatusView,
    setOrderStatusView,
  ] =
    useState<SalesOrderStatusView>(
      'all',
    );

  const [
    orderSortBy,
    setOrderSortBy,
  ] =
    useState<SalesOrderSortBy>(
      'newest',
    );

  const [quoteRecords, setQuoteRecords] = useState<SalesWorkspaceData['quotes']>(initialData.quotes);
  const [orderRecords, setOrderRecords] = useState<SalesWorkspaceData['orders']>(initialData.orders);
  const [quoteRegisterHasMore, setQuoteRegisterHasMore] = useState(initialData.quotes.length >= 250);
  const [orderRegisterHasMore, setOrderRegisterHasMore] = useState(initialData.orders.length >= 250);
  const [quoteRegisterTotalCount, setQuoteRegisterTotalCount] = useState(initialData.metrics.quoteCount);
  const [orderRegisterTotalCount, setOrderRegisterTotalCount] = useState(initialData.metrics.orderCount);
  const [quoteRegisterQueueCounts, setQuoteRegisterQueueCounts] = useState<Record<string, number> | null>(null);
  const [orderRegisterQueueCounts, setOrderRegisterQueueCounts] = useState<Record<string, number> | null>(null);
  const [quoteRegisterLoading, setQuoteRegisterLoading] = useState(false);
  const [orderRegisterLoading, setOrderRegisterLoading] = useState(false);
  const [quoteRegisterError, setQuoteRegisterError] = useState('');
  const [orderRegisterError, setOrderRegisterError] = useState('');
  const previousQuoteQuery = useRef('');
  const previousOrderQuery = useRef('');
  const quoteRegisterRequestId = useRef(0);
  const orderRegisterRequestId = useRef(0);
  const quoteBaseData = useRef(initialData.quotes);
  const orderBaseData = useRef(initialData.orders);

  const [
    orderDisplayMode,
    setOrderDisplayMode,
  ] =
    useState<'register' | 'cards'>(
      'register',
    );

  const [
    selectedQuoteIds,
    setSelectedQuoteIds,
  ] =
    useState<string[]>(
      [],
    );

  const [
    selectedOrderIds,
    setSelectedOrderIds,
  ] =
    useState<string[]>(
      [],
    );

  // Retain per-order invoice retry keys when a request response is interrupted.
  const bulkInvoiceIdempotencyKeys =
    useRef<Record<string, string>>(
      {},
    );

  const [
    savedOrderViews,
    setSavedOrderViews,
  ] =
    useState<SalesSavedOrderView[]>(
      [],
    );

  const [
    savedOrderViewName,
    setSavedOrderViewName,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    savedOrderViewsLoading,
    setSavedOrderViewsLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );

  const [
    savedOrderViewsError,
    setSavedOrderViewsError,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    savedQuoteViews,
    setSavedQuoteViews,
  ] =
    useState<SalesSavedQuoteView[]>(
      [],
    );

  const [
    savedViewName,
    setSavedViewName,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    savedViewsLoading,
    setSavedViewsLoading,
  ] =
    useState(
      true,
    );

  const [
    savedViewsError,
    setSavedViewsError,
  ] =
    useState(
      '',
    );

  const [
    composerOpen,
    setComposerOpen,
  ] =
    useState(
      false,
    );

  const [
    requestBusy,
    setRequestBusy,
  ] =
    useState(
      false,
    );

  const [
    pending,
    startTransition,
  ] =
    useTransition();

  const inFlight =
    useRef(
      false,
    );

  const {
    overlay,
    closeOverlay,
    showSuccess,
    showError,
    showWarning,
  } =
    useSaMiOverlay();

  const busy =
    requestBusy ||
    pending;

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadSavedViews() {
      setSavedViewsLoading(true);
      setSavedViewsError('');

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          '/api/apps/sales?savedViews=1',
          {
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            cache: 'no-store',
            headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
          },
        );
        const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

        if (!response.ok || body.success !== true) {
          throw new Error(body.error || 'Could not load saved quotation views.');
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setSavedQuoteViews(
            Array.isArray(body.savedViews)
              ? body.savedViews as SalesSavedQuoteView[]
              : [],
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setSavedViewsError(
            error instanceof Error
              ? error.message
              : 'Could not load saved quotation views.',
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setSavedViewsLoading(false);
      }
    }

    void loadSavedViews();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [initialData.company.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function loadSavedOrderViews() {
      setSavedOrderViewsLoading(true);
      setSavedOrderViewsError('');

      try {
        const response = await fetch(
          '/api/apps/sales?savedOrderViews=1',
          {
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            cache: 'no-store',
            headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
          },
        );
        const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));

        if (!response.ok || body.success !== true) {
          throw new Error(body.error || 'Could not load saved sales order views.');
        }

        if (!cancelled) {
          setSavedOrderViews(
            Array.isArray(body.savedOrderViews)
              ? body.savedOrderViews as SalesSavedOrderView[]
              : [],
          );
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (!cancelled) {
          setSavedOrderViewsError(
            error instanceof Error
              ? error.message
              : 'Could not load saved sales order views.',
          );
        }
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setSavedOrderViewsLoading(false);
      }
    }

    void loadSavedOrderViews();

    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [initialData.company.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (quoteBaseData.current !== initialData.quotes) {
      setQuoteRecords(initialData.quotes);
      setQuoteRegisterHasMore(initialData.quotes.length >= 250);
      setQuoteRegisterTotalCount(initialData.metrics.quoteCount);
    }
  }, [initialData.quotes, initialData.metrics.quoteCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (orderBaseData.current !== initialData.orders) {
      setOrderRecords(initialData.orders);
      setOrderRegisterHasMore(initialData.orders.length >= 250);
      setOrderRegisterTotalCount(initialData.metrics.orderCount);
    }
  }, [initialData.orders, initialData.metrics.orderCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (view !== 'quotes') return;
    const signature = search.trim() + '|' + quoteStatusView;
    const baseChanged = quoteBaseData.current !== initialData.quotes;
    if (signature === previousQuoteQuery.current && !baseChanged) return;
    const requestId = ++quoteRegisterRequestId.current;
    setSelectedQuoteIds([]);
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setQuoteRegisterLoading(true);
    setQuoteRegisterError('');
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        offset: '0',
        limit: '250',
        search: search.trim(),
        statusView: quoteStatusView,
      });
      void requestSalesRegisterPage<SalesWorkspaceData['quotes'][number]>('quotes', query, controller.signal)
        .then(page => {
          if (requestId !== quoteRegisterRequestId.current) return;
          previousQuoteQuery.current = signature;
          quoteBaseData.current = initialData.quotes;
          setQuoteRecords(page.rows);
          setQuoteRegisterHasMore(page.hasMore);
          setQuoteRegisterTotalCount(page.totalCount);
          setQuoteRegisterQueueCounts(page.queueCounts || {});
        })
        .catch(error => {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted && requestId === quoteRegisterRequestId.current) {
            setQuoteRegisterError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load quotations.');
          }
        })
        .finally(() => {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted && requestId === quoteRegisterRequestId.current) setQuoteRegisterLoading(false);
        });
    }, 250);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      controller.abort();
      if (requestId === quoteRegisterRequestId.current) setQuoteRegisterLoading(false);
    };
  }, [view, search, quoteStatusView, initialData.quotes, initialData.metrics.quoteCount]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (view !== 'orders') return;
    const signature = search.trim() + '|' + orderStatusView + '|' + orderSortBy;
    const baseChanged = orderBaseData.current !== initialData.orders;
    if (signature === previousOrderQuery.current && !baseChanged) return;
    const requestId = ++orderRegisterRequestId.current;
    setSelectedOrderIds([]);
    const controller = new AbortController();
    setOrderRegisterLoading(true);
    setOrderRegisterError('');
    const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        offset: '0',
        limit: '250',
        search: search.trim(),
        statusView: orderStatusView,
        sortBy: orderSortBy,
      });
      void requestSalesRegisterPage<SalesWorkspaceData['orders'][number]>('orders', query, controller.signal)
        .then(page => {
          if (requestId !== orderRegisterRequestId.current) return;
          previousOrderQuery.current = signature;
          orderBaseData.current = initialData.orders;
          setOrderRecords(page.rows);
          setOrderRegisterHasMore(page.hasMore);
          setOrderRegisterTotalCount(page.totalCount);
          setOrderRegisterQueueCounts(page.queueCounts || {});
        })
        .catch(error => {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted && requestId === orderRegisterRequestId.current) {
            setOrderRegisterError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load sales orders.');
          }
        })
        .finally(() => {
          if (!controller.signal.aborted && requestId === orderRegisterRequestId.current) setOrderRegisterLoading(false);
        });
    }, 250);
    return () => {
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
      controller.abort();
      if (requestId === orderRegisterRequestId.current) setOrderRegisterLoading(false);
    };
  }, [view, search, orderStatusView, orderSortBy, initialData.orders, initialData.metrics.orderCount]);

  async function loadMoreQuoteRecords() {
    if (quoteRegisterLoading || !quoteRegisterHasMore) return;
    const requestId = ++quoteRegisterRequestId.current;
    setQuoteRegisterLoading(true);
    setQuoteRegisterError('');
    try {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        offset: String(quoteRecords.length),
        limit: '250',
        search: search.trim(),
        statusView: quoteStatusView,
      });
      const page = await requestSalesRegisterPage<SalesWorkspaceData['quotes'][number]>('quotes', query);
      if (requestId !== quoteRegisterRequestId.current) return;
      setQuoteRecords(current => {
        const existing = new Set(current.map(row => row.id));
        return [...current, ...page.rows.filter(row => !existing.has(row.id))];
      });
      setQuoteRegisterHasMore(page.hasMore);
      setQuoteRegisterTotalCount(page.totalCount);
      setQuoteRegisterQueueCounts(page.queueCounts || {});
    } catch (error) {
      if (requestId === quoteRegisterRequestId.current) {
        setQuoteRegisterError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load more quotations.');
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestId === quoteRegisterRequestId.current) setQuoteRegisterLoading(false);
    }
  }

  async function loadMoreOrderRecords() {
    if (orderRegisterLoading || !orderRegisterHasMore) return;
    const requestId = ++orderRegisterRequestId.current;
    setOrderRegisterLoading(true);
    setOrderRegisterError('');
    try {
      const query = new URLSearchParams({
        offset: String(orderRecords.length),
        limit: '250',
        search: search.trim(),
        statusView: orderStatusView,
        sortBy: orderSortBy,
      });
      const page = await requestSalesRegisterPage<SalesWorkspaceData['orders'][number]>('orders', query);
      if (requestId !== orderRegisterRequestId.current) return;
      setOrderRecords(current => {
        const existing = new Set(current.map(row => row.id));
        return [...current, ...page.rows.filter(row => !existing.has(row.id))];
      });
      setOrderRegisterHasMore(page.hasMore);
      setOrderRegisterTotalCount(page.totalCount);
      setOrderRegisterQueueCounts(page.queueCounts || {});
    } catch (error) {
      if (requestId === orderRegisterRequestId.current) {
        setOrderRegisterError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not load more sales orders.');
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestId === orderRegisterRequestId.current) setOrderRegisterLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const visibleQuotes =
    useMemo(
      () => {
        const query =
          search
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();

        return initialData
          .quotes
          .filter(
            quote =>
              matchesQuoteStatusView(
                quote,
                quoteStatusView,
              ) &&
              (
                !query ||
                [
                  quote.quoteNumber,
                  quote.customerName,
                  quote.customerEmail || '',
                  quote.status,
                  quote.approvalStatus,
                  quote.reference ||
                  '',
                ]
                  .some(
                    value =>
                      value
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .includes(
                          query,
                        ),
                  )
              ),
          );
      },
      [
        quoteRecords,
        search,
        quoteStatusView,
      ],
    );

  const allVisibleQuotesSelected =
    visibleQuotes.length > 0 &&
    visibleQuotes.every(
      quote =>
        selectedQuoteIds.includes(
          quote.id,
        ),
    );

  const sendableSelectedQuoteIds =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        quoteRecords
          .filter(
            quote =>
              selectedQuoteIds.includes(quote.id) &&
              quote.status === 'draft' &&
              (
                quote.approvalStatus === 'approved' ||
                quote.approvalStatus === 'not_required'
              ),
          )
          .map(quote => quote.id),
      [
        quoteRecords,
        selectedQuoteIds,
      ],
    );

  const visibleOrders =
    useMemo(
      () => {
        const query =
          search
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();

        const matchingOrders = orderRecords.filter(
          order =>
            matchesSalesOrderView(order, orderStatusView) &&
            (
              !query ||
              [
                order.orderNumber,
                order.customerName,
                order.reference || '',
                order.status,
                order.fulfillmentStatus,
                order.invoiceStatus,
              ].some(value =>
                value
                  .toLowerCase()
                  .includes(query),
              )
            ),
        );

        return matchingOrders.sort((left, right) => {
          let difference = 0;

          switch (orderSortBy) {
            case 'newest':
              difference = right.orderDate.localeCompare(left.orderDate);
              break;
            case 'oldest':
              difference = left.orderDate.localeCompare(right.orderDate);
              break;
            case 'value_high':
              difference = right.baseTotalAmount - left.baseTotalAmount;
              break;
            case 'value_low':
              difference = left.baseTotalAmount - right.baseTotalAmount;
              break;
            case 'delivery_first':
              difference = left.deliveredPercent - right.deliveredPercent;
              break;
            case 'invoice_first':
              difference = left.invoicedPercent - right.invoicedPercent;
              break;
            case 'customer_az':
              difference = left.customerName.localeCompare(right.customerName);
              break;
          }

          return difference || left.orderNumber.localeCompare(right.orderNumber);
        });
      },
      [
        orderRecords,
        orderStatusView,
        orderSortBy,
        search,
      ],
    );

  const allVisibleOrdersSelected =
    visibleOrders.length > 0 &&
    visibleOrders.every(
      order => selectedOrderIds.includes(order.id),
    );

  const invoiceableSelectedOrderIds =
    useMemo(
      () =>
        orderRecords
          .filter(
            order =>
              selectedOrderIds.includes(order.id) &&
              order.status === 'confirmed' &&
              order.invoiceStatus !== 'invoiced',
          )
          .map(order => order.id),
      [
        orderRecords,
        selectedOrderIds,
      ],
    );

  async function saveCurrentQuoteView() {
    const name = savedViewName.trim();

    if (!name) {
      showWarning('Name required', 'Enter a name for this saved quotation view.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const result = await request({
        action: 'save_quote_view',
        name,
        statusView: quoteStatusView,
        searchQuery: search,
      });

      const savedView = result as unknown as SalesSavedQuoteView;
      setSavedQuoteViews(current => [
        savedView,
        ...current.filter(view => view.id !== savedView.id),
      ]);
      setSavedViewName('');
      setSavedViewsError('');
      showSuccess('View saved', 'Your quotation filters are saved to your Sales workspace.');
    } catch (error) {
      showError(
        'View could not be saved',
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not save this quotation view.',
      );
    }
  }

  function applySavedQuoteView(view: SalesSavedQuoteView) {
    setQuoteStatusView(view.statusView);
    setSearch(view.searchQuery);
    setSelectedQuoteIds([]);
  }

  async function removeSavedQuoteView(view: SalesSavedQuoteView) {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete the saved quotation view "' + view.name + '"?')) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      await request({
        action: 'delete_quote_view',
        viewId: view.id,
      });
      setSavedQuoteViews(current => current.filter(item => item.id !== view.id));
      showSuccess('Saved view deleted', 'The saved quotation view was removed.');
    } catch (error) {
      showError(
        'View could not be deleted',
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not delete this saved view.',
      );
    }
  }


  async function saveCurrentOrderView() {
    const name = savedOrderViewName.trim();

    if (!name) {
      showWarning('Name required', 'Enter a name for this saved sales order view.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      const result = await request({
        action: 'save_order_view',
        name,
        statusView: orderStatusView,
        searchQuery: search,
        sortBy: orderSortBy,
      });

      const savedView = result as unknown as SalesSavedOrderView;
      setSavedOrderViews(current => [
        savedView,
        ...current.filter(view => view.id !== savedView.id),
      ]);
      setSavedOrderViewName('');
      setSavedOrderViewsError('');
      showSuccess('View saved', 'Your sales order queue and search are saved to your workspace.');
    } catch (error) {
      showError(
        'View could not be saved',
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not save this sales order view.',
      );
    }
  }


  function applySavedOrderView(view: SalesSavedOrderView) {
    setOrderStatusView(view.statusView);
    setSearch(view.searchQuery);
    setOrderSortBy(view.sortBy);
    setSelectedQuoteIds([]);
    setSelectedOrderIds([]);
  }


  async function removeSavedOrderView(view: SalesSavedOrderView) {
    if (!window.confirm('Delete the saved sales order view "' + view.name + '"?')) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      await request({
        action: 'delete_order_view',
        viewId: view.id,
      });
      setSavedOrderViews(current => current.filter(item => item.id !== view.id));
      showSuccess('Saved view deleted', 'The saved sales order view was removed.');
    } catch (error) {
      showError(
        'View could not be deleted',
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'SaMi could not delete this saved sales order view.',
      );
    }
  }

  async function bulkSendSelectedQuotes() {
    const quoteIds = sendableSelectedQuoteIds;

    if (quoteIds.length === 0) {
      return;
    }

    if (!window.confirm(
      'Send ' + quoteIds.length +
      ' eligible draft quotation(s) to customers now? Each quotation is sent using the configured Sales delivery channel.',
    )) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      const result = await request({
        action: 'bulk_send_quotes',
        quoteIds,
      });

      const sentCount = Number(result.sentCount || 0);
      const failedCount = Number(result.failedCount || 0);
      const outcomes = Array.isArray(result.results)
        ? result.results as Array<{
            quoteId: string;
            success: boolean;
            error?: string;
          }>
        : [];
      const failures = outcomes.filter(outcome => !outcome.success);

      if (failedCount > 0) {
        setSelectedQuoteIds(
          failures
            .map(outcome => outcome.quoteId)
            .filter(Boolean),
        );
        const failureSummary = failures
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map(outcome => {
            const quote = quoteRecords.find(
              item => item.id === outcome.quoteId,
            );
            return (quote?.quoteNumber || 'Quotation') +
              ': ' + (outcome.error || 'Delivery failed');
          })
          .join(' · ');

        showWarning(
          'Some quotations were not sent',
          sentCount + ' sent; ' + failedCount + ' failed.' +
            (failureSummary ? ' ' + failureSummary : ''),
        );
      } else {
        setSelectedQuoteIds([]);
        showSuccess(
          'Quotations sent',
          sentCount + ' draft quotation(s) were sent to customers.',
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError(
        'Quotations could not be sent',
        error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not send the selected quotations.',
      );
    }
  }

  async function bulkInvoiceSelectedOrders() {
    const orderIds = invoiceableSelectedOrderIds;

    if (orderIds.length === 0) {
      showWarning(
        'No invoiceable orders selected',
        'Select confirmed orders that are not yet fully invoiced.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (orderIds.length > 25) {
      showWarning(
        'Batch is too large',
        'Invoice at most 25 sales orders at a time.',
      );
      return;
    }

    if (!window.confirm(
      'Create a separate invoice for each of the ' + orderIds.length +
      ' selected order(s)? Each order follows its own invoice policy. Successful retries reuse the original invoice.',
    )) {
      return;
    }

    const orders = orderIds.map(orderId => {
      let idempotencyKey = bulkInvoiceIdempotencyKeys.current[orderId];

      if (!idempotencyKey) {
        idempotencyKey = 'sales-bulk-' + crypto.randomUUID();
        bulkInvoiceIdempotencyKeys.current[orderId] = idempotencyKey;
      }

      return { orderId, idempotencyKey };
    });

    try {
      const result = await request({
        action: 'bulk_invoice_orders',
        orders,
      });

      const outcomes = Array.isArray(result.results)
        ? result.results as Array<{
            orderId: string;
            success: boolean;
            invoiceId?: string;
            reused?: boolean;
            error?: string;
          }>
        : [];
      const successes = outcomes.filter(outcome => outcome.success);
      const failures = outcomes.filter(outcome => !outcome.success);

      for (const outcome of successes) {
        delete bulkInvoiceIdempotencyKeys.current[outcome.orderId];
      }

      if (failures.length > 0) {
        setSelectedOrderIds(failures.map(outcome => outcome.orderId));
        const details = failures
          .slice(0, 3)
          .map(outcome => {
            const order = orderRecords.find(item => item.id === outcome.orderId);
            return (order?.orderNumber || 'Sales order') + ': ' +
              (outcome.error || 'Invoice creation failed');
          })
          .join(' · ');

        showWarning(
          'Some orders could not be invoiced',
          successes.length + ' succeeded; ' + failures.length + ' failed.' +
            (details ? ' ' + details : ''),
        );
      } else {
        setSelectedOrderIds([]);
        showSuccess(
          'Invoices created',
          successes.length + ' sales-order invoice(s) created or safely recovered.',
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError(
        'Bulk invoicing interrupted',
        (error instanceof Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not complete bulk invoicing.') +
          ' Retry the same selection; request keys are retained to prevent duplicate invoices.',
      );
    }
  }

  async function request(
    payload:
      Record<
        string,
        unknown
      >,
  ) {
    if (
      inFlight.current
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        'Another Sales action is still being saved.',
      );
    }

    inFlight.current =
      true;

    setRequestBusy(
      true,
    );

    try {
      const response =
        await fetch(
          '/api/apps/sales',
          {
            method:
              'POST',
            credentials:
              'same-origin',
            cache:
              'no-store',
            headers: {
              'Content-Type':
                'application/json',
              Accept:
                'application/json',
            },
            body:
              JSON.stringify(
                payload,
              ),
          },
        );

      const body =
        await response
          .json()
          .catch(
            () => ({}),
          ) as {
            success?:
              boolean;
            error?:
              string;
            result?:
              Record<
                string,
                unknown
              >;
          };

      if (
        !response.ok ||
        body.success !==
          true
      ) {
        throw new Error(
          body.error ||
          'SaMi could not complete the Sales action.',
        );
      }

      startTransition(
        () => {
          router.refresh();
        },
      );

      return body.result ||
        {};
    } finally {
      inFlight.current =
        false;

      setRequestBusy(
        false,
      );
    }
  }

  async function saveQuote(
    payload:
      Record<
        string,
        unknown
      >,
  ) {
    try {
      const result = await request(
        payload,
      );

      setComposerOpen(
        false,
      );

      showSuccess(
        'Quotation saved',
        linkedOpportunityId
          ? 'The quotation is linked to its opportunity.'
          : 'The commercial document was saved successfully.',
      );

      if (linkedOpportunityId && result.id) {
        router.push('/apps/sales/quotes/' + encodeURIComponent(String(result.id)));
      }

      return true;
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      const message =
        error instanceof
          Error
          ? error.message
          : 'SaMi could not save this quotation.';

      if (
        message.includes(
          'still being saved',
        )
      ) {
        showWarning(
          'Action already in progress',
          message,
        );
      } else {
        showError(
          'Quotation could not be saved',
          message,
        );
      }

      return false;
    }
  }

  return (

        }

              step.section as

              {

              >
                <RefreshCw
