import 'server-only';

import {
  hasSalesPermission,
  requireSalesContext,
  SALES_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';

export type SalesOpportunityFunnelRow = {
  stageId: string;
  stageName: string;
  sequence: number;
  stageType: 'open' | 'won' | 'lost';
  stageProbability: number;
  currency: string;
  opportunityCount: number;
  pipelineValue: number;
  weightedPipelineValue: number;
  wonValue: number;
  lostValue: number;
  overdueOpportunityCount: number;
  overdueValue: number;
  staleOpportunityCount: number;
  staleValue: number;
};

export async function getSalesOpportunityFunnelData(): Promise<SalesOpportunityFunnelRow[]> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const canViewReports = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.REPORT_VIEW,
  );

  if (!canViewReports) return [];

  const result = await context.pool.query(
    `
      SELECT
        s.id AS stage_id,
        s.name AS stage_name,
        s.sequence,
        s.stage_type,
        s.probability AS stage_probability,
        UPPER(COALESCE(
          NULLIF(BTRIM(o.currency), ''),
          NULLIF(BTRIM($2::text), ''),
          'KES'
        )) AS currency,
        COUNT(o.id)::int AS opportunity_count,
        COALESCE(
          SUM(o.expected_value) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'open'),
          0
        ) AS pipeline_value,
        COALESCE(
          SUM(
            o.expected_value
            * LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, COALESCE(o.probability, s.probability, 0)))
            / 100.0
          ) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'open'),
          0
        ) AS weighted_pipeline_value,
        COALESCE(
          SUM(o.expected_value) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'won'),
          0
        ) AS won_value,
        COALESCE(
          SUM(o.expected_value) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'lost'),
          0
        ) AS lost_value,
        COUNT(o.id) FILTER (
          WHERE s.stage_type = 'open'
            AND o.expected_close_date < CURRENT_DATE
        )::int AS overdue_opportunity_count,
        COALESCE(
          SUM(o.expected_value) FILTER (
            WHERE s.stage_type = 'open'
              AND o.expected_close_date < CURRENT_DATE
          ),
          0
        ) AS overdue_value,
        COUNT(o.id) FILTER (
          WHERE s.stage_type = 'open'
            AND COALESCE(stage_age.last_stage_at, o.created_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
        )::int AS stale_opportunity_count,
        COALESCE(
          SUM(o.expected_value) FILTER (
            WHERE s.stage_type = 'open'
              AND COALESCE(stage_age.last_stage_at, o.created_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
          ),
          0
        ) AS stale_value
      FROM sales_pipeline_stages s
      LEFT JOIN sales_opportunities o
        ON o.stage_id = s.id
        AND o.company_id = s.company_id
        AND o.company_id = $1
        AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MAX(h.created_at) AS last_stage_at
        FROM sales_opportunity_stage_history h
        WHERE h.company_id = o.company_id
          AND h.opportunity_id = o.id
          AND h.to_stage_id = o.stage_id
      ) stage_age ON TRUE
      WHERE s.company_id = $1
        AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.sequence, s.stage_type, s.probability,
        UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(o.currency), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM($2::text), ''), 'KES'))
      ORDER BY s.sequence ASC, s.name ASC, currency ASC
    `,
    [context.companyId, context.company.currentCompany.currency],
  );

  return result.rows.map(row => ({
    stageId: String(row.stage_id),
    stageName: String(row.stage_name),
    sequence: Number(row.sequence || 0),
    stageType: String(row.stage_type) as 'open' | 'won' | 'lost',
    stageProbability: Number(row.stage_probability || 0),
    currency: String(row.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase(),
    opportunityCount: Number(row.opportunity_count || 0),
    pipelineValue: Number(row.pipeline_value || 0),
    weightedPipelineValue: Number(row.weighted_pipeline_value || 0),
    wonValue: Number(row.won_value || 0),
    lostValue: Number(row.lost_value || 0),
    overdueOpportunityCount: Number(row.overdue_opportunity_count || 0),
    overdueValue: Number(row.overdue_value || 0),
    staleOpportunityCount: Number(row.stale_opportunity_count || 0),
    staleValue: Number(row.stale_value || 0),
  }));
}


export type SalesOpportunityRiskRow = {
  opportunityId: string;
  opportunityNumber: string;
  opportunityName: string;
  customerName: string;
  stageName: string;
  currency: string;
  expectedValue: number;
  probability: number;
  expectedCloseDate: string | null;
  salespersonName: string;
  daysInStage: number;
  overdue: boolean;
  missingCloseDate: boolean;
  stale: boolean;
};

export async function getSalesOpportunityRiskQueue(): Promise<SalesOpportunityRiskRow[]> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const canViewReports = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.REPORT_VIEW,
  );

  if (!canViewReports) return [];

  const result = await context.pool.query(
    `
      SELECT
        o.id AS opportunity_id,
        o.opportunity_number,
        o.name AS opportunity_name,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(o.customer_name), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM(o.contact_name), ''), 'Customer not set') AS customer_name,
        s.name AS stage_name,
        UPPER(COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(o.currency), ''), NULLIF(BTRIM($3::text), ''), 'KES')) AS currency,
        o.expected_value,
        o.probability,
        o.expected_close_date::text AS expected_close_date,
        COALESCE(owner.name, 'Unassigned') AS salesperson_name,
        GREATEST(
          0,
          FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - COALESCE(stage_age.last_stage_at, o.created_at))) / 86400)
        )::int AS days_in_stage,
        (o.expected_close_date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue,
        (o.expected_close_date IS NULL) AS missing_close_date,
        (COALESCE(stage_age.last_stage_at, o.created_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') AS stale
      FROM sales_opportunities o
      INNER JOIN sales_pipeline_stages s
        ON s.id = o.stage_id
        AND s.company_id = o.company_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MAX(h.created_at) AS last_stage_at
        FROM sales_opportunity_stage_history h
        WHERE h.company_id = o.company_id
          AND h.opportunity_id = o.id
          AND h.to_stage_id = o.stage_id
      ) stage_age ON TRUE
      LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
          tu.user_id,
          COALESCE(
            NULLIF(BTRIM(COALESCE(u.full_name, '')), ''),
            NULLIF(BTRIM(CONCAT_WS(' ', u.first_name, u.last_name)), ''),
            u.email
          ) AS name
        FROM tenant_users tu
        INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = tu.user_id
        WHERE tu.tenant_id = $2
          AND tu.status = 'active'
          AND tu.member_type = 'internal'
          AND tu.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
      ) owner ON owner.user_id = o.salesperson_user_id
      WHERE o.company_id = $1
        AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND s.stage_type = 'open'
        AND (
          o.expected_close_date < CURRENT_DATE
          OR o.expected_close_date IS NULL
          OR COALESCE(stage_age.last_stage_at, o.created_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
        )
      ORDER BY
        CASE
          WHEN o.expected_close_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 0
          WHEN COALESCE(stage_age.last_stage_at, o.created_at) < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1
          WHEN o.expected_close_date IS NULL THEN 2
          ELSE 3
        END,
        o.expected_close_date ASC NULLS LAST,
        days_in_stage DESC,
        o.expected_value DESC,
        o.id ASC
      LIMIT 50
    `,
    [context.companyId, context.tenantId, context.company.currentCompany.currency],
  );

  return result.rows.map(row => ({
    opportunityId: String(row.opportunity_id),
    opportunityNumber: String(row.opportunity_number),
    opportunityName: String(row.opportunity_name),
    customerName: String(row.customer_name || 'Customer not set'),
    stageName: String(row.stage_name),
    currency: String(row.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase(),
    expectedValue: Number(row.expected_value || 0),
    probability: Number(row.probability || 0),
    expectedCloseDate: row.expected_close_date ? String(row.expected_close_date).slice(0, 10) : null,
    salespersonName: String(row.salesperson_name || 'Unassigned'),
    daysInStage: Number(row.days_in_stage || 0),
    overdue: row.overdue === true,
    missingCloseDate: row.missing_close_date === true,
    stale: row.stale === true,
  }));
}

import 'server-only';

import {
  hasSalesPermission,
  requireSalesContext,
  SALES_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';

export type SalesPipelineOutcomeSummary = {
  currency: string;
  closedCount: number;
  wonCount: number;
  lostCount: number;
  winRate: number | null;
  wonValue: number;
  lostValue: number;
  averageDaysToWin: number | null;
  medianDaysToWin: number | null;
  averageDaysToLose: number | null;
};

export type SalesPipelineLossReason = {
  currency: string;
  reason: string;
  opportunityCount: number;
  lostValue: number;
};

export type SalesPipelineOutcomeReport = {
  summaries: SalesPipelineOutcomeSummary[];
  lossReasons: SalesPipelineLossReason[];
};

export async function getSalesPipelineOutcomeReport(): Promise<SalesPipelineOutcomeReport> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const canViewReports = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.REPORT_VIEW,
  );

  if (!canViewReports) return { summaries: [], lossReasons: [] };

  const [summaryResult, lossReasonResult] = await Promise.all([
    context.pool.query(
      `
        SELECT
          UPPER(COALESCE(
            NULLIF(BTRIM(o.currency), ''),
            NULLIF(BTRIM($2::text), ''),
            'KES'
          )) AS currency,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type IN ('won', 'lost'))::int AS closed_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS won_count,
          COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'lost' AND o.lost_at IS NOT NULL)::int AS lost_count,
          ROUND(
            100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at IS NOT NULL)
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (
                WHERE (s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at IS NOT NULL)
                   OR (s.stage_type = 'lost' AND o.lost_at IS NOT NULL)
              ), 0),
            1
          ) AS win_rate,
          COALESCE(SUM(o.expected_value) FILTER (
            WHERE s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at IS NOT NULL
          ), 0) AS won_value,
          COALESCE(SUM(o.expected_value) FILTER (
            WHERE s.stage_type = 'lost' AND o.lost_at IS NOT NULL
          ), 0) AS lost_value,
          AVG(
            GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.won_at - o.created_at)) / 86400.0)
          ) FILTER (
            WHERE s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at IS NOT NULL
          ) AS average_days_to_win,
          percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
            ORDER BY GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.won_at - o.created_at)) / 86400.0)
          ) FILTER (
            WHERE s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at IS NOT NULL
          ) AS median_days_to_win,
          AVG(
            GREATEST(0, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.lost_at - o.created_at)) / 86400.0)
          ) FILTER (
            WHERE s.stage_type = 'lost' AND o.lost_at IS NOT NULL
          ) AS average_days_to_lose
        FROM sales_opportunities o
        INNER JOIN sales_pipeline_stages s
          ON s.id = o.stage_id
          AND s.company_id = o.company_id
        WHERE o.company_id = $1
          AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (
            (s.stage_type = 'won' AND o.won_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
            OR (s.stage_type = 'lost' AND o.lost_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days')
          )
        GROUP BY 1
        ORDER BY currency
      `,
      [context.companyId, context.company.currentCompany.currency],
    ),
    context.pool.query(
      `
        WITH lost_opportunities AS (
          SELECT
            UPPER(COALESCE(
              NULLIF(BTRIM(o.currency), ''),
              NULLIF(BTRIM($2::text), ''),
              'KES'
            )) AS currency,
            COALESCE(NULLIF(BTRIM(o.lost_reason), ''), 'Reason not recorded') AS reason,
            o.expected_value
          FROM sales_opportunities o
          INNER JOIN sales_pipeline_stages s
            ON s.id = o.stage_id
            AND s.company_id = o.company_id
          WHERE o.company_id = $1
            AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND s.stage_type = 'lost'
            AND o.lost_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
        ),
        ranked_reasons AS (
          SELECT
            currency,
            reason,
            COUNT(*)::int AS opportunity_count,
            COALESCE(SUM(expected_value), 0) AS lost_value,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
              PARTITION BY currency
              ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, SUM(expected_value) DESC, reason ASC
            ) AS reason_rank
          FROM lost_opportunities
          GROUP BY currency, reason
        )
        SELECT currency, reason, opportunity_count, lost_value
        FROM ranked_reasons
        WHERE reason_rank <= 5
        ORDER BY currency, opportunity_count DESC, lost_value DESC, reason ASC
      `,
      [context.companyId, context.company.currentCompany.currency],
    ),
  ]);

  return {
    summaries: summaryResult.rows.map(row => ({
      currency: String(row.currency || context.company.currentCompany.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase(),
      closedCount: Number(row.closed_count || 0),
      wonCount: Number(row.won_count || 0),
      lostCount: Number(row.lost_count || 0),
      winRate: row.win_rate == null ? null : Number(row.win_rate),
      wonValue: Number(row.won_value || 0),
      lostValue: Number(row.lost_value || 0),
      averageDaysToWin: row.average_days_to_win == null ? null : Number(row.average_days_to_win),
      medianDaysToWin: row.median_days_to_win == null ? null : Number(row.median_days_to_win),
      averageDaysToLose: row.average_days_to_lose == null ? null : Number(row.average_days_to_lose),
    })),
    lossReasons: lossReasonResult.rows.map(row => ({
      currency: String(row.currency || context.company.currentCompany.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase(),
      reason: String(row.reason || 'Reason not recorded'),
      opportunityCount: Number(row.opportunity_count || 0),
      lostValue: Number(row.lost_value || 0),
    })),
  };
}

FILE: lib\apps\sales\pipeline-stage-rules.ts

/**
 * Terminal opportunity stages define their own probability.
 *
 * A won stage is always 100% and a lost stage is always 0%, regardless of
 * any client-supplied probability. Returning null means the caller should use
 * the normal open-stage probability validation path.
 */
export function terminalSalesOpportunityProbability(stageType: unknown): number | null {
  const type = typeof stageType === 'string' ? stageType.trim().toLowerCase() : '';
  if (type === 'won') return 100;
  if (type === 'lost') return 0;
  return null;
}

import 'server-only';

import {
  hasSalesPermission,
  requireSalesContext,
  SALES_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';

export type SalesPipelineVelocityRow = {
  fromStageId: string;
  fromStageName: string;
  toStageId: string;
  toStageName: string;
  transitionCount: number;
  opportunityCount: number;
  averageDaysInStage: number | null;
  medianDaysInStage: number | null;
  maxDaysInStage: number | null;
};

export type SalesPipelineVelocityReport = {
  transitions: SalesPipelineVelocityRow[];
};

export async function getSalesPipelineVelocityReport(): Promise<SalesPipelineVelocityReport> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const canViewReports = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.REPORT_VIEW,
  );

  if (!canViewReports) return { transitions: [] };

  const result = await context.pool.query(
    `
      WITH ordered_history AS (
        SELECT
          h.company_id,
          h.opportunity_id,
          h.from_stage_id,
          h.to_stage_id,
          h.created_at,
          o.created_at AS opportunity_created_at,
          LAG(h.created_at) OVER (
            PARTITION BY h.company_id, h.opportunity_id
            ORDER BY h.created_at, h.id
          ) AS previous_change_at,
          LAG(h.to_stage_id) OVER (
            PARTITION BY h.company_id, h.opportunity_id
            ORDER BY h.created_at, h.id
          ) AS previous_to_stage_id
        FROM sales_opportunity_stage_history h
        INNER JOIN sales_opportunities o
          ON o.id = h.opportunity_id
          AND o.company_id = h.company_id
          AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE h.company_id = $1
      ),
      transitions AS (
        SELECT
          opportunity_id,
          from_stage_id,
          to_stage_id,
          GREATEST(
            0,
            EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
              created_at - COALESCE(
                CASE
                  WHEN previous_to_stage_id = from_stage_id THEN previous_change_at
                  ELSE NULL
                END,
                opportunity_created_at
              )
            )) / 86400.0
          ) AS days_in_source_stage
        FROM ordered_history
        WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days'
          AND from_stage_id IS NOT NULL
          AND from_stage_id <> to_stage_id
      )
      SELECT
        from_stage.id AS from_stage_id,
        from_stage.name AS from_stage_name,
        to_stage.id AS to_stage_id,
        to_stage.name AS to_stage_name,
        COUNT(*)::int AS transition_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.opportunity_id)::int AS opportunity_count,
        ROUND(AVG(t.days_in_source_stage)::numeric, 1) AS average_days_in_stage,
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (
          ORDER BY t.days_in_source_stage
        ) AS median_days_in_stage,
        MAX(t.days_in_source_stage) AS max_days_in_stage
      FROM transitions t
      INNER JOIN sales_pipeline_stages from_stage
        ON from_stage.id = t.from_stage_id
        AND from_stage.company_id = $1
        AND from_stage.deleted_at IS NULL
      INNER JOIN sales_pipeline_stages to_stage
        ON to_stage.id = t.to_stage_id
        AND to_stage.company_id = $1
        AND to_stage.deleted_at IS NULL
      GROUP BY from_stage.id, from_stage.name, to_stage.id, to_stage.name
      ORDER BY
        percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.days_in_source_stage) DESC,
        COUNT(*) DESC,
        from_stage.name ASC,
        to_stage.name ASC
      LIMIT 15
    `,
    [context.companyId],
  );

  return {
    transitions: result.rows.map(row => ({
      fromStageId: String(row.from_stage_id),
      fromStageName: String(row.from_stage_name),
      toStageId: String(row.to_stage_id),
      toStageName: String(row.to_stage_name),
      transitionCount: Number(row.transition_count || 0),
      opportunityCount: Number(row.opportunity_count || 0),
      averageDaysInStage: row.average_days_in_stage == null ? null : Number(row.average_days_in_stage),
      medianDaysInStage: row.median_days_in_stage == null ? null : Number(row.median_days_in_stage),
      maxDaysInStage: row.max_days_in_stage == null ? null : Number(row.max_days_in_stage),
    })),
  };
}

import 'server-only';

import {
  hasSalesPermission,
  requireSalesContext,
  SALES_PERMISSIONS,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';

export type SalesProductPerformanceRow = {
  productKey: string;
  productName: string;
  sku: string | null;
  currency: string;
  lineCount: number;
  orderCount: number;
  quantityOrdered: number;
  quantityShipped: number;
  quantityDelivered: number;
  quantityInvoiced: number;
  netSales: number;
  discountAmount: number;
  marginAmount: number;
};

const EMPTY_REPORT: { rows: SalesProductPerformanceRow[] } = { rows: [] };

export async function getSalesProductPerformance(): Promise<{ rows: SalesProductPerformanceRow[] }> {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_VIEW);
  const canViewReports = hasSalesPermission(
    context.permissions.isOwner,
    context.permissions.permissionSet,
    SALES_PERMISSIONS.REPORT_VIEW,
  );
  if (!canViewReports) return EMPTY_REPORT;

  const result = await context.pool.query(
    `
      WITH product_rollup AS (
        SELECT
          CASE
            WHEN i.catalog_item_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'catalog:' || i.catalog_item_id::text
            WHEN i.external_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'external:' || i.external_product_id::text
            ELSE 'description:' || LOWER(BTRIM(i.description))
          END AS product_key,
          COALESCE(MAX(NULLIF(BTRIM(i.description), '')), 'Unnamed product') AS product_name,
          MAX(NULLIF(BTRIM(i.sku_snapshot), '')) AS sku,
          UPPER(COALESCE(
            NULLIF(BTRIM(o.currency), ''),
            NULLIF(BTRIM($2::text), ''),
            'KES'
          )) AS currency,
          COUNT(*)::int AS line_count,
          COUNT(DISTINCT o.id)::int AS order_count,
          COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) AS quantity_ordered,
          COALESCE(SUM(i.shipped_quantity), 0) AS quantity_shipped,
          COALESCE(SUM(i.delivered_quantity), 0) AS quantity_delivered,
          COALESCE(SUM(i.invoiced_quantity), 0) AS quantity_invoiced,
          COALESCE(SUM(i.subtotal - i.discount_amount), 0) AS net_sales,
          COALESCE(SUM(i.discount_amount), 0) AS discount_amount,
          COALESCE(SUM(i.margin_amount), 0) AS margin_amount
        FROM sales_order_items_v2 i
        INNER JOIN sales_orders_v2 o
          ON o.id = i.sales_order_id
          AND o.company_id = i.company_id
          AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
        WHERE i.company_id = $1
          AND o.company_id = $1
          AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND o.status IN ('confirmed', 'closed')
          AND o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
        GROUP BY product_key, currency
      ),
      ranked_products AS (
        SELECT product_rollup.*,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY currency
            ORDER BY net_sales DESC, order_count DESC, product_name ASC,
              sku ASC NULLS LAST, product_key ASC
          ) AS currency_rank
        FROM product_rollup
      )
      SELECT *
      FROM ranked_products
      WHERE currency_rank <= 250
      ORDER BY currency ASC, net_sales DESC, order_count DESC, product_name ASC,
        currency_rank ASC
    `,

    [context.companyId, context.company.currentCompany.currency],
  );

  return {
    rows: result.rows.map(row => ({
      productKey: String(row.product_key || 'unknown'),
      productName: String(row.product_name || 'Unnamed product'),
      sku: row.sku == null ? null : String(row.sku),
      currency: String(row.currency || context.company.currentCompany.currency || 'KES').toUpperCase(),
      lineCount: Number(row.line_count || 0),
      orderCount: Number(row.order_count || 0),
      quantityOrdered: Number(row.quantity_ordered || 0),
      quantityShipped: Number(row.quantity_shipped || 0),
      quantityDelivered: Number(row.quantity_delivered || 0),
      quantityInvoiced: Number(row.quantity_invoiced || 0),
      netSales: Number(row.net_sales || 0),
      discountAmount: Number(row.discount_amount || 0),
      marginAmount: Number(row.margin_amount || 0),
    })),
  };
}

FILE: lib\apps\sales\product-variants.ts

import 'server-only';
import crypto from 'crypto';
import type { PoolClient } from 'pg';
import { cleanText, numberInput, requireSalesContext, requireUuid, SALES_PERMISSIONS, SalesError } from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';
import { createSalesCatalogItem } from '@/lib/apps/sales/commands';

type Attribute = { name: string; value: string };
type Context = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof requireSalesContext>>;

function requireCatalogManage(context: Context) {
  if (!context.permissions.isOwner && !context.permissions.permissionSet.has('invoicing.catalog.manage')) {
    throw new SalesError('SALES_PERMISSION_REQUIRED', 'Product-variant management requires shared catalogue-management permission.', { permission: 'invoicing.catalog.manage' });
  }
}

function canManageSalesCost(context: Context) {
  return context.permissions.isOwner || context.permissions.permissionSet.has(SALES_PERMISSIONS.MARGIN_MANAGE);
}

function canViewSalesCost(context: Context) {
  return canManageSalesCost(context) || context.permissions.permissionSet.has(SALES_PERMISSIONS.MARGIN_VIEW);
}

function requireCostPermission(context: Context, value: unknown) {
  if (value !== undefined && !canManageSalesCost(context)) {
    throw new SalesError('SALES_PERMISSION_REQUIRED', 'Changing product cost requires sales margin-management permission.', { permission: SALES_PERMISSIONS.MARGIN_MANAGE });
  }
}
function normalizeAttributes(value: unknown): Attribute[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length < 1 || value.length > 12) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'A product variant needs between 1 and 12 attribute values.');
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const rows: Attribute[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < value.length; i += 1) {
    const raw = value[i];
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Variant attribute ' + String(i + 1) + ' is invalid.');
    const record = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
    const name = cleanText(record.name, 40);
    const attributeValue = cleanText(record.value, 80);
    if (!name || !attributeValue) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Every variant attribute needs both a name and a value.');
    if (seen.has(name.toLowerCase())) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Variant attribute names must be unique within a variant.');
    seen.add(name.toLowerCase());
    rows.push({ name, value: attributeValue });
  }
  return rows.sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
}
function labelFor(attributes: Attribute[]) {
  return attributes.map(item => item.name + ': ' + item.value).join(' · ').slice(0, 180);
}
function nameFor(baseName: string, label: string) {
  return cleanText(baseName + ' — ' + label, 255);
}
async function audit(client: PoolClient, context: Context, id: string, event: string, content: string, metadata: Record<string, unknown>) {
  await client.query(
    `INSERT INTO activities(company_id,user_id,model,record_id,type,content,metadata)
     VALUES ($1,$2,'sales.product.variant',$3,$4,$5,$6::jsonb)`,
    [context.companyId, context.userId, id, event, content, JSON.stringify(metadata)],
  );
}

export async function createSalesProductVariant(input: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_CREATE);
  requireCatalogManage(context);
  const baseCatalogItemId = requireUuid(input.baseCatalogItemId, 'Base product');
  const sku = cleanText(input.sku, 120);
  if (!sku) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Each product variant needs a unique SKU.');
  const attributes = normalizeAttributes(input.attributes);
  const label = labelFor(attributes);
  requireCostPermission(context, input.unitCost);
  const client = await context.pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const baseResult = await client.query(
      `SELECT id,name,item_type,description,unit,unit_price,tax_category,default_tax_rate_id,default_tax_group_id,metadata
       FROM invoicing_catalog_items WHERE id=$1 AND company_id=$2 AND item_type='product'
         AND is_active=TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR SHARE`,
      [baseCatalogItemId, context.companyId],
    );
    const base = baseResult.rows[0];
    if (!base) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Select an active product from the shared catalogue.');
    const baseMetadata = base.metadata && typeof base.metadata === 'object' && !Array.isArray(base.metadata)
      ? base.metadata as Record<string, unknown>
      : {};
    const inheritedUnitCost = numberInput(
      baseMetadata.standardCost ?? baseMetadata.unitCost ?? 0,
      'Base product cost',
      { min: 0 },
    );
    const unitCost = canManageSalesCost(context)
      ? numberInput(input.unitCost ?? inheritedUnitCost, 'Variant unit cost', { min: 0 })
      : inheritedUnitCost;
    const unitPrice = numberInput(input.unitPrice ?? base.unit_price, 'Variant unit price', { min: 0 });
    const name = nameFor(String(base.name), label);
    await client.query('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext($1), hashtext(LOWER(BTRIM($2))))', ['sales-product-variant:' + context.companyId, sku]);
    const duplicate = await client.query(
      `SELECT id FROM invoicing_catalog_items WHERE company_id=$1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
       AND LOWER(BTRIM(COALESCE(sku,'')))=LOWER(BTRIM($2)) LIMIT 1`,
      [context.companyId, sku],
    );
    if (duplicate.rows[0]) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'That SKU is already used by another active catalogue item.');
    const variantId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const metadata = { standardCost: unitCost, unitCost, salesProductVariant: { id: variantId, baseCatalogItemId, label, attributes } };
    const created = await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO invoicing_catalog_items
       (company_id,item_type,name,sku,description,unit,unit_price,tax_category,default_tax_rate_id,
        default_tax_group_id,created_by,updated_by,metadata)
       VALUES ($1,'product',$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,$10,$10,$11::jsonb) RETURNING id,name`,
      [context.companyId,name,sku,base.description||null,String(base.unit||'unit'),unitPrice,base.tax_category||null,
       base.default_tax_rate_id||null,base.default_tax_group_id||null,context.userId,JSON.stringify(metadata)],
    );
    const catalogItemId = String(created.rows[0].id);
    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO sales_product_variants
       (id,company_id,base_catalog_item_id,variant_catalog_item_id,variant_label,sku,attributes,unit_price,unit_cost,created_by,updated_by)
       VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7::jsonb,$8,$9,$10,$10)`,
      [variantId,context.companyId,baseCatalogItemId,catalogItemId,label,sku,JSON.stringify(attributes),unitPrice,unitCost,context.userId],
    );
    await audit(client,context,variantId,'sales.product.variant.created','Created product variant '+name+'.',
      {baseCatalogItemId,catalogItemId,sku,attributes,unitPrice});
    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return {variantId,id:catalogItemId,catalogItemId,baseCatalogItemId,name,variantLabel:label,sku,attributes,unitPrice,...(canViewSalesCost(context) ? { unitCost } : {}),isVariant:true};
  } catch(error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK').catch(()=>undefined);
    throw error;
  } finally { client.release(); }
}

export async function updateSalesProductVariant(input: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_EDIT);
  requireCatalogManage(context);
  const variantId = requireUuid(input.variantId, 'Product variant');
  const sku = cleanText(input.sku, 120);
  if (!sku) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Each product variant needs a unique SKU.');
  const attributes = normalizeAttributes(input.attributes);
  const label = labelFor(attributes);
  const client = await context.pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const currentResult = await client.query(
      `SELECT v.id,v.base_catalog_item_id,v.variant_catalog_item_id,v.unit_price,v.unit_cost,
              b.name AS base_name,b.description AS base_description,b.unit,b.tax_category,
              b.default_tax_rate_id,b.default_tax_group_id
       FROM sales_product_variants v
       INNER JOIN invoicing_catalog_items b ON b.id=v.base_catalog_item_id AND b.company_id=v.company_id
         AND b.is_active=TRUE AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
       INNER JOIN invoicing_catalog_items i ON i.id=v.variant_catalog_item_id AND i.company_id=v.company_id
       WHERE v.id=$1 AND v.company_id=$2 AND v.is_active=TRUE AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
         AND i.is_active=TRUE AND i.deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF v,i`,
      [variantId,context.companyId],
    );
    const current = currentResult.rows[0];
    if (!current) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'The active product variant was not found.');
    const unitPrice = numberInput(input.unitPrice ?? current.unit_price,'Variant unit price',{min:0});
    requireCostPermission(context, input.unitCost);
    const unitCost = canManageSalesCost(context)
      ? numberInput(input.unitCost ?? current.unit_cost,'Variant unit cost',{min:0})
      : Number(current.unit_cost ?? 0);
    const name = nameFor(String(current.base_name),label);
    await client.query('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext($1), hashtext(LOWER(BTRIM($2))))',['sales-product-variant:'+context.companyId,sku]);
    const duplicate = await client.query(
      `SELECT id FROM invoicing_catalog_items WHERE company_id=$1 AND id<>$2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
       AND LOWER(BTRIM(COALESCE(sku,'')))=LOWER(BTRIM($3)) LIMIT 1`,
      [context.companyId,current.variant_catalog_item_id,sku],
    );
    if (duplicate.rows[0]) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT','That SKU is already used by another active catalogue item.');
    const metadata = { standardCost:unitCost, unitCost, salesProductVariant:{id:variantId,baseCatalogItemId:current.base_catalog_item_id,label,attributes} };
    await client.query(
      `UPDATE invoicing_catalog_items SET name=$3,sku=$4,description=$5,unit=$6,unit_price=$7,tax_category=$8,
        default_tax_rate_id=$9,default_tax_group_id=$10,metadata=COALESCE(metadata,'{}'::jsonb)||$11::jsonb,
        updated_by=$12,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1 AND company_id=$2 AND is_active=TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [current.variant_catalog_item_id,context.companyId,name,sku,current.base_description||null,String(current.unit||'unit'),
       unitPrice,current.tax_category||null,current.default_tax_rate_id||null,current.default_tax_group_id||null,JSON.stringify(metadata),context.userId],
    );
    await client.query(
      `UPDATE sales_product_variants SET variant_label=$3,sku=$4,attributes=$5::jsonb,unit_price=$6,unit_cost=$7,
        updated_by=$8,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1 AND company_id=$2 AND is_active=TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [variantId,context.companyId,label,sku,JSON.stringify(attributes),unitPrice,unitCost,context.userId],
    );
    await audit(client,context,variantId,'sales.product.variant.updated','Updated product variant '+name+'.',
      {variantId,sku,attributes,unitPrice});
    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return {variantId,id:String(current.variant_catalog_item_id),catalogItemId:String(current.variant_catalog_item_id),
      baseCatalogItemId:String(current.base_catalog_item_id),name,variantLabel:label,sku,attributes,unitPrice,...(canViewSalesCost(context) ? { unitCost } : {}),isVariant:true};
  } catch(error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK').catch(()=>undefined);
    throw error;
  } finally { client.release(); }
}

export async function archiveSalesProductVariant(input: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_EDIT);
  requireCatalogManage(context);
  const variantId = requireUuid(input.variantId,'Product variant');
  const client = await context.pool.connect();
  try {
    await client.query('BEGIN');
    const result = await client.query(
      `SELECT id,variant_catalog_item_id,variant_label,sku FROM sales_product_variants
       WHERE id=$1 AND company_id=$2 AND is_active=TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE`,
      [variantId,context.companyId],
    );
    const variant=result.rows[0];
    if(!variant) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT','The active product variant was not found.');
    await client.query(
      `UPDATE invoicing_catalog_items SET is_active=FALSE,deleted_at=NOW(),updated_by=$3,updated_at=NOW()
       WHERE id=$1 AND company_id=$2 AND is_active=TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [variant.variant_catalog_item_id,context.companyId,context.userId],
    );
    await client.query(
      `UPDATE sales_product_variants SET is_active=FALSE,deleted_at=NOW(),updated_by=$3,updated_at=NOW()
       WHERE id=$1 AND company_id=$2 AND is_active=TRUE AND deleted_at IS NULL`,
      [variantId,context.companyId,context.userId],
    );
    await audit(client,context,variantId,'sales.product.variant.archived','Archived product variant '+String(variant.variant_label)+'.',
      {variantId,sku:variant.sku,catalogItemId:variant.variant_catalog_item_id});
    await client.query('COMMIT');
    return {variantId,catalogItemId:String(variant.variant_catalog_item_id),archived:true};
  } catch(error) {
    await client.query('ROLLBACK').catch(()=>undefined);
    throw error;
  } finally { client.release(); }
}

function parseImportedVariantAttributes(value: unknown): unknown {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value;
  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim()) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Variant rows need variantAttributes, for example Color=Blue|Size=Large.');
  }
  const raw = value.trim();
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) return parsed;
  } catch {
    // Accept a human-editable delimited form as well as JSON exported by SaMi.
  }
  return raw.split(/[|\r\n;]+/).map(part => {
    const separator = part.indexOf('=');
    if (separator < 1) {
      throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Use attribute=value pairs for variantAttributes.');
    }
    return {
      name: part.slice(0, separator).trim(),
      value: part.slice(separator + 1).trim(),
    };
  }).filter(part => part.name && part.value);
}

export async function bulkImportSalesCatalogItems(input: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const context = await requireSalesContext(SALES_PERMISSIONS.QUOTE_CREATE);
  requireCatalogManage(context);
  const rows = input.items;
  if (!Array.isArray(rows) || rows.length < 1 || rows.length > 200) {
    throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Upload between 1 and 200 catalogue rows per import.');
  }

  const results: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
  for (let index = 0; index < rows.length; index += 1) {
    const rowNumber = index + 2;
    const raw = rows[index];
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) {
      results.push({ row: rowNumber, success: false, error: 'Invalid row data.' });
      continue;
    }

    const row = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
    const sku = cleanText(row.sku, 120);
    const unit = cleanText(row.unit, 40) || 'unit';
    const description = cleanText(row.description, 4000);
    const baseProductSku = cleanText(row.baseProductSku, 120);

    try {
      if (baseProductSku) {
        if (!sku) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Each product variant needs a unique SKU.');
        const baseResult = await context.pool.query(
          "SELECT item.id " +
          "FROM invoicing_catalog_items item " +
          "WHERE item.company_id=$1 AND item.item_type='product' " +
          "AND item.is_active=TRUE AND item.deleted_at IS NULL " +
          "AND LOWER(BTRIM(COALESCE(item.sku,'')))=LOWER(BTRIM($2)) " +
          "AND NOT EXISTS (" +
          "SELECT 1 FROM sales_product_variants variant " +
          "WHERE variant.company_id=item.company_id " +
          "AND variant.variant_catalog_item_id=item.id AND variant.deleted_at IS NULL) " +
          "LIMIT 1",
          [context.companyId, baseProductSku],
        );
        const base = baseResult.rows[0];
        if (!base) {
          throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Base product SKU "' + baseProductSku + '" was not found in this company catalogue. Import the base product first.');
        }
        const optionalUnitCost = cleanText(row.unitCost, 60);
        const created = await createSalesProductVariant({
          baseCatalogItemId: String(base.id),
          sku,
          attributes: parseImportedVariantAttributes(row.variantAttributes ?? row.attributes),
          ...(cleanText(row.unitPrice, 60) ? { unitPrice: row.unitPrice } : {}),
          ...(optionalUnitCost ? { unitCost: optionalUnitCost } : {}),
        });
        results.push({ row: rowNumber, success: true, id: created.catalogItemId, name: created.name, sku, isVariant: true });
        continue;
      }

      const name = cleanText(row.name, 255);
      if (!name) throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Item name is required.');
      const rawType = cleanText(row.itemType, 30).toLowerCase();
      const itemType = rawType || 'product';
      if (itemType !== 'product' && itemType !== 'service') {
        throw new SalesError('INVALID_INPUT', 'Item type must be product or service.');
      }
      const unitPrice = numberInput(row.unitPrice ?? 0, 'Unit price', { min: 0 });
      const optionalUnitCost = cleanText(row.unitCost, 60);
      const created = await createSalesCatalogItem({
        itemType,
        name,
        sku,
        unit,
        description,
        unitPrice,
        taxRateId: cleanText(row.taxRateId, 120) || undefined,
        ...(optionalUnitCost ? { unitCost: optionalUnitCost } : {}),
      });
      results.push({ row: rowNumber, success: true, id: created.id, name: created.name, sku, isVariant: false });
    } catch (error) {
      results.push({
        row: rowNumber,
        success: false,
        name: cleanText(row.name, 255) || undefined,
        sku: sku || undefined,
        error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Could not create this catalogue row.',
      });
    }
  }

  const created = results.filter(row => row.success === true).length;
  return { total: rows.length, created, failed: rows.length - created, results };
}

import 'server-only';

import { assertSalesQuoteApprovalSatisfied } from '@/lib/apps/sales/approvals';
import { SALES_QUOTE_ELECTRONIC_SIGNATURE_CONSENT } from '@/lib/apps/sales/signature';

import {
  isSalesQuoteExpired,
  salesDateOnly,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/date-utils';
import { expirePublicSalesQuoteWithAudit } from '@/lib/apps/sales/public-quote-expiry';

import crypto from 'crypto';

import {
  getTenantPoolByTenantId,
} from '@/lib/db/tenant';

import {
  money,
  nullableText,
  recordSalesActivity,
  SalesError,
  UUID_RE,
} from '@/lib/apps/sales/context';


function sha256(
  value:
    string,
) {
  return crypto
    .createHash(
      'sha256',
    )
    .update(
      value,
    )
    .digest(
      'hex',
    );
}


function assertToken(
  token:
    string,
) {
  if (
    typeof token !==
      'string' ||
    token.length <
      32 ||
    token.length >
      200
  ) {
    throw new SalesError(
      'QUOTE_NOT_FOUND',
      'Quote was not found.',
    );
  }
}


type PublicSalesQuotePageDependencies = {
  getTenantPoolByTenantId: typeof getTenantPoolByTenantId;
  expirePublicSalesQuoteWithAudit: typeof expirePublicSalesQuoteWithAudit;
  recordSalesActivity: typeof recordSalesActivity;
};

const defaultPublicSalesQuotePageDependencies: PublicSalesQuotePageDependencies = {
  getTenantPoolByTenantId,
  expirePublicSalesQuoteWithAudit,
  recordSalesActivity,
};


export async function getPublicSalesQuote(
  tenantId:
    string,
  token:
    string,
  options: {
    markViewed?: boolean;
  } = {},
  overrides: Partial<PublicSalesQuotePageDependencies> = {},
) {
  const dependencies: PublicSalesQuotePageDependencies = {
    ...defaultPublicSalesQuotePageDependencies,
    ...overrides,
  };

  assertToken(
    token,
  );

  const pool =
    await dependencies.getTenantPoolByTenantId(
      tenantId,
    );

  const tokenHash =
    sha256(
      token,
    );

  const result =
    await pool.query(
      `
        SELECT
          q.id,
          q.company_id,
          q.quote_number,
          q.status,
          q.quote_date,
          q.valid_until,
          q.currency,
          q.reference,
          q.customer_name,
          q.customer_email,
          q.customer_phone,
          q.customer_tax_id,
          q.billing_address,
          q.subtotal,
          q.discount_total,
          q.tax_total,
          q.shipping_total,
          q.total_amount,
          q.deposit_type,
          q.deposit_value,
          q.notes,
          q.terms,
          q.sales_order_id,
          q.latest_invoice_id,
          q.viewed_at,
          c.name
            AS company_name,
          c.email
            AS company_email,
          c.phone
            AS company_phone,
          c.address
            AS company_address,
          c.tax_id
            AS company_tax_id,
          c.registration_number
            AS company_registration_number,
          COALESCE(
            t.primary_color,
            s.primary_color,
            '#164a9f'
          )
            AS primary_color,
          COALESCE(
            t.secondary_color,
            s.secondary_color,
            '#0f172a'
          )
            AS secondary_color,
          COALESCE(
            t.footer_text,
            s.footer_text
          )
            AS footer_text,
          COALESCE(
            s.allow_online_acceptance,
            TRUE
          )
            AS allow_online_acceptance,
          COALESCE(
            s.allow_online_rejection,
            TRUE
          )
            AS allow_online_rejection
        FROM sales_quotes q
        INNER JOIN companies c
          ON c.id =
             q.company_id
        LEFT JOIN sales_quote_templates t
          ON t.id =
             q.template_id
         AND t.company_id =
             q.company_id
         AND t.deleted_at
             IS NULL
        LEFT JOIN sales_settings s
          ON s.company_id =
             q.company_id
        WHERE q.public_token_hash =
              $1
          AND q.public_enabled =
              TRUE
          AND q.deleted_at
              IS NULL
        LIMIT 1
      `,
      [
        tokenHash,
      ],
    );

  if (
    result.rows.length !==
      1
  ) {
    throw new SalesError(
      'QUOTE_NOT_FOUND',
      'Quote was not found.',
    );
  }

  const quote =
    result.rows[0];

  const today =
    new Date()
      .toISOString()
      .slice(
        0,
        10,
      );

  let status =
    String(
      quote.status,
    );

  if (
    [
      'sent',
      'viewed',
    ].includes(
      status,
    ) &&
    isSalesQuoteExpired(
      quote.valid_until,
      today,
    )
  ) {
    const client = await pool.connect();

    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');

      // Re-read under a row lock. A customer acceptance/rejection may have
      // committed after the initial public-page SELECT.
      const currentResult = await client.query(
        `
          SELECT status, valid_until
          FROM sales_quotes
          WHERE id = $1
            AND company_id = $2
            AND deleted_at IS NULL
          FOR UPDATE
        `,
        [quote.id, quote.company_id],
      );

      if (currentResult.rows.length !== 1) {
        throw new SalesError(
          'QUOTE_NOT_FOUND',
          'Quote was not found.',
        );
      }

      const currentStatus = String(currentResult.rows[0].status);
      quote.valid_until = currentResult.rows[0].valid_until;
      if (
        ['sent', 'viewed'].includes(currentStatus) &&
        isSalesQuoteExpired(currentResult.rows[0].valid_until, today)
      ) {
        const expired = await dependencies.expirePublicSalesQuoteWithAudit(
          client,
          {
            quoteId: String(quote.id),
            companyId: String(quote.company_id),
            quoteNumber: String(quote.quote_number),
            fromStatus: currentStatus as 'sent' | 'viewed',
            source: 'public_quote_view',
          },
          dependencies.recordSalesActivity,
        );

        if (expired) {
          status = 'expired';
        } else {
          // The source status changed despite the lock/compare-and-set; show the
          // latest persisted status and never claim an expiry that did not occur.
          const latest = await client.query(
            `
              SELECT status
              FROM sales_quotes
              WHERE id = $1
                AND company_id = $2
            `,
            [quote.id, quote.company_id],
          );
          status = latest.rows[0] ? String(latest.rows[0].status) : currentStatus;
        }
      } else {
        // The state may have advanced to accepted/rejected while this request
        // was waiting for the lock; reflect the database state, not stale data.
        status = currentStatus;
      }

      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (error) {
      try {
        await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      } catch {}
      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  } else if (
    options.markViewed !==
      false &&
    status ===
      'sent'
  ) {
    const client =
      await pool.connect();

    try {
      await client.query(
        'BEGIN',
      );

      const changed =
        await client.query(
          `
            UPDATE sales_quotes
            SET
              status = 'viewed',
              viewed_at =
                COALESCE(
                  viewed_at,
                  NOW()
                ),
              updated_at =
                NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
              AND company_id = $2
              AND status = 'sent'
            RETURNING id
          `,
          [
            quote.id,
            quote.company_id,
          ],
        );

      if (
        changed.rows.length >
          0
      ) {
        await client.query(
          `
            INSERT INTO sales_quote_status_history (
              quote_id,
              company_id,
              from_status,
              to_status,
              reason,
              changed_by
            )
            VALUES (
              $1,$2,
              'sent',
              'viewed',
              'Viewed by customer',
              NULL
            )
          `,
          [
            quote.id,
            quote.company_id,
          ],
        );

        await dependencies.recordSalesActivity(
          client,
          {
            companyId:
              String(
                quote.company_id,
              ),
            userId:
              null,
            quoteId:
              String(
                quote.id,
              ),
            type:
              'sales.quote.viewed',
            content:
              'Quote ' +
              String(
                quote.quote_number,
              ) +
              ' viewed by customer.',
          },
        );

        status =
          'viewed';
      }

      await client.query(
        'COMMIT',
      );
    } catch (
      error
    ) {
      try {
        await client.query(
          'ROLLBACK',
        );
      } catch {}

      throw error;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }

  const lines =
    await pool.query(
      `
        SELECT
          description,
          sku_snapshot,
          unit,
          quantity,
          unit_price,
          discount_type,
          discount_value,
          discount_amount,
          tax_name_snapshot,
          tax_rate,
          tax_amount,
          subtotal,
          line_total
        FROM sales_quote_items
        WHERE quote_id = $1
          AND company_id = $2
        ORDER BY
          sort_order,
          id
      `,
      [
        quote.id,
        quote.company_id,
      ],
    );

  const optionalItems =
    await pool.query(
      `
        SELECT
          id,
          catalog_item_id,
          description,
          sku_snapshot,
          unit,
          quantity,
          unit_price,
          tax_name_snapshot,
          tax_rate,
          is_selected
        FROM sales_quote_optional_items
        WHERE quote_id = $1
          AND company_id = $2
        ORDER BY
          sort_order,
          id
      `,
      [
        quote.id,
        quote.company_id,
      ],
    );

  return {
    tenantId,
    token,
    id:
      String(
        quote.id,
      ),
    quoteNumber:
      String(
        quote.quote_number,
      ),
    status,
    quoteDate:
      salesDateOnly(quote.quote_date) ||
      String(quote.quote_date).slice(0, 10),
    validUntil:
      salesDateOnly(quote.valid_until),
    currency:
      String(
        quote.currency,
      ),
    reference:
      quote.reference
        ? String(
            quote.reference,
          )
        : null,
    subtotal:
      money(
        quote.subtotal,
      ),
    discountTotal:
      money(
        quote.discount_total,
      ),
    taxTotal:
      money(
        quote.tax_total,
      ),
    shippingTotal:
      money(
        quote.shipping_total,
      ),
    depositType:
      quote.deposit_type === 'percent'
        ? 'percent'
        : quote.deposit_type === 'fixed'
          ? 'fixed'
          : 'none',
    depositValue:
      money(quote.deposit_value),
    depositRequiredAmount:
      quote.deposit_type === 'percent'
        ? money(money(quote.total_amount) * money(quote.deposit_value) / 100)
        : quote.deposit_type === 'fixed'
          ? Math.min(money(quote.total_amount), money(quote.deposit_value))
          : 0,
    totalAmount:
      money(
        quote.total_amount,
      ),
    notes:
      quote.notes
        ? String(
            quote.notes,
          )
        : null,
    terms:
      quote.terms
        ? String(
            quote.terms,
          )
        : null,
    salesOrderId:
      quote.sales_order_id
        ? String(
            quote.sales_order_id,
          )
        : null,
    latestInvoiceId:
      quote.latest_invoice_id
        ? String(
            quote.latest_invoice_id,
          )
        : null,
    customer: {
      name:
        String(
          quote.customer_name,
        ),
      email:
        quote.customer_email
          ? String(
              quote.customer_email,
            )
          : null,
      phone:
        quote.customer_phone
          ? String(
              quote.customer_phone,
            )
          : null,
      taxId:
        quote.customer_tax_id
          ? String(
              quote.customer_tax_id,
            )
          : null,
      billingAddress:
        quote.billing_address
          ? String(
              quote.billing_address,
            )
          : null,
    },
    company: {
      name:
        String(
          quote.company_name,
        ),
      email:
        quote.company_email
          ? String(
              quote.company_email,
            )
          : null,
      phone:
        quote.company_phone
          ? String(
              quote.company_phone,
            )
          : null,
      address:
        quote.company_address
          ? String(
              quote.company_address,
            )
          : null,
      taxId:
        quote.company_tax_id
          ? String(
              quote.company_tax_id,
            )
          : null,
      registrationNumber:
        quote.company_registration_number
          ? String(
              quote.company_registration_number,
            )
          : null,
    },
    portal: {

            ),
          quantity:
            Number(
              line.quantity,
            ),
          unitPrice:
            money(
              line.unit_price,
            ),
          discountType:
            line.discount_type ===
              'fixed'
              ? 'fixed'
              : 'percent',
          discountValue:
            money(
              line.discount_value,
            ),
          discountAmount:
            money(
              line.discount_amount,
            ),
          taxName:
            line.tax_name_snapshot
              ? String(
                  line.tax_name_snapshot,

              : null,
          taxRate:

              line.tax_rate,

            money(
