test('Sales quote-to-order is transaction-safe, idempotent, and invoice permission is checked before side effects', async () => {
  const commands =
    await source(
      'lib/apps/sales/commands.ts',
    );

  const transactionStart =
    commands.indexOf(
      'export async function createSalesOrderFromQuoteTransaction(',
    );
  const orderStart =
    commands.indexOf(
      'export async function createSalesOrderFromQuote(',
      transactionStart,
    );
  const invoiceStart =
    commands.indexOf(
      'export async function convertSalesQuoteToInvoice(',
      orderStart,
    );
  const fulfillmentStart =
    commands.indexOf(
      'export async function updateSalesOrderFulfillment(',
      invoiceStart,
    );

  assert.ok(transactionStart >= 0 && orderStart > transactionStart && invoiceStart > orderStart && fulfillmentStart > invoiceStart);

  const quoteToOrder =
    commands.slice(
      transactionStart,
      invoiceStart,
    );

  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /await client\.query\(\s*'BEGIN'/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /pg_advisory_xact_lock/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /FOR UPDATE/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /row\.sales_order_id/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /quote_id = \$3/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /This quote references a missing, deleted, or mismatched sales order/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /A sales order already references this quotation but the quotation link is missing/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /Resolve the existing order link before retrying conversion/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /This quotation is marked converted but has no linked sales order/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /Resolve the record before retrying conversion/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /INSERT INTO sales_order_items_v2/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /sales_order_id = \$3/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /Complete internal quotation approval before creating a sales order/);
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /salesDateOnly\(row\.exchange_rate_date\)/,
    'PostgreSQL DATE values must be normalized before they are written into order exchange-rate dates');
  assert.match(quoteToOrder, /ROLLBACK/);

  const quoteToInvoice =
    commands.slice(
      invoiceStart,
      fulfillmentStart,
    );
  const permissionCheck =
    quoteToInvoice.indexOf(
      'await requireSalesContext(',
    );
  const orderManagePermission =
    quoteToInvoice.indexOf(
      '.ORDER_MANAGE',
      permissionCheck,
    );
  const orderCreation =
    quoteToInvoice.indexOf(
      'await createSalesOrderFromQuote(',
    );

  assert.ok(permissionCheck >= 0);
  assert.ok(orderManagePermission > permissionCheck);
  assert.ok(orderCreation > orderManagePermission,
    'Invoice permission must be confirmed before the quote is converted into an order.');
});

  );

  assert.match(

  );

test('Sales bulk quotation sending is permission-gated, capped, sequential and reports per-quotation outcomes', async () => {
  const [bulk, commands, delivery, service, route, ui] = await Promise.all([
    source('lib/apps/sales/bulk-send.ts'),
    source('lib/apps/sales/commands.ts'),
    source('lib/apps/sales/delivery.ts'),
    source('lib/apps/sales/service.ts'),
    source('app/api/apps/sales/route.ts'),
    source('app/apps/sales/SalesWorkspaceClient.tsx'),
  ]);

  assert.match(bulk, /requireSalesContext\(SALES_PERMISSIONS\.QUOTE_SEND\)/);
  assert.match(bulk, /MAX_BULK_QUOTE_SEND = 50/);
  assert.match(bulk, /requireUuid\(value, 'Quotation'\)/);
  assert.match(bulk, /new Set/);

test('Sales invoice selection rejects duplicate and non-order line IDs', async () => {
  const commands =
    await source(
      'lib/apps/sales/commands.ts',
    );

  const invoiceStart =
    commands.indexOf(
      'export async function createSalesOrderInvoiceTransaction(',
    );
  const invoiceEnd =
    commands.indexOf(
      'export async function updateSalesSettings(',
      invoiceStart,
    );
  const invoice =
    commands.slice(
      invoiceStart,
      invoiceEnd,
    );

  assert.ok(invoiceStart >= 0);
  assert.ok(invoiceEnd > invoiceStart);
  assert.match(invoice, /requestedMap\.has\(lineId\)/);
  assert.match(invoice, /'Sales order line',[\s\S]*\)\.toLowerCase\(\)/);
  assert.match(invoice, /An invoice line can only be selected once/);
  assert.match(invoice, /new Set\([\s\S]*lineRows\.map\([\s\S]*String\(line\.id\)/);
  assert.match(invoice, /orderLineIds\.has\(requestedLineId\)/);
  assert.match(invoice, /An invoice line does not belong to this sales order/);
  assert.match(invoice, /existingBatch\.rows\[0\]\.requested_lines/);
  assert.match(invoice, /normalizeSelection/);
  assert.match(invoice, /JSON\.stringify\(priorSelection\) !== JSON\.stringify\(currentSelection\)/);
  assert.match(invoice, /This invoice batch was started with a different line selection/);
  assert.match(invoice, /hasExplicitLineSelection/);
  assert.match(invoice, /hasExplicitLineSelection &&\s*requestedMap\.size === 0/);
  assert.match(invoice, /Choose at least one invoiceable line with a quantity greater than zero/);
  assert.match(invoice, /const invoiceableLineCount =\s*lineRows\.filter/);
  assert.match(invoice, /selected\.length !== invoiceableLineCount/);
  assert.match(invoice, /normalizeIdempotentSelection/);
  assert.match(invoice, /idempotency key already belongs to an invoice with a different line selection/);
  assert.match(invoice, /mode: hasExplicitLineSelection\s*\?\s*'explicit'\s*:\s*'all_remaining'/);
  assert.match(invoice, /else if \(storedMode === 'explicit'\)/,
    'an omitted retry selection cannot replay a completed partial invoice');
  assert.match(invoice, /storedMode !== null && storedMode !== currentMode/,
    'pending invoice-batch recovery must preserve the original selection mode');
  const completedBatchGuardStart = invoice.indexOf(
    'if (\n      existingBatch.rows.length > 0 &&\n      existingBatch.rows[0].invoice_id',
  );
  const completedBatchReturn = invoice.indexOf('reused:\n          true', completedBatchGuardStart);
  assert.ok(completedBatchGuardStart >= 0 && completedBatchReturn > completedBatchGuardStart);
  const completedBatchGuard = invoice.slice(completedBatchGuardStart, completedBatchReturn);
  assert.doesNotMatch(completedBatchGuard, /input\.lines\.length > 0/,
    'empty explicit selections must be rejected instead of bypassing idempotency validation');
  assert.match(completedBatchGuard, /if \(Array\.isArray\(input\.lines\)\)/);
  assert.ok(
    invoice.indexOf('normalizeIdempotentSelection(storedLines)') <
      invoice.indexOf('return {\n        orderId,\n        invoiceId:'),
    'A completed batch must validate any explicitly supplied retry selection before returning the existing invoice.',
  );

  const fulfillmentStart =
    commands.indexOf(
      'export async function updateSalesOrderFulfillmentTransaction(',
    );
  const cancelStart =
    commands.indexOf(
      'export async function cancelSalesOrder(',
    );
  const createInvoiceStart =
    commands.indexOf(
      'export async function createSalesOrderInvoice(',
    );
  const fulfillment =
    commands.slice(
      fulfillmentStart,
      cancelStart,
    );
  const cancellation =
    commands.slice(
      cancelStart,
      createInvoiceStart,
    );

  assert.match(fulfillment, /const requestedLineIds = new Set<string>\(\)/);
  assert.match(fulfillment, /requestedLineIds\.has\(lineId\)/);
  assert.match(fulfillment, /A fulfillment line can only be updated once per request/);
  assert.ok(
    fulfillment.indexOf('const requestedLineIds = new Set<string>()') <
      fulfillment.indexOf('const client ='),
    'Duplicate fulfillment lines must be rejected before acquiring a database connection.',
  );
  assert.match(fulfillment, /pg_advisory_xact_lock/);
  assert.match(cancellation, /pg_advisory_xact_lock/);
  assert.match(fulfillment, /sales-order-invoice:' \+ orderId/);
  assert.match(cancellation, /sales-order-invoice:' \+ orderId/);
  assert.match(cancellation, /SUM\([\s\S]*oi\.shipped_quantity[\s\S]*AS shipped_quantity/);
  assert.match(cancellation, /SUM\([\s\S]*oi\.delivered_quantity[\s\S]*AS delivered_quantity/);
  assert.match(cancellation, /This order has shipped or delivered quantities/);
  assert.match(cancellation, /Process a Sales return to reverse stock/);
  assert.match(cancellation, /pendingShipments/);
  assert.match(cancellation, /Cancel all unshipped shipment plans before cancelling this order/);

  const operations = await source('lib/apps/sales/operations.ts');
  const returnStart = operations.indexOf('export async function createSalesReturnTransaction(');
  const approveStart = operations.indexOf('export async function approveSalesReturnTransaction(', returnStart);
  const createReturn = operations.slice(returnStart, approveStart);
  assert.ok(returnStart >= 0);
  assert.ok(approveStart > returnStart);
  assert.match(createReturn, /const preparedLineIds =\s*new Set<string>\(\)/);
  assert.match(createReturn, /preparedLineIds\.has\(lineId\)/);
  assert.match(createReturn, /A sales-order line can only be selected once for a return/);
  assert.match(createReturn, /return_row\.status IN \(\s*'requested',\s*'approved'\s*\)/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(createReturn, /return_row\.status <> 'cancelled'/,
    'Received returns already reduce delivered_quantity and must not be subtracted twice.');
  assert.match(createReturn, /pg_advisory_xact_lock/);
  assert.ok(createReturn.includes("'sales-order-invoice:' + orderId"));

  const receiveStart = operations.indexOf('export async function receiveSalesReturnTransaction(');
  const issueCreditStart = operations.indexOf('export async function issueSalesReturnCreditTransaction(', receiveStart);
  const receiveReturn = operations.slice(receiveStart, issueCreditStart);
  assert.ok(receiveStart >= 0);
  assert.ok(issueCreditStart > receiveStart);
  assert.match(receiveReturn, /pg_advisory_xact_lock/);
  assert.match(receiveReturn, /sales-order-invoice:/);

  const issueReturnCreditStart = operations.indexOf('export async function issueSalesReturnCreditTransaction(');
  const refundReturnCreditStart = operations.indexOf('export async function refundSalesReturnCreditTransaction(', issueReturnCreditStart);
  const issueReturnCredit = operations.slice(issueReturnCreditStart, refundReturnCreditStart);
  const returnCreditInvoiceQueryStart = issueReturnCredit.indexOf('const invoiceItems =');
  const returnCreditInvoiceQueryEndMatch =
    issueReturnCredit.slice(returnCreditInvoiceQueryStart).search(/\n\s*for \(\s*const invoiceItem/);
  const returnCreditInvoiceQueryEnd =
    returnCreditInvoiceQueryEndMatch < 0
      ? -1
      : returnCreditInvoiceQueryStart + returnCreditInvoiceQueryEndMatch;
  const returnCreditInvoiceQuery = issueReturnCredit.slice(returnCreditInvoiceQueryStart, returnCreditInvoiceQueryEnd);
  assert.ok(issueReturnCreditStart >= 0);
  assert.ok(refundReturnCreditStart > issueReturnCreditStart);
  assert.ok(returnCreditInvoiceQueryStart >= 0);
  assert.ok(returnCreditInvoiceQueryEnd > returnCreditInvoiceQueryStart);
  assert.ok(returnCreditInvoiceQuery.includes("'sales-return:' ||"));
  assert.ok(returnCreditInvoiceQuery.includes("$4::text"));
  assert.ok(returnCreditInvoiceQuery.includes("invoice_item.invoice_id::text"));

  const invoicingCreditNotes = await source('lib/apps/invoicing/credit-notes.ts');
  const issueInvoicingCreditStart = invoicingCreditNotes.indexOf('export async function issueInvoiceCreditNote(');
  const cancelInvoicingCreditStart = invoicingCreditNotes.indexOf('export async function cancelInvoiceCreditNote(', issueInvoicingCreditStart);
  const issueInvoicingCredit = invoicingCreditNotes.slice(issueInvoicingCreditStart, cancelInvoicingCreditStart);
  assert.ok(issueInvoicingCreditStart >= 0);
  assert.ok(cancelInvoicingCreditStart > issueInvoicingCreditStart);
  assert.ok(issueInvoicingCredit.includes('const duplicateCreditState'));
  assert.ok(issueInvoicingCredit.includes('availableCredit:'));
  assert.ok(issueInvoicingCredit.includes('duplicateCreditState.availableAmount'));
  assert.match(issueInvoicingCredit, /INVOICE_STATE_INVALID/);
  assert.ok(issueInvoicingCredit.includes('The existing credit note balance could not be verified'));
  assert.match(returnCreditInvoiceQuery, /returnId,/);
  assert.match(createReturn, /'Sales order line',[\s\S]*\)\.toLowerCase\(\)/);

  const shipmentStart = operations.indexOf('export async function createSalesShipment(');
  const updateShipmentStart = operations.indexOf('export async function updateSalesShipmentStatus(', shipmentStart);
  const shipmentReturnStart = operations.indexOf('export async function createSalesReturnTransaction(', updateShipmentStart);
  const createShipment = operations.slice(shipmentStart, updateShipmentStart);
  const updateShipment = operations.slice(updateShipmentStart, shipmentReturnStart);
  assert.ok(shipmentStart >= 0);
  assert.ok(updateShipmentStart > shipmentStart);
  assert.ok(shipmentReturnStart > updateShipmentStart);
  assert.match(createShipment, /pg_advisory_xact_lock/);
  assert.ok(createShipment.includes("'sales-order-invoice:' + orderId"));
  assert.match(createShipment, /requireUuid\([\s\S]*?\)\.toLowerCase\(\);/);
  assert.match(createShipment, /createHash\('sha256'\)/);
  assert.match(createShipment, /metadata->>'idempotencyKey' = \$3/);
  assert.match(createShipment, /storedFingerprint !== requestFingerprint/);
  assert.match(createShipment, /This shipment request key already belongs to a different shipment request/);
  assert.match(createShipment, /reused: true/);
  assert.match(createShipment, /metadata,[\s\S]*created_by,[\s\S]*\$8::jsonb/);
  assert.match(createShipment, /requestFingerprint/);
  const shipmentDetailClient = await source('app/apps/sales/SalesOrderDetailClient.tsx');
  assert.match(shipmentDetailClient, /shipmentIdempotencyKey[\s\S]*useRef/);
  assert.match(shipmentDetailClient, /action:[\s\S]*'create_shipment',[\s\S]*idempotencyKey,/);
  assert.match(shipmentDetailClient, /if \(result\) \{\s*shipmentIdempotencyKey.current = null;/);
  assert.match(createShipment, /\['cancelled', 'closed'\]/);

test('Sales revision and approval engine use consistent currency-safe threshold semantics', async () => {
  const [commercial, approvals] = await Promise.all([
    source('lib/apps/sales/commercial.ts'),
    source('lib/apps/sales/approvals.ts'),
  ]);

  const revisionStart = commercial.indexOf('export async function createSalesQuoteRevision(');
  const revisionEnd = commercial.indexOf('\nexport async function ', revisionStart + 30);
  assert.ok(revisionStart >= 0 && revisionEnd > revisionStart, 'quote revision should have a bounded implementation');
  const revision = commercial.slice(revisionStart, revisionEnd);
  assert.match(revision, /salesQuoteRequiresLegacyApproval\([\s\S]*row\.base_total_amount/);

  assert.equal(
    (approvals.match(/salesQuoteRequiresLegacyApproval\(/g) || []).length,
    2,
    'approval submission and quote-to-cash enforcement must share the base-currency threshold rule',
  );
  assert.match(approvals, /return salesQuoteApprovalPolicyMatches\(policy, quote\)/);
  assert.match(approvals, /base_total_amount.*base_currency.*exchange_rate.*exchange_rate_date/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(approvals, /Number\(snapshot\.quote\.total_amount \|\| 0\) >=/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(approvals, /Number\(quote\.total_amount \|\| 0\) >=/);
});

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';

const root = process.cwd();
async function source(file) {
  return (await readFile(path.join(root, file), 'utf8')).replace(/\r\n/g, '\n');
}

test('Sales Part 11 routes legacy approval actions through the sequential approval engine', async () => {
  const [commands, engine, service, route] = await Promise.all([
    source('lib/apps/sales/commands.ts'),
    source('lib/apps/sales/approvals.ts'),
    source('lib/apps/sales/service.ts'),
    source('app/api/apps/sales/route.ts'),
  ]);
  assert.match(commands, /return requestAdvancedSalesQuoteApproval\(input\)/);
  assert.match(commands, /return reviewAdvancedSalesQuoteApproval\(input\)/);
  const requestPublicStart = engine.indexOf('export async function requestAdvancedSalesQuoteApproval(');
  const requestTransactionStart = engine.indexOf('export async function requestAdvancedSalesQuoteApprovalTransaction(', requestPublicStart);
  const reviewPublicStart = engine.indexOf('export async function reviewAdvancedSalesQuoteApproval(');
  const reviewTransactionStart = engine.indexOf('export async function reviewAdvancedSalesQuoteApprovalTransaction(', reviewPublicStart);
  assert.ok(requestPublicStart >= 0 && requestTransactionStart > requestPublicStart);
  assert.ok(reviewPublicStart > requestTransactionStart && reviewTransactionStart > reviewPublicStart);

  const reviewPublic = engine.slice(reviewPublicStart, reviewTransactionStart);
  assert.match(requestPublic, /requireSalesContext\(SALES_PERMISSIONS\.QUOTE_EDIT\)/);
  assert.match(requestPublic, /requestAdvancedSalesQuoteApprovalTransaction\(input, context\)/);
  assert.match(reviewPublic, /requireSalesContext\(SALES_PERMISSIONS\.QUOTE_INTERNAL_APPROVE\)/);
  assert.match(reviewPublic, /reviewAdvancedSalesQuoteApprovalTransaction\(input, context\)/);
  assert.match(service, /getSalesQuoteApprovalData/);

  }

test('Pipeline stage mutations are company-scoped, transactional, and keep Won/Lost terminal stages protected', async () => {
  const [pipeline, schema] = await Promise.all([
    source('lib/apps/sales/pipeline.ts'),
    source('lib/apps/sales/schema.sql'),
  ]);
  assert.match(schema, /CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public\.sales_pipeline_stages/);
  for (const name of [
    'createSalesPipelineStage',
    'updateSalesPipelineStage',
    'archiveSalesPipelineStage',
    'reorderSalesPipelineStages',
  ]) {
    const start = pipeline.indexOf('export async function ' + name);
    assert.ok(start >= 0, name + ' is implemented');
    const next = pipeline.indexOf('export async function ', start + 30);
    const body = pipeline.slice(start, next < 0 ? pipeline.length : next);
    assert.match(body, /requireSalesContext\(SALES_PERMISSIONS\.PIPELINE_MANAGE\)/, name + ' must enforce pipeline permissions');
    assert.match(body, /context\.companyId/, name + ' must scope database operations to the active company');
    assert.match(body, /BEGIN/);
    assert.match(body, /COMMIT/);
    assert.match(body, /ROLLBACK/);
  }
  assert.match(pipeline, /Won and Lost are reserved terminal stage names/);
  assert.match(pipeline, /Won and Lost are terminal stages and cannot be archived/);
  assert.match(pipeline, /Stage order must include every active open stage in this pipeline exactly once/);
  assert.match(pipeline, /INSERT INTO sales_opportunity_stage_history/);
  assert.match(pipeline, /MAX\(s\.sequence\)\+10/);
  assert.match(pipeline, /MAX\(s\.sequence\)\+20/);
});


test('Opportunity outcome transition SQL is exercised through a transaction core behind the permission-checked command', async () => {
  const pipeline = await source('lib/apps/sales/pipeline.ts');
  const helperStart = pipeline.indexOf('export async function moveSalesOpportunityTransaction(');
  const helperEnd = pipeline.indexOf('export async function moveSalesOpportunity(', helperStart);
  const wrapperEnd = pipeline.indexOf('async function normalizePipelineTerminalSequences', helperEnd);
  assert.ok(helperStart >= 0 && helperEnd > helperStart && wrapperEnd > helperEnd);

  const transactionCore = pipeline.slice(helperStart, helperEnd);
  const wrapper = pipeline.slice(helperEnd, wrapperEnd);
  assert.match(wrapper, /requireSalesContext\(SALES_PERMISSIONS\.PIPELINE_MANAGE\)/);
  const begin = wrapper.indexOf("await client.query('BEGIN')");
  const call = wrapper.indexOf('await moveSalesOpportunityTransaction(');
  const commit = wrapper.indexOf("await client.query('COMMIT')");
  assert.ok(begin >= 0 && call > begin && commit > call,
    'the public command must keep the transaction around the production transition core');
  assert.match(transactionCore, /WHERE o\.id=\$1 AND o\.company_id=\$2 AND o\.deleted_at IS NULL/);
  assert.match(transactionCore, /WHERE id=\$1 AND company_id=\$2 AND is_active=TRUE/);
  assert.match(transactionCore, /An opportunity cannot be moved to a stage in a different sales pipeline/);
  assert.match(transactionCore, /A reason is required to mark an opportunity as lost/);
  assert.match(transactionCore, /terminalSalesOpportunityProbability\(targetStageType\)/);
  assert.match(transactionCore, /INSERT INTO sales_opportunity_stage_history/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(transactionCore, /query\('BEGIN'\)|query\('COMMIT'\)|query\('ROLLBACK'\)/,
    'the transaction core must rely on the authorized production caller to commit or roll back');
});

    source('lib/apps/sales/pipeline.ts'),
    source('lib/apps/sales/pipeline-stage-rules.ts'),

  assert.match(move, /lost_at=CASE WHEN \$5='lost'/);

  assert.match(rules, /type === 'lost'\) return 0/);
});

FILE: tests\sales-pipeline-stage-rules.test.ts

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

import {
  terminalSalesOpportunityProbability,
} from '../lib/apps/sales/pipeline-stage-rules';

test('won and lost opportunity stages enforce canonical probabilities', () => {
  assert.equal(terminalSalesOpportunityProbability('won'), 100);
  assert.equal(terminalSalesOpportunityProbability('lost'), 0);
  assert.equal(terminalSalesOpportunityProbability('WON'), 100);
  assert.equal(terminalSalesOpportunityProbability(' Lost '), 0);
});

test('open and unknown stages leave probability selection to normal validation', () => {
  assert.equal(terminalSalesOpportunityProbability('open'), null);
  assert.equal(terminalSalesOpportunityProbability('qualification'), null);
  assert.equal(terminalSalesOpportunityProbability(null), null);
  assert.equal(terminalSalesOpportunityProbability(undefined), null);
});

  const saveEnd = sourceText.indexOf('export async function resolveSalesPricelistUnitPrice(', saveStart);
  assert.ok(saveStart >= 0 && saveEnd > saveStart, 'pricelist save function must exist');

  assert.match(save, /Every product-specific pricelist rule must reference an active catalogue item in this company/);

FILE: tests\sales-quote-expiry.test.ts

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import type { PoolClient } from 'pg';
import { expirePublicSalesQuoteWithAudit } from '../lib/apps/sales/public-quote-expiry';

import {
  isSalesQuoteExpired,
  salesDateOnly,
  shouldExpireSalesQuoteBeforeAcceptance,
} from '../lib/apps/sales/date-utils';

test('Sales date normalization preserves PostgreSQL DATE values and ISO date strings', () => {
  assert.equal(salesDateOnly(new Date(2026, 9, 14)), '2026-10-14');
  assert.equal(salesDateOnly('2026-10-14'), '2026-10-14');
  assert.equal(salesDateOnly('2026-10-14T18:30:00.000Z'), '2026-10-14');
  assert.equal(salesDateOnly('2026-10-14 00:00:00+03'), '2026-10-14');
});

test('Sales date normalization rejects invalid and unsupported date values', () => {
  assert.equal(salesDateOnly('2026-02-31'), null);
  assert.equal(salesDateOnly('not a date'), null);
  assert.equal(salesDateOnly(null), null);
  assert.equal(salesDateOnly(Number.NaN), null);
  assert.equal(salesDateOnly(new Date(Number.NaN)), null);
});

test('Sales quote expiry uses date-only calendar comparisons', () => {
  assert.equal(isSalesQuoteExpired(new Date(2026, 9, 14), '2026-10-15'), true);
  assert.equal(isSalesQuoteExpired('2026-10-15', '2026-10-15'), false);
  assert.equal(isSalesQuoteExpired('2026-10-16', '2026-10-15'), false);
  assert.equal(isSalesQuoteExpired(null, '2026-10-15'), false);
});

test('Sales quote acceptance expires stale quotes but does not block rejection or cancellation', () => {
  assert.equal(
    shouldExpireSalesQuoteBeforeAcceptance('2026-10-14', 'draft', 'accepted', '2026-10-15'),
    true,
  );
  assert.equal(
    shouldExpireSalesQuoteBeforeAcceptance(new Date(2026, 9, 14), 'sent', 'accepted', '2026-10-15'),
    true,
  );
  assert.equal(
    shouldExpireSalesQuoteBeforeAcceptance('2026-10-14', 'viewed', 'rejected', '2026-10-15'),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(
    shouldExpireSalesQuoteBeforeAcceptance('2026-10-14', 'viewed', 'cancelled', '2026-10-15'),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(
    shouldExpireSalesQuoteBeforeAcceptance('2026-10-15', 'sent', 'accepted', '2026-10-15'),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(
    shouldExpireSalesQuoteBeforeAcceptance('2026-10-16', 'draft', 'accepted', '2026-10-15'),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(
    shouldExpireSalesQuoteBeforeAcceptance('2026-10-14', 'accepted', 'accepted', '2026-10-15'),
    false,
  );
});


type FakeQueryResult = { rows: Array<Record<string, unknown>> };

function createFakeExpiryClient(
  results: FakeQueryResult[],
  failAtCall = -1,
) {
  const calls: Array<{ sql: string; values?: unknown[] }> = [];
  let nextCall = 0;
  const client = {
    query: async (sql: string, values?: unknown[]) => {
      const callIndex = nextCall++;
      calls.push({
        sql: sql.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(),
        values,
      });
      if (callIndex === failAtCall) {
        throw new Error('simulated database failure');
      }
      return results[callIndex] ?? { rows: [] };
    },
  } as unknown as PoolClient;

  return { client, calls };
}

test('public Sales quote expiry writes state, history and activity only when the compare-and-set succeeds', async () => {
  const quoteId = 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa';
  const companyId = 'bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb';
  const { client, calls } = createFakeExpiryClient([
    { rows: [{ id: quoteId }] },
    { rows: [] },
  ]);
  const recordedActivities: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];

  const expired = await expirePublicSalesQuoteWithAudit(
    client,
    {
      quoteId,
      companyId,
      quoteNumber: 'Q-2026-0042',
      fromStatus: 'viewed',
      source: 'public_quote_response',
      attemptedAction: 'accept',
    },
    async (_client, activity) => {
      recordedActivities.push(activity as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
    },
  );

  assert.equal(expired, true);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 2);
  assert.match(calls[0].sql, /UPDATE sales_quotes/);
  assert.match(calls[0].sql, /company_id = \$2/);
  assert.match(calls[0].sql, /status = \$3::varchar\(30\)/);
  assert.match(calls[0].sql, /RETURNING id/);
  assert.deepEqual(calls[0].values, [quoteId, companyId, 'viewed']);

  assert.match(calls[1].sql, /INSERT INTO sales_quote_status_history/);
  assert.deepEqual(calls[1].values, [
    quoteId,
    companyId,
    'viewed',
    'Quotation expired before customer action.',
  ]);

  assert.deepEqual(recordedActivities, [{
    companyId,
    userId: null,
    quoteId,
    type: 'sales.quote.expired',
    content: 'Quote Q-2026-0042 expired before customer action.',
    metadata: {
      reason: 'validity_expired',
      source: 'public_quote_response',
      attemptedAction: 'accept',
    },
  }]);
});

test('public Sales quote expiry records no history or activity when the source status changed', async () => {
  const { client, calls } = createFakeExpiryClient([
    { rows: [] },
  ]);
  let activityCount = 0;

  const expired = await expirePublicSalesQuoteWithAudit(
    client,
    {
      quoteId: 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa',
      companyId: 'bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb',
      quoteNumber: 'Q-2026-0042',
      fromStatus: 'sent',
      source: 'public_quote_view',
    },
    async () => {
      activityCount += 1;
    },
  );

  assert.equal(expired, false);
  assert.equal(calls.length, 1);
  assert.equal(activityCount, 0);
});

test('public Sales quote expiry propagates audit failures so the caller can roll back', async () => {
  const { client, calls } = createFakeExpiryClient([
    { rows: [{ id: 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa' }] },
  ], 1);
  let activityCount = 0;

  await assert.rejects(
    expirePublicSalesQuoteWithAudit(
      client,
      {
        quoteId: 'aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa',
        companyId: 'bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb',
        quoteNumber: 'Q-2026-0042',
        fromStatus: 'sent',
        source: 'public_quote_view',
      },
      async () => {
        activityCount += 1;
      },
    ),
    /simulated database failure/,
  );

  assert.equal(calls.length, 2);
  assert.equal(activityCount, 0);
});

FILE: tests\sales-return-credit-idempotency.test.mjs

import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import test from 'node:test';

const root = process.cwd();

async function source(file) {

}

test('Sales return credit counters change only when a new allocation is committed', async () => {
  const operations = await source('lib/apps/sales/operations.ts');
  const start = operations.indexOf('export async function issueSalesReturnCreditTransaction(');
  const end = operations.indexOf('export async function refundSalesReturnCreditTransaction(', start);
  assert.ok(start >= 0 && end > start, 'return-credit issuance function must exist');

  const credit = operations.slice(start, end);
  const saved = credit.indexOf('INSERT INTO sales_return_credits');
  const allocation = credit.indexOf('INSERT INTO sales_return_credit_items');
  const counterUpdate = credit.indexOf('UPDATE sales_order_items_v2');
  assert.ok(saved >= 0, 'persist the return-credit record');
  assert.ok(allocation > saved, 'persist the invoice-line allocation after the return-credit record');
  assert.ok(counterUpdate > allocation, 'update the order-line aggregate after persisting the allocation');

  assert.ok(credit.includes('const serializationClient = await context.pool.connect()'));
  assert.match(credit, /await client\.query\('BEGIN'\)/);
  assert.match(credit, /await client\.query\('COMMIT'\)/);
  assert.match(credit, /await client\.query\('ROLLBACK'\)/);
  assert.match(credit, /ON CONFLICT\s*\([\s\S]*?return_credit_id,[\s\S]*?return_item_id,[\s\S]*?invoice_item_id[\s\S]*?\)\s*DO NOTHING\s*RETURNING id/);
  assert.match(credit, /if \(allocation\.rows\.length > 0\)\s*\{[\s\S]*?UPDATE sales_order_items_v2[\s\S]*?credited_quantity\s*=\s*LEAST\([\s\S]*?credited_quantity\s*\+\s*\$4/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(
    credit,
    /credited_quantity\s*=\s*LEAST\([\s\S]*?SELECT SUM\(credit_item\.quantity\)/,
    'do not discard historical aggregate values by recomputing only from the current allocation table',
  );

});

test('Sales return-credit issuance serializes retries and preserves refund lifecycle states', async () => {
  const operations = await source('lib/apps/sales/operations.ts');
  const start = operations.indexOf('export async function issueSalesReturnCreditTransaction(');
  const end = operations.indexOf('export async function refundSalesReturnCreditTransaction(', start);
  const credit = operations.slice(start, end);
  const compact = credit.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

  const lock = credit.indexOf("pg_advisory_lock(hashtext($1), hashtext($2))");
  const returnRead = credit.indexOf('FROM sales_returns');
  const invoiceCredit = credit.indexOf('await deps.issueInvoiceCreditNote(');
  const unlock = credit.indexOf("pg_advisory_unlock(hashtext($1), hashtext($2))");
  assert.ok(lock >= 0 && lock < returnRead, 'serialize before reading return-credit state');
  assert.match(credit, /!\[\s*'received',\s*'credited',\s*'partially_refunded',\s*'refunded',?\s*\]\.includes/, 'allow idempotent recovery of a return whose refund already completed');
  assert.ok(invoiceCredit > lock && unlock > invoiceCredit, 'hold the lock over cross-module credit creation and recovery');
  assert.ok(
    compact.includes("status = CASE WHEN status IN ('partially_refunded', 'refunded') THEN status WHEN $4::boolean THEN 'credited' ELSE status END"),
    'do not overwrite a refund state or mark an un-invoiced return as credited',
  );
  assert.ok(compact.includes("credited_at = CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN COALESCE(credited_at, NOW()) ELSE credited_at END"));
  assert.match(credit, /RETURNING status/);
  assert.ok(compact.includes("status: String(returnState.rows[0]?.status || returnRow.status)"));
});

test('Sales return refunds serialize with credit issuance and reload the balance after locking', async () => {
  const operations = await source('lib/apps/sales/operations.ts');
  const start = operations.indexOf('export async function refundSalesReturnCreditTransaction(');
  const refund = operations.slice(start);
  const compact = refund.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

  const firstCreditRead = refund.indexOf('FROM sales_return_credits');
  const lock = refund.indexOf("pg_advisory_lock(hashtext($1), hashtext($2))");
  const freshCreditRead = refund.indexOf('const freshResult = await serializationClient.query(');
  const refundCall = refund.indexOf('await deps.refundInvoiceCreditNote(');
  const unlock = refund.indexOf("pg_advisory_unlock(hashtext($1), hashtext($2))");

  assert.ok(firstCreditRead >= 0 && firstCreditRead < lock, 'identify the parent return before taking its lock');
  assert.ok(lock < freshCreditRead && freshCreditRead < refundCall, 're-read authoritative credit balance under the shared lock before refunding');
  assert.ok(refundCall < unlock, 'hold the same return lock through the cross-module refund and Sales state repair');
  assert.ok(compact.includes("'sales-return-credit:' + returnId"), 'refund and credit issuance use the same per-return lock identity');
  assert.ok(compact.includes('AND credit.return_id = $3'), 'the locked re-read must remain tied to the parent return');
});

test('Sales refund retries recover their posted amount before available-balance validation', async () => {
  const operations = await source('lib/apps/sales/operations.ts');
  const start = operations.indexOf('export async function refundSalesReturnCreditTransaction(');
  const refund = operations.slice(start);
  const compact = refund.replace(/\s+/g, ' ');

  const priorRefundLookup = refund.indexOf('FROM invoicing_credit_note_refunds');
  const amountValidation = refund.indexOf('if (', priorRefundLookup);
  const refundCall = refund.indexOf('await deps.refundInvoiceCreditNote(');
  assert.ok(priorRefundLookup >= 0 && priorRefundLookup < refundCall, 'look up a caller-supplied idempotency key before retry amount validation');
  assert.ok(compact.includes("'credit-refund:' + suppliedRefundKey"), 'look up the exact key used by Invoicing');
  assert.ok(compact.includes('salesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey(returnCreditId, callerKey)'), 'use the full-key collision-safe helper');
  assert.ok(compact.includes('legacySalesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey(returnCreditId, callerKey)'), 'preserve lookup compatibility for old keys');
  assert.ok(compact.includes('idempotency_key IN ($3, $4)'), 'recover both new hashed keys and legacy truncated keys');
  assert.match(compact, /const refundOperationKey = priorRefund \? String\(priorRefund\.idempotency_key\)\.slice\('credit-refund:'\.length\) : suppliedRefundKey/);
  assert.ok(compact.includes('const amount = priorRefund ? money(priorRefund.amount) : requestedAmount ?? available'));
  assert.ok(compact.includes('(!priorRefund && amount > available + 0.0001)'), 'apply available-balance rejection only to new refunds');
  assert.ok(compact.includes("refundedAmount <= 0.0001 ? 'credited'"), 'keep a credited return credited when no posted refunds exist');
});

test('Sales return-credit idempotency regression is part of Sales CI', async () => {
  const packageJson = JSON.parse(await source('package.json'));
  assert.match(packageJson.scripts['test:sales'], /tests\/sales-return-credit-idempotency\.test\.mjs/);
});


==========================================================================================
FILE: tests\sales-return-credit-rules.test.ts
==========================================================================================
import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

import {
  legacySalesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey,
  salesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey,
} from '../lib/apps/sales/return-credit-rules';

const returnCreditId = '7fd83cf8-a2a5-49e2-8d9d-fef901b6aabc';

test('return refund idempotency keys distinguish caller keys beyond legacy truncation', () => {
  const prefix = 'x'.repeat(56);
  const callerKeyA = prefix + 'a'.repeat(24);
  const callerKeyB = prefix + 'b'.repeat(24);

  assert.equal(callerKeyA.length, 80);
  assert.equal(callerKeyB.length, 80);

  const keyA = salesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey(returnCreditId, callerKeyA);
  const keyB = salesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey(returnCreditId, callerKeyB);

  assert.notEqual(keyA, keyB, 'different full caller keys must not collapse to one idempotency key');
  assert.equal(keyA, salesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey(returnCreditId, callerKeyA), 'the same caller key must be stable');
  assert.equal(keyA.length, 106, 'leave room for Invoicing’s 14-character prefix');
  assert.equal(keyB.length, 106);
});

test('legacy refund key helper preserves pre-fix lookup compatibility', () => {
  const prefix = 'x'.repeat(56);
  const callerKeyA = prefix + 'a'.repeat(24);
  const callerKeyB = prefix + 'b'.repeat(24);

  // This collision is why the legacy key may be looked up for recovery, but
  // must not be used to create new refund records.
  assert.equal(
    legacySalesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey(returnCreditId, callerKeyA),
    legacySalesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey(returnCreditId, callerKeyB),
  );
  assert.equal(legacySalesReturnRefundIdempotencyKey(returnCreditId, callerKeyA).length, 120);
});
